145	  async cleanupExpiredPairings(): Promise<void> {
146	    await this.update((data) => {
147	      const now = Date.now();
148	      for (const [key, pairing] of Object.entries(data.pendingPairings)) {
149	        if (Date.parse(pairing.expiresAt) <= now || pairing.consumedAt) {
150	          delete data.pendingPairings[key];
151	        }
152	      }
153	    });
154	  }
155	
156	  async createPendingPairing(input: {
157	    channel?: PendingPairingRecord["channel"];
158	    sessionId: string;
159	    sessionFile?: string;
160	    sessionLabel: string;
161	    expiryMs: number;
162	    codeKind?: PendingPairingRecord["codeKind"];
163	  }): Promise<{ nonce: string; pairing: PendingPairingRecord }> {
164	    const nonce = input.codeKind === "pin" ? createPairingPin() : createPairingNonce();
165	    const nonceHash = sha256(nonce);
166	    const sessionKey = sessionKeyOf(input.sessionId, input.sessionFile);
167	    const createdAt = toIsoNow();
168	    const pairing: PendingPairingRecord = {
169	      nonceHash,
170	      codeKind: input.codeKind ?? "nonce",
171	      channel: input.channel,
172	      sessionKey,
173	      sessionId: input.sessionId,
174	      sessionFile: input.sessionFile,
175	      sessionLabel: input.sessionLabel,
176	      createdAt,
177	      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + input.expiryMs).toISOString(),
178	    };
179	
180	    await this.update((data) => {
181	      for (const [key, candidate] of Object.entries(data.pendingPairings)) {
182	        if (candidate.sessionKey === sessionKey) delete data.pendingPairings[key];
183	      }
184	      data.pendingPairings[nonceHash] = pairing;
185	    });
186	
187	    return { nonce, pairing };
188	  }
189	
190	  async inspectPendingPairing(nonce: string, options: { channel?: PendingPairingRecord["channel"] } = {}): Promise<PendingPairingInspection> {
191	    const data = await this.load();
192	    const pairing = findPendingPairingByCode(data, nonce);
193	    if (!pairing) return { status: "missing" };
194	    if (options.channel && pairing.channel && pairing.channel !== options.channel) return { status: "wrong-channel", pairing };
195	    if (pairing.consumedAt) return { status: "consumed", pairing };
196	    if (Date.parse(pairing.expiresAt) <= Date.now()) return { status: "expired", pairing };
197	    return { status: "active", pairing };
198	  }
199	
200	  async markPendingPairingConsumed(nonce: string, options: { channel?: PendingPairingRecord["channel"] } = {}): Promise<PendingPairingRecord | undefined> {
201	    let found: PendingPairingRecord | undefined;
202	    await this.update((data) => {
203	      const entry = findPendingPairingEntryByCode(data, nonce);
204	      const pairing = entry?.pairing;
205	      if (!pairing) return;
206	      if (options.channel && pairing.channel && pairing.channel !== options.channel) return;
207	      if (pairing.consumedAt) return;
208	      if (Date.parse(pairing.expiresAt) <= Date.now()) {
209	        delete data.pendingPairings[entry!.key];
210	        return;
211	      }
212	      found = { ...pairing, consumedAt: toIsoNow() };
213	      data.pendingPairings[entry!.key] = found;
214	    });
215	    return found;
216	  }
217	
218	  async consumePendingPairing(nonce: string, options: { channel?: PendingPairingRecord["channel"] } = {}): Promise<PendingPairingRecord | undefined> {
219	    let found: PendingPairingRecord | undefined;
220	    await this.update((data) => {
221	      const entry = findPendingPairingEntryByCode(data, nonce);
222	      const pairing = entry?.pairing;
223	      if (!pairing) return;
224	      if (options.channel && pairing.channel && pairing.channel !== options.channel) return;
225	      if (pairing.consumedAt) {
226	        delete data.pendingPairings[entry!.key];
227	        return;
228	      }
229	      if (Date.parse(pairing.expiresAt) <= Date.now()) {
230	        delete data.pendingPairings[entry!.key];
231	        return;
232	      }
233	      found = { ...pairing, consumedAt: toIsoNow() };
234	      delete data.pendingPairings[entry!.key];
235	    });
236	    return found;
237	  }

239	  async migrateSessionBindings(input: SessionBindingMigrationInput): Promise<SessionBindingMigrationResult> {
240	    const now = input.now ?? toIsoNow();
241	    const result: SessionBindingMigrationResult = { telegram: [], channels: [], movedSelections: 0 };
242	    const movedAddresses = new Map<string, Pick<ChannelActiveSelectionRecord, "channel" | "conversationId" | "userId">>();
243	
244	    await this.update((data) => {
245	      const telegram = data.bindings[input.oldSessionKey];
246	      const telegramMatchesRequester = !input.requester || input.requester.channel === "telegram"
247	        && input.requester.conversationId === String(telegram?.chatId)
248	        && input.requester.userId === String(telegram?.userId);
249	      if (telegram?.status === "active" && telegramMatchesRequester && !activeTargetTelegramBindingConflicts(data, input, telegram)) {
250	        const moved: PersistedBindingRecord = {
251	          ...telegram,
252	          sessionKey: input.newSessionKey,
253	          sessionId: input.newSessionId,
254	          sessionFile: input.newSessionFile,
255	          sessionLabel: input.newSessionLabel,
256	          lastSeenAt: now,
257	          status: "active",
258	          revokedAt: undefined,
259	          movedAt: undefined,
260	          movedToSessionKey: undefined,
261	        };
262	        data.bindings[input.oldSessionKey] = { ...telegram, status: "revoked", revokedAt: now, movedAt: now, movedToSessionKey: input.newSessionKey };
263	        data.bindings[input.newSessionKey] = moved;
264	        result.telegram.push(moved);
265	        movedAddresses.set(channelSelectionStorageKey("telegram", String(telegram.chatId), String(telegram.userId)), { channel: "telegram", conversationId: String(telegram.chatId), userId: String(telegram.userId) });
266	      }
267	
268	      for (const [key, binding] of Object.entries(data.channelBindings)) {
269	        if (binding.sessionKey !== input.oldSessionKey || binding.status !== "active") continue;
270	        if (input.requester && (input.requester.channel !== binding.channel
271	          || (input.requester.instanceId ?? "default") !== (binding.instanceId ?? "default")
272	          || input.requester.conversationId !== binding.conversationId
273	          || input.requester.userId !== binding.userId)) continue;
274	        const targetKey = channelBindingStorageKey(binding.channel, input.newSessionKey, binding.instanceId);
275	        const target = data.channelBindings[targetKey];
276	        if (target && (target.channel !== binding.channel
277	          || (target.instanceId ?? "default") !== (binding.instanceId ?? "default")
278	          || target.conversationId !== binding.conversationId
279	          || target.userId !== binding.userId)) continue;
280	        const moved: ChannelPersistedBindingRecord = {
281	          ...binding,
282	          sessionKey: input.newSessionKey,
283	          sessionId: input.newSessionId,
284	          sessionFile: input.newSessionFile,
285	          sessionLabel: input.newSessionLabel,
286	          lastSeenAt: now,
287	          status: "active",
288	          revokedAt: undefined,
289	          movedAt: undefined,
290	          movedToSessionKey: undefined,
291	        };
292	        data.channelBindings[key] = { ...binding, status: "revoked", revokedAt: now, movedAt: now, movedToSessionKey: input.newSessionKey };
293	        data.channelBindings[targetKey] = moved;
294	        result.channels.push(moved);
295	        movedAddresses.set(channelSelectionStorageKey(binding.channel, binding.conversationId, binding.userId), { channel: binding.channel, conversationId: binding.conversationId, userId: binding.userId });
296	      }
297	
298	      for (const [key, address] of movedAddresses) {
299	        const selection = data.activeChannelSelections[key];
300	        if (selection && selection.sessionKey !== input.oldSessionKey && selection.sessionKey !== input.newSessionKey) continue;
301	        data.activeChannelSelections[key] = { ...selection, ...address, sessionKey: input.newSessionKey, updatedAt: now };
302	        result.movedSelections += 1;
303	      }
304	    });
305	    return result;
306	  }

375	  async revokeChannelBinding(channel: ChannelBinding["channel"], sessionKey: string, revokedAt = toIsoNow(), instanceId = "default"): Promise<ChannelPersistedBindingRecord | undefined> {
376	    const key = channelBindingStorageKey(channel, sessionKey, instanceId);
377	    const legacyKey = legacyChannelBindingStorageKey(channel, sessionKey);
378	    let revoked: ChannelPersistedBindingRecord | undefined;
379	    await this.update((data) => {
380	      const existing = data.channelBindings[key] ?? (instanceId === "default" ? data.channelBindings[legacyKey] : undefined);
381	      if (!existing) return;
382	      revoked = revokeChannelBindingRecord(existing, revokedAt);
383	      data.channelBindings[key] = revoked;
384	      if (key !== legacyKey) delete data.channelBindings[legacyKey];
385	      clearSelectionForBinding(data, existing, sessionKey);
386	    });
387	    return revoked;
388	  }

390	  async revokeChannelBindingsForSession(sessionKey: string, revokedAt = toIsoNow()): Promise<ChannelPersistedBindingRecord[]> {
391	    const revoked: ChannelPersistedBindingRecord[] = [];
392	    await this.update((data) => {
393	      for (const [key, existing] of Object.entries(data.channelBindings)) {
394	        if (existing.sessionKey !== sessionKey || existing.status === "revoked") continue;
395	        const record = revokeChannelBindingRecord(existing, revokedAt);
396	        data.channelBindings[key] = record;
397	        clearSelectionForBinding(data, existing, sessionKey);
398	        revoked.push(record);
399	      }
400	    });
401	    return revoked;
402	  }

498	  async tryUpsertDelegationTask(task: DelegationTaskRecord, options: { maxAuditEntries?: number } = {}): Promise<{ applied: boolean; task: DelegationTaskRecord; reason?: "conflict" }> {
499	    const maxAuditEntries = Math.max(1, options.maxAuditEntries ?? 200);
500	    let result: { applied: boolean; task: DelegationTaskRecord; reason?: "conflict" } = { applied: true, task };
501	    await this.update((data) => {
502	      const current = data.delegationTasks[task.id];
503	      if (current && !delegationTaskIncludesAudit(task, current)) {
504	        result = { applied: false, task: current, reason: "conflict" };
505	        return;
506	      }
507	      saveDelegationTask(data, task, maxAuditEntries);
508	      result = { applied: true, task };
509	    });
510	    return result;
511	  }

513	  async getDelegationTask(taskId: string, options: { runningTimeoutMs?: number; now?: string } = {}): Promise<DelegationTaskRecord | undefined> {
514	    let task: DelegationTaskRecord | undefined;
515	    await this.update((data) => {
516	      const current = data.delegationTasks[taskId];
517	      if (!current) return;
518	      const next = normalizeDelegationTaskForRead(current, options);
519	      if (next !== current) {
520	        saveDelegationTask(data, next, 200);
521	      }
522	      task = next;
523	    });
524	    return task;
525	  }

527	  async listDelegationTasks(options: { room?: DelegationTaskRoomRef; roomConversationId?: string; sourceMachineId?: string; targetMachineId?: string; limit?: number; runningTimeoutMs?: number; now?: string } = {}): Promise<DelegationTaskRecord[]> {
528	    const limit = Math.max(1, options.limit ?? 50);
529	    const data = await this.update((draft) => {
530	      for (const [taskId, current] of Object.entries(draft.delegationTasks)) {
531	        const next = normalizeDelegationTaskForRead(current, options);
532	        if (next === current) continue;
533	        saveDelegationTask(draft, next, 200);
534	      }
535	    });
536	    return Object.values(data.delegationTasks)
537	      .filter((task) => !options.room || delegationRoomMatches(task.room, options.room))
538	      .filter((task) => !options.roomConversationId || task.room.conversationId === options.roomConversationId)
539	      .filter((task) => !options.sourceMachineId || task.sourceMachineId === options.sourceMachineId)
540	      .filter((task) => !options.targetMachineId || task.target.kind === "machine" && task.target.machineId === options.targetMachineId)
541	      .sort((left, right) => Date.parse(right.updatedAt) - Date.parse(left.updatedAt) || right.id.localeCompare(left.id))
542	      .slice(0, limit);
543	  }

545	  async rememberDelegationEvent(eventId: string, options: { maxEntries?: number } = {}): Promise<boolean> {
546	    const normalized = eventId.trim();
547	    if (!normalized) return false;
548	    let duplicate = false;
549	    const maxEntries = Math.max(1, options.maxEntries ?? 500);
550	    await this.update((data) => {
551	      duplicate = data.delegationHandledEvents.includes(normalized);
552	      if (!duplicate) data.delegationHandledEvents = [...data.delegationHandledEvents, normalized].slice(-maxEntries);
553	    });
554	    return duplicate;
555	  }

266	function chunkText(text) {
267	  const maxChars = config.maxTelegramMessageChars || 3900;
268	  const safe = prepareTelegramChatText(text);
269	  if (safe.length <= maxChars) return [safe];
270	  const chunks = [];
271	  let remaining = safe;
272	  while (remaining.length > maxChars) {
273	    let splitAt = remaining.lastIndexOf('\n', maxChars);
274	    if (splitAt < maxChars * 0.5) splitAt = remaining.lastIndexOf(' ', maxChars);
275	    if (splitAt < maxChars * 0.5) splitAt = maxChars;
276	    chunks.push(remaining.slice(0, splitAt).trimEnd());
277	    remaining = remaining.slice(splitAt).trimStart();
278	  }
279	  if (remaining) chunks.push(remaining);
280	  return chunks.map((chunk, index) => chunks.length > 1 ? `[${index + 1}/${chunks.length}]\n${chunk}` : chunk);
281	}

313	async function withRetry(operation) {
314	  let lastError;
315	  const retries = Math.max(1, config.sendRetryCount || 1);
316	  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= retries; attempt += 1) {
317	    try {
318	      return await operation();
319	    } catch (error) {
320	      lastError = error;
321	      if (attempt >= retries || !isRetriable(error)) break;
322	      await sleep(retryDelay(error, attempt));
323	    }
324	  }
325	  throw lastError;
326	}

507	async function downloadImage(reference) {
508	  if (!reference.supported) throw new Error(reference.unsupportedReason || 'Unsupported image attachment.');
509	  if (reference.fileSize && reference.fileSize > maxInboundImageBytes()) {
510	    throw new Error(`Image is too large (${reference.fileSize} bytes). Limit: ${maxInboundImageBytes()} bytes.`);
511	  }
512	  const telegramFile = await withRetry(() => api.getFile(reference.fileId));
513	  const remoteSize = telegramFile.file_size || reference.fileSize;
514	  if (remoteSize && remoteSize > maxInboundImageBytes()) {
515	    throw new Error(`Image is too large (${remoteSize} bytes). Limit: ${maxInboundImageBytes()} bytes.`);
516	  }
517	  if (!telegramFile.file_path) throw new Error('Telegram did not return a downloadable file path for this image.');
518	  const response = await fetch(`https://api.telegram.org/file/bot${config.botToken}/${telegramFile.file_path}`);
519	  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Telegram file download failed with HTTP ${response.status}.`);
520	  const buffer = Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer());
521	  if (buffer.byteLength > maxInboundImageBytes()) {
522	    throw new Error(`Image is too large (${buffer.byteLength} bytes). Limit: ${maxInboundImageBytes()} bytes.`);
523	  }
524	  const prepared = prepareInboundImagePromptContent(buffer, {
525	    mimeType: reference.mimeType,
526	    allowedMimeTypes: allowedImageMimeTypes(),
527	    maxBytes: maxInboundImageBytes(),
528	    fileName: reference.fileName,
529	    fallbackBase: reference.kind === 'photo' ? 'telegram-photo' : 'telegram-image',
530	  });
531	  return {
532	    image: prepared.image,
533	    fileName: prepared.fileName,
534	    fileSize: prepared.fileSize,
535	    source: reference,
536	  };
537	}

597	let stateUpdateQueue = Promise.resolve();

599	async function updateState(mutator) {
600	  const previous = stateUpdateQueue;
601	  let releaseQueue;
602	  const current = new Promise((resolve) => { releaseQueue = resolve; });
603	  stateUpdateQueue = current;
604	  await previous.catch(() => undefined);
605	
606	  try {
607	    await mkdir(config.stateDir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
608	    const releaseLock = await lockfile.lock(config.stateDir, { realpath: false, stale: 60_000, retries: { retries: 10, minTimeout: 10, maxTimeout: 100 } });
609	    try {
610	      const state = await loadState();
611	      await mutator(state);
612	      await saveState(state);
613	      return state;
614	    } finally {
615	      await releaseLock();
616	    }
617	  } finally {
618	    releaseQueue();
619	    if (stateUpdateQueue === current) stateUpdateQueue = Promise.resolve();
620	  }
621	}

1323	async function inspectPendingPairing(nonce, expectedChannel = 'telegram') {
1324	  const nonceHash = await pairingHashForCode(nonce);
1325	  const state = await loadState();
1326	  const pairing = state.pendingPairings[nonceHash];
1327	  if (!pairing) return { status: 'missing' };
1328	  if (expectedChannel && pairing.channel && pairing.channel !== expectedChannel) return { status: 'wrong-channel', pairing };
1329	  if (pairing.consumedAt) return { status: 'consumed', pairing };
1330	  if (Date.parse(pairing.expiresAt) <= Date.now()) return { status: 'expired', pairing };
1331	  return { status: 'active', pairing };
1332	}

1334	async function consumePendingPairing(nonce, expectedChannel = 'telegram') {
1335	  const nonceHash = await pairingHashForCode(nonce);
1336	  let found;
1337	  await updateState((state) => {
1338	    const pairing = state.pendingPairings[nonceHash];
1339	    if (!pairing) return;
1340	    if (expectedChannel && pairing.channel && pairing.channel !== expectedChannel) return;
1341	    if (pairing.consumedAt || Date.parse(pairing.expiresAt) <= Date.now()) {
1342	      delete state.pendingPairings[nonceHash];
1343	      return;
1344	    }
1345	    found = { ...pairing, consumedAt: nowIso() };
1346	    delete state.pendingPairings[nonceHash];
1347	  });
1348	  return found;
1349	}

167	  if (!config.enabled || config.rules.length === 0) return undefined;
168	  const toolName = input.toolName.trim();
169	  const summary = summarizeToolCall(toolName, input.input);
170	  const category = inferApprovalCategory(toolName, input.input, summary);
171	  const searchable = `${toolName}\n${category}\n${rawSearchText(input.input)}\n${summary}`.toLowerCase();
172	  const pathText = extractPathText(input.input).toLowerCase();
173	  const commandText = extractCommandText(input.input).toLowerCase();
174	  const matched = config.rules.find((rule) => ruleMatches(rule, { toolName, category, searchable, pathText, commandText }));
175	  if (!matched) return undefined;
176	  const matcherFingerprint = approvalMatcherFingerprint({ toolName, category, matchedRuleId: matched.id, summaryBasis: fingerprintBasis(toolName, input.input, summary) });
177	  return {
178	    operationId: input.toolCallId?.trim() || randomUUID(),
179	    toolName,
180	    input: input.input,
181	    category,
182	    summary,
183	    matcherFingerprint,
184	    matchedRuleId: matched.id,
185	  };
186	}

188	export function summarizeToolCall(toolName: string, input: unknown): string {
189	  const name = toolName.trim() || "tool";
190	  if (name === "bash") {
191	    const command = extractStringField(input, "command") ?? rawSearchText(input);
192	    return boundSummary(`Run shell command: ${redactApprovalText(command)}`);
193	  }
194	  if (name === "write") {
195	    const path = extractStringField(input, "path") ?? extractStringField(input, "filePath") ?? "unknown path";
196	    const content = extractStringField(input, "content") ?? "";
197	    return boundSummary(`Write file: ${redactApprovalText(path)}${content ? ` (${content.length} chars)` : ""}`);
198	  }
199	  if (name === "edit") {
200	    const path = extractStringField(input, "path") ?? extractStringField(input, "filePath") ?? "unknown path";
201	    const oldText = extractStringField(input, "oldText") ?? "";
202	    const newText = extractStringField(input, "newText") ?? "";
203	    return boundSummary(`Edit file: ${redactApprovalText(path)} (${oldText.length} → ${newText.length} chars)`);
204	  }
205	  return boundSummary(`${name}: ${redactApprovalText(rawSearchText(input))}`);
206	}

208	export function redactApprovalText(text: string): string {
209	  return redactSecrets(text)
210	    .replace(/(token|secret|password|passwd|api[_-]?key|authorization)\s*[:=]\s*([^\s"']+)/gi, "$1=[redacted]")
211	    .replace(/Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+/gi, "Bearer [redacted]")
212	    .replace(/--(token|password|secret|api-key|api_key)\s+[^\s"']+/gi, "--$1 [redacted]")
213	    .replace(/https?:\/\/[^\s"']*(token|secret|key|signature|sig|X-Amz-Signature)[^\s"']*/gi, "[redacted-url]");
214	}

216	export function inferApprovalCategory(toolName: string, input: unknown, summary = rawSearchText(input)): ApprovalRiskCategory {
217	  if (toolName === "write" || toolName === "edit") return "file-write";
218	  if (toolName !== "bash") return "custom";
219	  const command = (extractCommandText(input) || summary).toLowerCase();
220	  if (/\b(git\s+push|git\s+pull|git\s+fetch|git\s+remote|gh\s+release|gh\s+repo)\b/.test(command)) return "git-remote";
221	  if (/\b(npm\s+publish|pnpm\s+publish|yarn\s+npm\s+publish|twine\s+upload|docker\s+push|cargo\s+publish)\b/.test(command)) return "publish";
222	  if (/\b(rm\s+-[^\n]*r|rm\s+-rf|sudo\b|chmod\s+777|chown\b|mkfs\b|dd\s+if=|killall\b|pkill\b)\b/.test(command)) return "destructive";
223	  return "shell";
224	}

235	export function parseApprovalTextCommand(command: string, args: string): { decision: ApprovalDecisionKind; approvalId: string } | undefined {
236	  if (command !== "approval" && command !== "approve") return undefined;
237	  const parts = args.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
238	  const verb = command === "approve" ? "approve" : parts.shift();
239	  const approvalId = parts.shift();
240	  if (!verb || !approvalId) return undefined;
241	  const decision = verb === "approve" ? "approve-once"
242	    : verb === "approve-session" || verb === "session" ? "approve-session"
243	    : verb === "approve-persistent" || verb === "persistent" ? "approve-persistent"
244	    : verb === "deny" ? "deny"
245	    : undefined;
246	  return decision ? { decision, approvalId } : undefined;
247	}

249	export function parseApprovalActionData(value: string): { decision: ApprovalDecisionKind; approvalId: string } | undefined {
250	  const parts = value.split(":");
251	  if (parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === COMPACT_ACTION_PREFIX) {
252	    const decision = APPROVAL_DECISION_BY_CODE[parts[1] ?? ""];
253	    const approvalId = parts[2]?.trim();
254	    return decision && approvalId ? { decision, approvalId } : undefined;
255	  }
256	  if (parts.length !== 4 || parts[0] !== "pirelay" || parts[1] !== "approval") return undefined;
257	  const decision = parts[2];
258	  if (decision !== "approve-once" && decision !== "approve-session" && decision !== "approve-persistent" && decision !== "deny") return undefined;
259	  const approvalId = parts[3]?.trim();
260	  return approvalId ? { decision, approvalId } : undefined;
261	}

358	function ruleMatches(rule: ApprovalGateRule, input: { toolName: string; category: ApprovalRiskCategory; searchable: string; pathText: string; commandText: string }): boolean {
359	  const tools = [...(rule.tools ?? []), ...(rule.toolNames ?? [])].map((tool) => tool.toLowerCase());
360	  if (tools.length > 0 && !tools.includes(input.toolName.toLowerCase())) return false;
361	  if (rule.categories && rule.categories.length > 0 && !rule.categories.includes(input.category)) return false;
362	  const hasPatternConstraints = hasConfiguredPatterns(rule.commandPatterns) || hasConfiguredPatterns(rule.pathPatterns) || hasConfiguredPatterns(rule.textPatterns);
363	  const patternMatched = patternsMatch(rule.commandPatterns, input.commandText)
364	    || patternsMatch(rule.pathPatterns, input.pathText)
365	    || patternsMatch(rule.textPatterns, input.searchable);
366	  if (hasPatternConstraints) return patternMatched;
367	  return tools.length > 0 || Boolean(rule.categories && rule.categories.length > 0);
368	}
369	
370	function hasConfiguredPatterns(patterns: string[] | undefined): boolean {
371	  return Boolean(patterns?.some((pattern) => pattern.trim().length > 0));
372	}
373	
374	function patternsMatch(patterns: string[] | undefined, text: string): boolean {
375	  if (!patterns || patterns.length === 0) return false;
376	  return patterns.some((pattern) => {
377	    const normalized = pattern.trim().toLowerCase();
378	    if (!normalized) return false;
379	    if (normalized.startsWith("/") && normalized.endsWith("/") && normalized.length > 2) {
380	      try {
381	        return new RegExp(normalized.slice(1, -1), "i").test(text);
382	      } catch (error) {
383	        throw new Error(`Invalid approval pattern ${pattern}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
384	      }
385	    }
386	    return text.includes(normalized);
387	  });
388	}
389	
390	function clampNumber(value: number | undefined, fallback: number, min: number, max: number): number {
391	  if (value === undefined || !Number.isFinite(value)) return fallback;
392	  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, Math.trunc(value)));
393	}
394	
395	function extractStringField(input: unknown, field: string): string | undefined {
396	  if (!input || typeof input !== "object" || !(field in input)) return undefined;
397	  const value = (input as Record<string, unknown>)[field];
398	  return typeof value === "string" ? value : undefined;
399	}
400	
401	function extractCommandText(input: unknown): string {
402	  return extractStringField(input, "command") ?? extractStringField(input, "cmd") ?? "";
403	}
404	
405	function extractPathText(input: unknown): string {
406	  return ["path", "filePath", "relativePath"].map((field) => extractStringField(input, field)).filter(Boolean).join("\n");
407	}
408	
409	function rawSearchText(input: unknown): string {
410	  if (typeof input === "string") return input;
411	  try {
412	    return JSON.stringify(input ?? {});
413	  } catch (error) {
414	    throw new Error(`Could not summarize approval input: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
415	  }
416	}
417	
418	function fingerprintBasis(toolName: string, input: unknown, summary: string): string {
419	  if (toolName === "bash") return extractCommandText(input) || summary;
420	  return `${extractPathText(input)}\n${summary}`;
421	}
422	
423	function boundSummary(text: string): string {
424	  const normalized = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
425	  return normalized.length <= MAX_APPROVAL_SUMMARY_CHARS ? normalized : `${normalized.slice(0, MAX_APPROVAL_SUMMARY_CHARS - 1)}…`;

283	  async function ensureConfig(ctx?: ExtensionContext, interactiveNotice = false): Promise<TelegramTunnelConfig> {
284	    if (configCache) return configCache;

286	    configCache = config;

288	    if (ctx && interactiveNotice) {

299	      }

397	  async function stopAndClearRuntimes(ctx: ExtensionContext, options: { restartBrokerProcess?: boolean } = {}): Promise<{ telegramStopped: boolean; discordStopped: string[]; slackStopped: string[]; brokerRestarted: boolean; brokerRestartResult?: Awaited<ReturnType<NonNullable<TunnelRuntime["restartBrokerProcess"]>>> }> {
398	    resetToolProgress();
399	    let telegramStopped = false;
400	    let brokerRestarted = false;
401	    let brokerRestartResult: Awaited<ReturnType<NonNullable<TunnelRuntime["restartBrokerProcess"]>>> | undefined;
402	    const discordStopped: string[] = [];
403	    const slackStopped: string[] = [];
404	    const failures: unknown[] = [];
405	    if (runtime) {
406	      try {
407	        if (options.restartBrokerProcess && runtime.restartBrokerProcess) {
408	          brokerRestartResult = await runtime.restartBrokerProcess();
409	          brokerRestarted = true;
410	        } else {
411	          await runtime.stop();
412	        }
413	        runtime = undefined;
414	        telegramRuntimeStatus = { enabled: true, started: false };
415	        telegramStopped = true;
416	      } catch (error) {
417	        failures.push(error);
418	      }
419	    }
420	    for (const [instanceId, discord] of [...discordRuntimes]) {
421	      try {
422	        await discord.stop();
423	        discordRuntimes.delete(instanceId);
424	        discordStopped.push(instanceId);
425	      } catch (error) {
426	        failures.push(error);
427	      }
428	    }
429	    for (const [instanceId, slack] of [...slackRuntimes]) {
430	      try {
431	        await slack.stop();
432	        slackRuntimes.delete(instanceId);
433	        slackStopped.push(instanceId);
434	      } catch (error) {
435	        failures.push(error);
436	      }
437	    }
438	    if (failures.length > 0) {
439	      const first = failures[0];
440	      const message = first instanceof Error ? first.message : String(first);
441	      ctx.ui.notify(`Stopped PiRelay runtimes with ${failures.length} warning(s): ${redactSecrets(message)}`, "warning");
442	    }
443	    return { telegramStopped, discordStopped, slackStopped, brokerRestarted, brokerRestartResult };
444	  }

446	  function statusKeyForChannel(channel: RelayStatusLineChannel, instanceId = "default"): string {
447	    if (channel === "telegram") return "relay";
448	    const base = `${channel}-relay`;
449	    return instanceId === "default" ? base : `${base}:${instanceId}`;
450	  }
451	
452	  function telegramStatusBinding(binding: PersistedBindingRecord | TelegramBindingMetadata | undefined): RelayStatusLineBindingState | undefined {
453	    if (!binding || "status" in binding && binding.status === "revoked") return undefined;
454	    return { paused: binding.paused, conversationKind: "private" };
455	  }
456	
457	  function channelStatusBinding(binding: ChannelPersistedBindingRecord | undefined): RelayStatusLineBindingState | undefined {
458	    if (!binding || binding.status === "revoked") return undefined;
459	    const conversationKind = typeof binding.metadata?.conversationKind === "string" ? binding.metadata.conversationKind : undefined;
460	    return { paused: binding.paused, conversationKind };
461	  }
462	
463	  async function currentStatusBinding(config: TelegramTunnelConfig, channel: RelayStatusLineChannel, instanceId = "default"): Promise<RelayStatusLineBindingState | undefined> {
464	    if (!currentRoute) return undefined;
465	    const store = new TunnelStateStore(config.stateDir);
466	    const snapshot = await store.loadBindingAuthoritySnapshot();
467	    if (channel === "telegram") {
468	      const routeBinding = currentRoute.binding ?? volatileTelegramBindings.get(currentRoute.sessionKey);
469	      if (snapshot.kind === "state-unavailable") return routeBinding ? telegramStatusBinding(routeBinding) : undefined;
470	      const outcome = resolveTelegramBindingAuthority(
471	        snapshot,
472	        { sessionKey: currentRoute.sessionKey, chatId: routeBinding?.chatId, userId: routeBinding?.userId, includePaused: true, allowVolatileFallback: true },
473	        routeBinding,
474	      );
475	      if (!authorityOutcomeAllowsDelivery(outcome)) return undefined;
476	      currentRoute.binding = outcome.binding;
477	      return telegramStatusBinding(outcome.binding);
478	    }
479	    const outcome = resolveChannelBindingAuthority(
480	      snapshot,
481	      { channel, sessionKey: currentRoute.sessionKey, instanceId, includePaused: true },
482	    );
483	    return authorityOutcomeAllowsDelivery(outcome) && "status" in outcome.binding ? channelStatusBinding(outcome.binding) : undefined;
484	  }
485	
486	  async function setMessengerStatus(ctx: ExtensionContext, channel: RelayStatusLineChannel, state: Omit<Parameters<typeof formatRelayStatusLine>[0], "channel" | "binding"> & { binding?: RelayStatusLineBindingState }, instanceId = "default"): Promise<void> {
487	    const key = statusKeyForChannel(channel, instanceId);
488	    if (state.error) relayStatusDiagnostics.set(key, `${channel}${instanceId === "default" ? "" : `:${instanceId}`}: ${state.error}`);
489	    else relayStatusDiagnostics.delete(key);
490	    const colorize = ctx.ui.theme ? (tone: Parameters<Theme["fg"]>[0], text: string) => ctx.ui.theme.fg(tone, text) : undefined;
491	    safeSetStatus(key, formatRelayStatusLine({ channel, ...state }, { colorize }), ctx);
492	  }
493	
494	  function clearStatus(key: string, ctx = latestContext): void {
495	    relayStatusDiagnostics.delete(key);
496	    safeSetStatus(key, "", ctx);
497	  }

499	  function discordStatusConfigured(config: DiscordRelayConfig | undefined): boolean {
500	    return Boolean(config?.enabled && config.botToken);
501	  }
502	
503	  function slackStatusConfigured(config: SlackRelayConfig | undefined): boolean {
504	    if (!config?.enabled || !config.botToken || !config.signingSecret) return false;
505	    return (config.eventMode ?? "socket") === "webhook" || Boolean(config.appToken);
506	  }
507	
508	  function statusConfiguredForChannel(config: TelegramTunnelConfig, channel: RelayStatusLineChannel, instanceId: string): boolean {
509	    if (channel === "telegram") return Boolean(config.botToken);
510	    if (channel === "discord") return discordStatusConfigured(config.discordInstances?.[instanceId] ?? (instanceId === "default" ? config.discord : undefined));
511	    return slackStatusConfigured(config.slackInstances?.[instanceId] ?? (instanceId === "default" ? config.slack : undefined));
512	  }
513	
514	  async function refreshMessengerStatus(ctx: ExtensionContext, channel: RelayStatusLineChannel, runtimeStatus?: { enabled: boolean; started: boolean; error?: string }, instanceId = "default"): Promise<void> {
515	    const config = await ensureConfig(ctx, false);
516	    const configured = statusConfiguredForChannel(config, channel, instanceId);
517	    const binding = runtimeStatus?.error ? undefined : await currentStatusBinding(config, channel, instanceId);
518	    const brokerState = channel === "telegram" ? runtime?.getBrokerSynchronizationState?.() : undefined;
519	    await setMessengerStatus(ctx, channel, {
520	      configured,
521	      runtimeStarted: channel === "telegram" ? Boolean(runtime) : runtimeStatus?.started,
522	      error: runtimeStatus?.error ? redactSecrets(runtimeStatus.error) : undefined,
523	      binding,
524	      broker: brokerState && currentRoute ? { transport: brokerState.transport, route: brokerState.routes[currentRoute.sessionKey] ?? "unknown" } : undefined,
525	    }, instanceId);
526	  }
527	
528	  async function refreshRelayStatuses(ctx: ExtensionContext): Promise<void> {
529	    await refreshMessengerStatus(ctx, "telegram", telegramRuntimeStatus);
530	    for (const [instanceId, discord] of discordRuntimes) await refreshMessengerStatus(ctx, "discord", discord.getStatus(), instanceId);
531	    for (const [instanceId, slack] of slackRuntimes) await refreshMessengerStatus(ctx, "slack", slack.getStatus(), instanceId);
532	  }
533	
534	  async function resetStoppedRuntimeStatuses(ctx: ExtensionContext, stopped: { telegramStopped: boolean; discordStopped: string[]; slackStopped: string[] }): Promise<void> {
535	    const config = await ensureConfig(ctx, false);
536	    if (stopped.telegramStopped) await setMessengerStatus(ctx, "telegram", { configured: Boolean(config.botToken), runtimeStarted: false });
537	    for (const instanceId of stopped.discordStopped) {
538	      await setMessengerStatus(ctx, "discord", { configured: statusConfiguredForChannel(config, "discord", instanceId), runtimeStarted: false }, instanceId);
539	    }
540	    for (const instanceId of stopped.slackStopped) {
541	      await setMessengerStatus(ctx, "slack", { configured: statusConfiguredForChannel(config, "slack", instanceId), runtimeStarted: false }, instanceId);
542	    }
543	  }
544	
545	  function refreshRelayStatusesSoon(ctx?: ExtensionContext): void {
546	    ctx ??= latestContext;
547	    if (!ctx || safeSessionKeyForContext(ctx) !== currentRoute?.sessionKey) return;
548	    void refreshRelayStatuses(ctx).catch((error) => {
549	      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
550	      safeSetStatus("relay-sync", `relay status error: ${redactSecrets(message)}`, ctx);
551	    });
552	  }
553	
554	  async function startDiscordRuntime(ctx: ExtensionContext, discord: DiscordRuntime, failHard = false, instanceId = "default"): Promise<boolean> {
555	    if (discord.getStatus().started) {
556	      await refreshMessengerStatus(ctx, "discord", discord.getStatus(), instanceId);
557	      return true;
558	    }
559	    try {
560	      await discord.start();
561	      await refreshMessengerStatus(ctx, "discord", discord.getStatus(), instanceId);
562	      return true;
563	    } catch (error) {
564	      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
565	      const safeMessage = redactSecrets(message);
566	      await setMessengerStatus(ctx, "discord", { configured: true, runtimeStarted: false, error: safeMessage }, instanceId);
567	      if (failHard) throw new Error(`Discord runtime failed to start: ${safeMessage}`);
568	      return false;
569	    }
570	  }
571	
572	  async function startSlackRuntime(ctx: ExtensionContext, slack: SlackRuntime, failHard = false, instanceId = "default"): Promise<boolean> {
573	    if (slack.getStatus().started) {
574	      await refreshMessengerStatus(ctx, "slack", slack.getStatus(), instanceId);
575	      return true;
576	    }
577	    try {
578	      await slack.start();
579	      const status = slack.getStatus();
580	      if (!status.started) {
581	        const safeMessage = redactSecrets(status.error || "Slack runtime did not start.");
582	        await setMessengerStatus(ctx, "slack", { configured: true, runtimeStarted: false, error: safeMessage }, instanceId);
583	        if (failHard) throw new Error(`Slack runtime failed to start: ${safeMessage}`);
584	        return false;
585	      }
586	      await refreshMessengerStatus(ctx, "slack", status, instanceId);
587	      return true;
588	    } catch (error) {
589	      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
590	      const safeMessage = redactSecrets(message);
591	      await setMessengerStatus(ctx, "slack", { configured: true, runtimeStarted: false, error: safeMessage }, instanceId);
592	      if (failHard) throw new Error(`Slack runtime failed to start: ${safeMessage}`);
593	      return false;
594	    }
595	  }

597	  function resetToolProgress(): void {
598	    toolProgress.reset();
599	    suppressedToolProgressIds.clear();
600	    suppressedMissingToolProgress.clear();
601	  }
602	
603	  function missingToolProgressKey(toolName: unknown): string | undefined {
604	    const normalized = String(toolName ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
605	    return normalized || undefined;
606	  }
607	
608	  function suppressToolProgress(event: ToolProgressEventInput, config: Pick<TelegramTunnelConfig, "redactionPatterns" | "maxProgressMessageChars">): void {
609	    if (typeof event.toolCallId === "string" && event.toolCallId.trim()) {
610	      const stableId = event.toolCallId.trim();
611	      suppressedToolProgressIds.add(stableId);
612	      toolProgress.discard(stableId);
613	      return;
614	    }
615	    const key = missingToolProgressKey(event.toolName);
616	    if (!key) return;
617	    suppressedMissingToolProgress.set(key, (suppressedMissingToolProgress.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
618	    toolProgress.discardMatching(event, config);
619	  }
620	
621	  function isToolProgressSuppressed(toolCallId: unknown, toolName: unknown): boolean {
622	    if (typeof toolCallId === "string" && toolCallId.trim()) return suppressedToolProgressIds.has(toolCallId.trim());
623	    const key = missingToolProgressKey(toolName);
624	    return key !== undefined && (suppressedMissingToolProgress.get(key) ?? 0) > 0;
625	  }
626	
627	  function consumeToolProgressSuppression(toolCallId: unknown, toolName: unknown): boolean {
628	    if (typeof toolCallId === "string" && toolCallId.trim()) return suppressedToolProgressIds.delete(toolCallId.trim());
629	    const key = missingToolProgressKey(toolName);
630	    if (!key) return false;
631	    const count = suppressedMissingToolProgress.get(key) ?? 0;
632	    if (count <= 0) return false;
633	    if (count === 1) suppressedMissingToolProgress.delete(key);
634	    else suppressedMissingToolProgress.set(key, count - 1);
635	    return true;
636	  }

639	    activeTurnImages = [];

644	    resetToolProgress();
645	  }

647	  function appendAudit(message: string, route?: SessionRoute): void {
648	    const safe = summarizeTextDeterministically(message, 280);
649	    try {
650	      pi.sendMessage({ customType: AUDIT_MESSAGE_TYPE, content: safe, display: true });
651	    } catch (error) {
652	      if (isStaleExtensionReferenceError(error)) {
653	        if (route) invalidateLiveContextForRoute(route);
654	        else latestContext = undefined;
655	        return;
656	      }
657	      throw error;
658	    }
659	  }

662	    const config = await ensureConfig();
663	    let workspaceRoot: string;
664	    try {
665	      workspaceRoot = ctx.cwd;

668	        if (route) invalidateLiveContextForRoute(route);
669	        else if (latestContext === ctx) latestContext = undefined;
670	        return { ok: false, error: unavailableRouteMessage() };
671	      }
672	      throw error;
673	    }
674	    return loadWorkspaceImageFile(relativePath, {
675	      workspaceRoot,
676	      turnId,
677	      index,
678	      maxBytes: config.maxOutboundImageBytes,
679	      allowedMimeTypes: config.allowedImageMimeTypes,
680	    });

683	  async function getLatestImagesForTelegram(route: SessionRoute): Promise<LatestTurnImage[]> {
684	    const ctx = liveContextForRoute(route);
685	    if (!ctx) return [];
686	    const images = [...latestTurnImages];
687	    const config = await ensureConfig();
688	    for (const candidate of latestTurnImageFileCandidates) {
689	      if (images.length >= config.maxLatestImages) break;
690	      const loaded = await loadImagePathForTelegram(ctx, candidate.path, candidate.turnId, images.length, route);
691	      if (loaded.ok) images.push(loaded.image);
692	    }
693	    return images;
694	  }

696	  function recordProgress(kind: "lifecycle" | "tool" | "assistant" | "status" | "compaction", text: string, detail?: string, options: { delivery?: "milestone" | "volatile"; semanticKey?: string } = {}): void {
697	    if (!currentRoute) return;
698	    const config = configCache;
699	    const entry = createProgressActivity({
700	      id: `${Date.now()}-${++progressSequence}`,
701	      kind,
702	      text,
703	      detail,
704	      delivery: options.delivery,
705	      semanticKey: options.semanticKey,
706	    }, config ?? { redactionPatterns: [], maxProgressMessageChars: undefined });
707	    if (!entry) return;
708	    currentRoute.notification.progressEvent = entry;
709	    appendRecentActivity(currentRoute.notification, entry, recentActivityLimit(config ?? {}));
710	    currentRoute.lastActivityAt = Date.now();

713	  function recordToolProgressActivity(input: ToolProgressEventInput & { state: "active" | "completed" | "failed" }, config: Pick<TelegramTunnelConfig, "redactionPatterns" | "maxProgressMessageChars" | "recentActivityLimit">): void {
714	    if (!currentRoute) return;
715	    if (input.state === "active") toolProgress.start(input, config);
716	    else toolProgress.finish({ ...input, failed: input.state === "failed" }, config);
717	    const entry = toolProgress.activity({ id: `${Date.now()}-${++progressSequence}`, at: input.at }, config);
718	    if (!entry) return;
719	    currentRoute.notification.progressEvent = entry;
720	    appendRecentActivity(currentRoute.notification, entry, recentActivityLimit(config));
721	    currentRoute.lastActivityAt = Date.now();
722	  }

731	  function persistBinding(binding: TelegramBindingMetadata | null, revoked = false, route?: SessionRoute): void {
732	    const data: BindingEntryData = {
733	      version: 1,
734	      binding: binding ?? undefined,
735	      revoked,
736	      revokedAt: revoked ? toIsoNow() : undefined,
737	    };
738	    try {
739	      pi.appendEntry<BindingEntryData>(BINDING_ENTRY_TYPE, data);
740	    } catch (error) {
741	      if (isStaleExtensionReferenceError(error)) {
742	        if (route) invalidateLiveContextForRoute(route);
743	        else latestContext = undefined;
744	        return;
745	      }
746	      throw error;
747	    }
748	    if (route) {
749	      if (revoked || !binding) volatileTelegramBindings.delete(route.sessionKey);
750	      else volatileTelegramBindings.set(route.sessionKey, binding);
751	    }
752	    if (route && currentRoute?.sessionKey === route.sessionKey) {
753	      currentRoute.binding = revoked ? undefined : binding ?? undefined;
754	    }
755	    const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
756	    if (live) refreshRelayStatusesSoon(live);
757	  }

781	  async function promptPairingApproval(ctx: ExtensionContext, identity: RelayPairingIdentity, sessionLabel: string): Promise<PairingApprovalDecision> {
782	    closeConnectQrScreen?.();
783	    closeConnectQrScreen = undefined;
784	    if (!ctx.hasUI) return "deny";
785	    const channel = identity.channel ?? "telegram";
786	    const label = pairingIdentityLabel(identity);
787	    const userId = pairingIdentityUserId(identity);
788	    const details = [
789	      `Allow ${label} to control ${sessionLabel}?`,
790	      `Messenger: ${channel}`,
791	      `User ID: ${userId}`,
792	      identity.conversationKind ? `Conversation: ${identity.conversationKind}` : undefined,
793	    ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
794	    const approved = await ctx.ui.confirm(`${channelLabel(channel)} Pairing Request`, details);
795	    if (!approved) return "deny";
796	    const trust = await ctx.ui.confirm("Trust relay user?", `Trust ${label} (${channel} ${userId}) so future fresh pairing codes can skip local confirmation on this machine?`);

819	  async function sendApprovalRequest(record: ApprovalRequestRecord, config: TelegramTunnelConfig): Promise<void> {
820	    const requester = record.requester;
821	    const text = renderApprovalRequest(record, approvalConfig(config));
822	    if (requester.channel === "telegram") {
823	      const adapter = new TelegramChannelAdapter(config);
824	      await adapter.sendText({ channel: "telegram", conversationId: requester.conversationId, userId: requester.userId }, text, {
825	        buttons: approvalButtonsForConfig(record, config),
826	      });
827	      return;
828	    }
829	    if (requester.channel === "discord") {
830	      const discord = discordRuntimes.get(requester.instanceId) as unknown as { sendApprovalRequestToRequester?: (requester: NonNullable<SessionRoute["remoteRequester"]>, text: string, buttons: ReturnType<typeof approvalButtonsForConfig>) => Promise<void> } | undefined;
831	      if (!discord?.sendApprovalRequestToRequester) throw new Error("Discord approval delivery is not available for this instance.");
832	      await discord.sendApprovalRequestToRequester(requester, text, approvalButtonsForConfig(record, config));
833	      return;
834	    }
835	    if (requester.channel === "slack") {
836	      const slack = slackRuntimes.get(requester.instanceId) as unknown as { sendApprovalRequestToRequester?: (requester: NonNullable<SessionRoute["remoteRequester"]>, text: string, buttons: ReturnType<typeof approvalButtonsForConfig>) => Promise<void> } | undefined;
837	      if (!slack?.sendApprovalRequestToRequester) throw new Error("Slack approval delivery is not available for this instance.");
838	      await slack.sendApprovalRequestToRequester(requester, text, approvalButtonsForConfig(record, config));
839	      return;
840	    }
841	    throw new Error(`Approval delivery is not supported for ${requester.channel}.`);
842	  }

848	  async function awaitApprovalDecision(record: ApprovalRequestRecord, timeoutMs: number): Promise<ApprovalDecisionResult> {
849	    const timeout = new Promise<ApprovalDecisionResult>((resolve) => {
850	      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
851	        pendingApprovalResolvers.delete(record.approvalId);
852	        resolve({ ok: false, status: "expired", message: "Approval expired; operation blocked." });
853	      }, timeoutMs);
854	      pendingApprovalResolvers.set(record.approvalId, (result) => {
855	        clearTimeout(timer);
856	        resolve(result);
857	      });
858	    });
859	    return timeout;
860	  }
861	
862	  async function resolveApprovalDecision(route: SessionRoute, decision: ApprovalDecisionRequest): Promise<ApprovalDecisionResult> {
863	    const config = configCache;
864	    const store = approvalStore(config);
865	    if (!route || !config || !store) return { ok: false, status: "stale", message: "Approval target is offline or stale." };
866	    const request = await store.getApprovalRequest(decision.approvalId);
867	    if (!request || request.sessionKey !== route.sessionKey) return { ok: false, status: "stale", message: "Approval request is stale." };
868	    if (request.status !== "pending") return { ok: false, status: request.status === "denied" ? "denied" : request.status === "approved" ? "approved" : "stale", message: "Approval request is no longer pending." };
869	    if (Date.parse(request.expiresAt) <= Date.now()) {
870	      await store.updateApprovalRequest(request.approvalId, (current) => ({ ...current, status: "expired", resolvedAt: toIsoNow(), decision: "deny" }));
871	      await appendApprovalAudit(config, { kind: "expired", approvalId: request.approvalId, sessionKey: request.sessionKey, sessionLabel: request.sessionLabel, toolName: request.toolName, category: request.category, matcherFingerprint: request.matcherFingerprint, requester: request.requester, summary: request.safeSummary, expiresAt: request.expiresAt });
872	      return { ok: false, status: "expired", message: "Approval request expired." };
873	    }
874	    if (!requesterMatchesDecision(request, decision)) return { ok: false, status: "unauthorized", message: "This identity cannot approve that operation." };
875	    const active = await approvalRequesterBindingIsActive(route, request.requester, store);
876	    if (!active) return { ok: false, status: "unauthorized", message: "Approval binding is no longer active." };
877	
878	    if (decision.decision === "deny") {
879	      await store.updateApprovalRequest(request.approvalId, (current) => ({ ...current, status: "denied", resolvedAt: toIsoNow(), resolvedBy: decision.userId, decision: decision.decision }));
880	      await appendApprovalAudit(config, { kind: "denied", approvalId: request.approvalId, sessionKey: request.sessionKey, sessionLabel: request.sessionLabel, toolName: request.toolName, category: request.category, matcherFingerprint: request.matcherFingerprint, requester: request.requester, summary: request.safeSummary });
881	      const result = { ok: false, status: "denied" as const, message: "Approval denied; operation blocked." };
882	      pendingApprovalResolvers.get(request.approvalId)?.(result);
883	      pendingApprovalResolvers.delete(request.approvalId);
884	      return result;
885	    }
886	
887	    const resolved = approvalConfig(config);
888	    const statusMessage = decision.decision === "approve-session" ? "Approved for this session." : decision.decision === "approve-persistent" ? "Persistent approval granted." : "Approved once.";
889	    if (decision.decision === "approve-session" || decision.decision === "approve-persistent") {
890	      const scope = decision.decision === "approve-session" ? "session" : "persistent";
891	      if (scope === "persistent" && !resolved.allowRemotePersistentGrants) return { ok: false, status: "unauthorized", message: "Remote persistent grants are disabled." };
892	      if (scope === "session" && !resolved.sessionGrants) return { ok: false, status: "unauthorized", message: "Session grants are disabled." };
893	      const grant = createApprovalGrant({ scope, record: request, createdBy: decision.userId, ttlMs: scope === "session" ? resolved.sessionGrantTtlMs : resolved.persistentGrantTtlMs });
894	      await store.upsertApprovalGrant(grant);
895	      await appendApprovalAudit(config, { kind: scope === "session" ? "approved-for-session" : "persistent-grant-created", approvalId: request.approvalId, grantId: grant.grantId, sessionKey: request.sessionKey, sessionLabel: request.sessionLabel, toolName: request.toolName, category: request.category, matcherFingerprint: request.matcherFingerprint, requester: request.requester, summary: request.safeSummary, expiresAt: grant.expiresAt });
896	    } else {
897	      await appendApprovalAudit(config, { kind: "approved-once", approvalId: request.approvalId, sessionKey: request.sessionKey, sessionLabel: request.sessionLabel, toolName: request.toolName, category: request.category, matcherFingerprint: request.matcherFingerprint, requester: request.requester, summary: request.safeSummary });
898	    }
899	    await store.updateApprovalRequest(request.approvalId, (current) => ({ ...current, status: "approved", resolvedAt: toIsoNow(), resolvedBy: decision.userId, decision: decision.decision }));
900	    const result = { ok: true, status: "approved" as const, message: statusMessage };
901	    pendingApprovalResolvers.get(request.approvalId)?.(result);
902	    pendingApprovalResolvers.delete(request.approvalId);
903	    return result;
904	  }
905	
906	  function requesterMatchesDecision(request: ApprovalRequestRecord, decision: ApprovalDecisionRequest): boolean {
907	    return request.requester.channel === decision.channel
908	      && request.requester.instanceId === (decision.instanceId ?? "default")
909	      && request.requester.conversationId === decision.conversationId
910	      && request.requester.userId === decision.userId
911	      && (request.requester.threadId ?? "") === (decision.threadId ?? "");
912	  }

914	  async function approvalRequesterBindingIsActive(route: SessionRoute, requester: NonNullable<SessionRoute["remoteRequester"]>, store: TunnelStateStore): Promise<boolean> {
915	    if (requester.channel === "telegram") {
916	      const binding = await store.getActiveBindingForSession(route.sessionKey, { chatId: Number(requester.conversationId), userId: Number(requester.userId) });
917	      return Boolean(binding && !binding.paused);
918	    }
919	    const binding = await store.getActiveChannelBindingForSession(requester.channel, route.sessionKey, { instanceId: requester.instanceId, conversationId: requester.conversationId, userId: requester.userId });
920	    return Boolean(binding && !binding.paused);

923	  function attachCommandContextToRoute(ctx: ExtensionCommandContext, route = currentRoute): void {
924	    if (!route) return;
925	    try {
926	      const routeWorkspace = route.actions.getWorkspaceRoot?.() ?? route.actions.context.cwd;
927	      if (safeSessionKeyForContext(ctx) !== route.sessionKey || normalizeWorkspaceRoot(ctx.cwd) !== normalizeWorkspaceRoot(routeWorkspace)) return;
928	    } catch {
929	      return;
930	    }
931	    latestCommandContext = ctx;
932	    route.actions.newSession = async (requester) => {
933	      const commandContext = latestCommandContext;
934	      if (commandContext !== ctx) throw routeUnavailableError();
935	      const handoff = await preparePendingHandoff(route, requester ? "remote-new" : "local-new", requester);
936	      if (requester && !handoff) throw routeUnavailableError("The selected relay binding is no longer active. Use /sessions to choose an online session.");
937	      const parentSession = route.sessionFile;
938	      try {
939	        const result = await commandContext.newSession({
940	          ...(parentSession ? { parentSession } : {}),
941	          withSession: async (replacementContext) => {
942	            latestContext = replacementContext;
943	            attachCommandContextToRoute(replacementContext);
944	          },
945	        });
946	        if (result.cancelled && handoff) removePendingSessionHandoffsForSession(route.sessionKey);
947	        return { cancelled: result.cancelled };
948	      } catch (error) {
949	        if (handoff) removePendingSessionHandoffsForSession(route.sessionKey);
950	        throw error;
951	      }
952	    };
953	  }

955	  function buildRoute(ctx: ExtensionContext, binding?: TelegramBindingMetadata, explicitLabel?: string): SessionRoute {
956	    const sessionId = ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId();
957	    const sessionFile = ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile();
958	    const sessionLabel = binding?.sessionLabel ?? deriveSessionLabel({
959	      explicitLabel,
960	      sessionName: ctx.sessionManager.getSessionName(),
961	      cwd: ctx.cwd,
962	      sessionFile,
963	      sessionId,
964	    });
965	    const route: SessionRoute = {
966	      sessionKey: sessionKeyOf(sessionId, sessionFile),
967	      sessionId,
968	      sessionFile,
969	      sessionLabel,
970	      binding,
971	      lastActivityAt: Date.now(),
972	      notification: { lastStatus: "idle" },
973	      actions: {
974	        context: ctx,
975	        isIdle: () => routeIsIdle(route),
976	        getWorkspaceRoot: () => routeWorkspaceRoot(route),
977	        getModel: () => {
978	          const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
979	          try {
980	            return live?.model;
981	          } catch (error) {
982	            if (isStaleExtensionReferenceError(error)) {
983	              invalidateLiveContextForRoute(route);
984	              return undefined;
985	            }
986	            throw error;
987	          }
988	        },
989	        summarizeText: async (text, mode) => summarizeForTelegram(text, mode, liveContextForRoute(route), () => invalidateLiveContextForRoute(route)),
990	        sendUserMessage: (text, options) => {
991	          const requester = route.remoteRequester;
992	          if (!liveContextForRoute(route)) {
993	            route.remoteRequesterPendingTurn = false;
994	            route.remoteRequesterActiveTurn = false;
995	            if (requester && route.remoteRequester === requester) route.remoteRequester = undefined;
996	            throw routeUnavailableError();
997	          }
998	          try {
999	            pi.sendUserMessage(text, options);
1000	          } catch (error) {
1001	            route.remoteRequesterPendingTurn = false;
1002	            route.remoteRequesterActiveTurn = false;
1003	            if (requester && route.remoteRequester === requester) route.remoteRequester = undefined;
1004	            if (isStaleExtensionReferenceError(error)) {
1005	              invalidateLiveContextForRoute(route);
1006	              throw routeUnavailableError();
1007	            }
1008	            throw error;
1009	          }
1010	          if (requester) route.remoteRequesterPendingTurn = true;
1011	        },
1012	        getLatestImages: () => getLatestImagesForTelegram(route),
1013	        getImageByPath: async (relativePath) => {
1014	          const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
1015	          if (!live) return { ok: false, error: unavailableRouteMessage() };
1016	          const turnId = route.notification.lastTurnId ?? createTurnId();
1017	          return loadImagePathForTelegram(live, relativePath, turnId, 0, route);
1018	        },
1019	        getSkillCommands: () => {
1020	          const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
1021	          if (!live) return [];
1022	          try {
1023	            return pi.getCommands().filter((command) => command.source === "skill");
1024	          } catch (error) {
1025	            if (isStaleExtensionReferenceError(error)) {
1026	              invalidateLiveContextForRoute(route);
1027	              return [];
1028	            }
1029	            throw error;
1030	          }
1031	        },
1032	        appendAudit: (message) => appendAudit(message, route),
1033	        notifyLocal: (message, level = "info") => {
1034	          const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
1035	          if (!live) return;
1036	          closeConnectQrScreen?.();
1037	          closeConnectQrScreen = undefined;
1038	          safeNotifyLocal(message, level, route);
1039	          refreshRelayStatusesSoon(live);
1040	        },
1041	        setLocalStatus: (key, value) => {
1042	          const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
1043	          if (!live) return;
1044	          if (key === "relay-binding-authority") {
1045	            relayStatusDiagnostics.set(key, value);
1046	            safeSetStatus(key, relayStatusIcon(live, "relay ⚠", "warning"), live);
1047	            return;
1048	          }
1049	          safeSetStatus(key, value, live);
1050	        },
1051	        clearLocalStatus: (key) => {
1052	          const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
1053	          if (!live) return;
1054	          clearStatus(key, live);
1055	        },
1056	        refreshLocalStatus: () => {
1057	          const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
1058	          if (!live) return;
1059	          refreshRelayStatusesSoon(live);
1060	        },
1061	        persistBinding: (binding, revoked) => persistBinding(binding, revoked, route),
1062	        promptLocalConfirmation: async (identity) => {
1063	          const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
1064	          if (!live) return "deny";
1065	          try {
1066	            return await promptPairingApproval(live, identity, route.sessionLabel);
1067	          } catch (error) {
1068	            if (isStaleExtensionReferenceError(error)) {
1069	              invalidateLiveContextForRoute(route);
1070	              return "deny";
1071	            }
1072	            throw error;
1073	          }
1074	        },
1075	        abort: () => {
1076	          const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
1077	          if (!live) throw routeUnavailableError();
1078	          try {
1079	            live.abort();
1080	          } catch (error) {
1081	            if (isStaleExtensionReferenceError(error)) {
1082	              invalidateLiveContextForRoute(route);
1083	              throw routeUnavailableError();
1084	            }
1085	            throw error;
1086	          }
1087	        },
1088	        resolveApprovalDecision: (decision) => resolveApprovalDecision(route, decision),
1089	        compact: () =>
1090	          new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
1091	            const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
1092	            if (!live) {
1093	              reject(routeUnavailableError());
1094	              return;
1095	            }
1096	            try {
1097	              live.compact({
1098	                onComplete: () => resolve(),
1099	                onError: (error) => {
1100	                  if (isStaleExtensionReferenceError(error)) {
1101	                    invalidateLiveContextForRoute(route);
1102	                    reject(routeUnavailableError());
1103	                    return;
1104	                  }
1105	                  reject(error);
1106	                },
1107	              });
1108	            } catch (error) {
1109	              if (isStaleExtensionReferenceError(error)) {
1110	                invalidateLiveContextForRoute(route);
1111	                reject(routeUnavailableError());
1112	                return;
1113	              }
1114	              reject(error);
1115	            }
1116	          }),
1117	      },
1118	    };
1119	    if (latestCommandContext) attachCommandContextToRoute(latestCommandContext, route);
1120	    return route;
1121	  }

1123	  async function publishRouteState(): Promise<void> {
1124	    const route = currentRoute;
1125	    if (!route) return;
1126	    const registrations: Array<Promise<void>> = [];
1127	    if (runtime) registrations.push(runtime.registerRoute(route));
1128	    registrations.push(...[...discordRuntimes.values()].map((discord) => discord.registerRoute(route)));
1129	    registrations.push(...[...slackRuntimes.values()].map((slack) => slack.registerRoute(route)));
1130	    await Promise.all(registrations);
1131	    const live = liveContextForRoute(route);
1132	    if (live) clearStatus("relay-sync", live);
1133	    if (live) await refreshRelayStatuses(live).catch((error) => {
1134	      if (isStaleExtensionReferenceError(error)) {
1135	        if (latestContext === live) latestContext = undefined;
1136	        return;
1137	      }
1138	      throw error;
1139	    });
1140	  }

1142	  function publishRouteStateSoon(): void {
1143	    void publishRouteState().catch((error) => {
1144	      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
1145	      safeSetStatus("relay-sync", `telegram sync error: ${redactSecrets(message)}`);
1146	    });
1147	  }

1149	  async function notifyTelegramLifecycle(config: TelegramTunnelConfig, route: SessionRoute, kind: RelayLifecycleEventKind): Promise<void> {
1150	    if (!runtime || !route.binding) return;
1151	    const store = new TunnelStateStore(config.stateDir);
1152	    const outcome = resolveTelegramBindingAuthority(
1153	      await store.loadBindingAuthoritySnapshot(),
1154	      { sessionKey: route.sessionKey, chatId: route.binding.chatId, userId: route.binding.userId, includePaused: true, allowVolatileFallback: true },
1155	      route.binding,
1156	    );
1157	    const binding = authorityOutcomeAllowsDelivery(outcome) ? outcome.binding : undefined;
1158	    if (!binding || binding.paused) return;
1159	    const decision = await store.recordLifecycleNotification({
1160	      channel: "telegram",
1161	      instanceId: "default",
1162	      sessionKey: route.sessionKey,
1163	      conversationId: String(binding.chatId),
1164	      userId: String(binding.userId),
1165	      kind,
1166	    });
1167	    if (!decision.shouldNotify) return;
1168	    await runtime.sendToBoundChat(route.sessionKey, formatRelayLifecycleNotification({ kind, sessionLabel: route.sessionLabel, channel: "telegram" }));
1169	    await store.markLifecycleNotificationDelivered({
1170	      channel: "telegram",
1171	      instanceId: "default",
1172	      sessionKey: route.sessionKey,
1173	      conversationId: String(binding.chatId),
1174	      userId: String(binding.userId),
1175	      kind,
1176	    });
1177	  }

1179	  async function notifyRelayLifecycle(ctx: ExtensionContext, kind: RelayLifecycleEventKind, route = currentRoute, onlyStarted?: { telegram?: boolean; discordInstances?: Set<string>; slackInstances?: Set<string> }): Promise<void> {
1180	    if (!route) return;
1181	    let config: TelegramTunnelConfig;
1182	    try {
1183	      config = await ensureConfig(ctx, false);
1184	    } catch {
1185	      return;
1186	    }
1187	    const deliveries: Array<{ label: string; delivery: Promise<void> | undefined }> = [];
1188	    if (onlyStarted?.telegram ?? true) deliveries.push({ label: "telegram", delivery: notifyTelegramLifecycle(config, route, kind) });
1189	    for (const [instanceId, discord] of discordRuntimes) {
1190	      if (onlyStarted?.discordInstances && !onlyStarted.discordInstances.has(instanceId)) continue;
1191	      deliveries.push({ label: instanceId === "default" ? "discord" : `discord:${instanceId}`, delivery: discord.notifyLifecycle?.(route, kind) });
1192	    }
1193	    for (const [instanceId, slack] of slackRuntimes) {
1194	      if (onlyStarted?.slackInstances && !onlyStarted.slackInstances.has(instanceId)) continue;
1195	      deliveries.push({ label: instanceId === "default" ? "slack" : `slack:${instanceId}`, delivery: slack.notifyLifecycle?.(route, kind) });
1196	    }
1197	    const results = await Promise.allSettled(deliveries.filter((item): item is { label: string; delivery: Promise<void> } => Boolean(item.delivery)).map((item) => withLifecycleNotificationTimeout(item.label, item.delivery)));
1198	    const rejected = results.find((result): result is PromiseRejectedResult => result.status === "rejected");
1199	    if (rejected) {
1200	      const message = redactSecrets(rejected.reason instanceof Error ? rejected.reason.message : String(rejected.reason));
1201	      relayStatusDiagnostics.set("relay-lifecycle", `lifecycle: ${message}`);
1202	      safeSetStatus("relay-lifecycle", relayStatusIcon(ctx, "relay ⚠", "warning"), ctx);
1203	    } else {
1204	      clearStatus("relay-lifecycle", ctx);
1205	    }
1206	  }

1208	  async function restoreBinding(ctx: ExtensionContext, config: TelegramTunnelConfig, preferPersisted = false): Promise<TelegramBindingMetadata | undefined> {
1209	    if (preferPersisted) {
1210	      const sessionKey = sessionKeyOf(ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId(), ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile());
1211	      const migrated = await new TunnelStateStore(config.stateDir).getBindingBySessionKey(sessionKey);
1212	      if (migrated?.status === "active") {
1213	        volatileTelegramBindings.set(sessionKey, migrated);
1214	        return migrated;
1215	      }
1216	    }
1217	    let latest: BindingEntryData | undefined;
1218	    for (const entry of ctx.sessionManager.getBranch()) {
1219	      if (entry.type === "custom" && (entry.customType === BINDING_ENTRY_TYPE || entry.customType === LEGACY_BINDING_ENTRY_TYPE)) {
1220	        latest = entry.data as BindingEntryData;
1221	      }
1222	    }
1223	    const sessionKey = sessionKeyOf(ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId(), ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile());
1224	    if (latest?.revoked) {
1225	      volatileTelegramBindings.delete(sessionKey);
1226	      return undefined;
1227	    }
1228	    if (latest?.binding) {
1229	      volatileTelegramBindings.set(sessionKey, latest.binding);
1230	      return latest.binding;
1231	    }
1232	    const volatile = volatileTelegramBindings.get(sessionKey);
1233	    if (volatile) return volatile;
1234	
1235	    const store = new TunnelStateStore(config.stateDir);
1236	    const localBinding = await store.getBindingBySessionKey(sessionKey);
1237	    if (!localBinding || localBinding.status === "revoked") return undefined;
1238	    return localBinding;
1239	  }

1241	  async function preparePendingHandoff(route: SessionRoute, reason: SessionHandoffReason, remoteRequester?: RelayFileDeliveryRequester): Promise<PendingSessionHandoff | undefined> {
1242	    const config = configCache;
1243	    if (!config) return undefined;
1244	    const data = await new TunnelStateStore(config.stateDir).load();
1245	    const bindings = bindingSummariesForSession(data, route.sessionKey);
1246	    if (bindings.length === 0) return undefined;
1247	    const requester = reason === "remote-new" && remoteRequester
1248	      ? bindings.find((binding) => binding.channel === remoteRequester.channel
1249	        && binding.instanceId === remoteRequester.instanceId
1250	        && binding.conversationId === remoteRequester.conversationId
1251	        && binding.userId === remoteRequester.userId)
1252	      : undefined;
1253	    if (reason === "remote-new" && !requester) return undefined;
1254	    const handoff = createPendingSessionHandoff({
1255	      oldSessionKey: route.sessionKey,
1256	      oldSessionId: route.sessionId,
1257	      oldSessionFile: route.sessionFile,
1258	      oldSessionLabel: route.sessionLabel,
1259	      runtimeInstanceId: relayRuntimeInstanceId,
1260	      machineId: config.machineId ?? "local",
1261	      workspaceRoot: route.actions.getWorkspaceRoot?.() ?? route.actions.context.cwd,
1262	      reason,
1263	      requester,
1264	      bindings,
1265	      activeSelections: activeSelectionsForSession(data, route.sessionKey),
1266	    });
1267	    registerPendingSessionHandoff(handoff, async () => {
1268	      const deliveries: Array<Promise<void> | undefined> = [notifyTelegramLifecycle(config, route, "offline")];
1269	      for (const discord of discordRuntimes.values()) deliveries.push(discord.notifyLifecycle?.(route, "offline"));
1270	      for (const slack of slackRuntimes.values()) deliveries.push(slack.notifyLifecycle?.(route, "offline"));
1271	      await Promise.allSettled(deliveries.filter((delivery): delivery is Promise<void> => Boolean(delivery)));
1272	    });
1273	    return handoff;
1274	  }

1276	  async function syncRoute(ctx: ExtensionContext): Promise<void> {
1277	    latestContext = ctx;
1278	    let config: TelegramTunnelConfig;
1279	    try {
1280	      config = await ensureConfig();
1281	    } catch (error) {
1282	      currentRoute = undefined;
1283	      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
1284	      safeSetStatus("relay", `relay config error: ${redactSecrets(message)}`, ctx);
1285	      return;
1286	    }
1287	
1288	    const nextSessionId = ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId();
1289	    const nextSessionFile = ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile();
1290	    const nextSessionKey = sessionKeyOf(nextSessionId, nextSessionFile);
1291	    const handoffMatch = findPendingSessionHandoff({
1292	      sessionKey: nextSessionKey,
1293	      runtimeInstanceId: relayRuntimeInstanceId,
1294	      machineId: config.machineId ?? "local",
1295	      workspaceRoot: ctx.cwd,
1296	    });
1297	    completedHandoff = undefined;
1298	    if (handoffMatch.kind === "matched") {
1299	      const previewRoute = buildRoute(ctx);
1300	      const migration = await new TunnelStateStore(config.stateDir).migrateSessionBindings({
1301	        oldSessionKey: handoffMatch.handoff.oldSessionKey,
1302	        newSessionKey: nextSessionKey,
1303	        newSessionId: nextSessionId,
1304	        newSessionFile: nextSessionFile,
1305	        newSessionLabel: previewRoute.sessionLabel,
1306	        requester: handoffMatch.handoff.reason === "remote-new" && handoffMatch.handoff.requester
1307	          ? handoffMatch.handoff.requester
1308	          : undefined,
1309	      });
1310	      if (migration.telegram.length > 0 || migration.channels.length > 0) {
1311	        removePendingSessionHandoff(handoffMatch.handoff.id);
1312	        completedHandoff = handoffMatch.handoff;
1313	      }
1314	    }
1315	
1316	    const restoredBinding = await restoreBinding(ctx, config, Boolean(completedHandoff));
1317	    const previousSessionKey = currentRoute?.sessionKey;
1318	    const nextRoute = buildRoute(ctx, restoredBinding);
1319	    if (nextRoute.sessionKey !== previousSessionKey) clearTurnImageCaches();
1320	    currentRoute = nextRoute;
1321	    const startedDiscordInstances = new Set<string>();
1322	    const startedSlackInstances = new Set<string>();
1323	    await ensureAllDiscordRuntimes();
1324	    for (const [instanceId, discord] of discordRuntimes) {
1325	      await discord.registerRoute(currentRoute);
1326	      if (await startDiscordRuntime(ctx, discord, false, instanceId)) startedDiscordInstances.add(instanceId);
1327	    }
1328	    await ensureAllSlackRuntimes();
1329	    for (const [instanceId, slack] of slackRuntimes) {
1330	      await slack.registerRoute(currentRoute);
1331	      if (await startSlackRuntime(ctx, slack, false, instanceId)) startedSlackInstances.add(instanceId);
1332	    }
1333	    let telegramStarted = false;
1334	    try {
1335	      runtime = await ensureRuntime();
1336	      await runtime.registerRoute(currentRoute);
1337	      telegramRuntimeStatus = { enabled: Boolean(config.botToken), started: true };
1338	      telegramStarted = true;
1339	      clearStatus("relay-sync", ctx);
1340	    } catch (error) {
1341	      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
1342	      telegramRuntimeStatus = { enabled: Boolean(config.botToken), started: false, error: message };
1343	      safeSetStatus("relay-sync", `telegram sync error: ${redactSecrets(message)}`, ctx);
1344	    }
1345	    await refreshRelayStatuses(ctx).catch((error) => {
1346	      if (isStaleExtensionReferenceError(error)) {
1347	        if (latestContext === ctx) latestContext = undefined;
1348	        return;
1349	      }
1350	      throw error;
1351	    });
1352	    await notifyRelayLifecycle(ctx, completedHandoff ? "moved" : "online", currentRoute, { telegram: telegramStarted, discordInstances: startedDiscordInstances, slackInstances: startedSlackInstances });
1353	  }

1502	  async function handleRelayRestart(ctx: ExtensionContext): Promise<void> {
1503	    await ensureRuntime(ctx, false);
1504	    const stopped = await stopAndClearRuntimes(ctx, { restartBrokerProcess: true });
1505	    configCache = undefined;
1506	    await resetStoppedRuntimeStatuses(ctx, stopped);
1507	    await syncRoute(ctx);
1508	    const convergence = stopped.brokerRestartResult || undefined;
1509	    const restartMessage = convergence
1510	      ? convergence.status === "complete"
1511	        ? `Shared PiRelay broker restarted; recovered ${convergence.connectedClientCount}/${convergence.expectedClientCount} client(s) and ${convergence.registeredRouteCount} route(s).`
1512	        : convergence.status === "failed"
1513	          ? "Shared PiRelay broker restart failed safely; automatic recovery remains active. Use /relay doctor if this session stays offline."
1514	          : convergence.status === "in-progress"
1515	            ? "A shared PiRelay broker restart is already in progress; active sessions will reconnect automatically."
1516	            : `Shared PiRelay broker restart reached a partial timeout: recovered ${convergence.connectedClientCount}/${convergence.expectedClientCount} client(s) and ${convergence.registeredRouteCount} route(s). Other live sessions will keep retrying automatically; use /relay doctor locally if one remains offline.`
1517	      : stopped.brokerRestarted ? "Shared PiRelay broker and runtimes restarted for this session." : "PiRelay runtimes restarted for this session.";
1518	    ctx.ui.notify(restartMessage, convergence && convergence.status !== "complete" ? "warning" : "info");
1519	  }
