```text
{"body":"## Bug\n\nOn `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` \u003e= 0.83, every processed Discord message fails with:\n\n```\n{\"level\":50,...,\"err\":\"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'getAvailableSnapshot')\",\"msg\":\"processMessage failed\"}\n```\n\nThe bot still sends an `⚠️ Internal error: ...` reply to Discord for each message.\n\n## Root cause\n\n`src/agent/model-catalog.ts` constructs the model registry like this:\n\n```ts\nfunction createModelRegistry(authStorage: AuthStorage): ModelRegistry {\n  const registryClass = ModelRegistry as unknown as {\n    create?: (authStorage: AuthStorage) =\u003e ModelRegistry;\n    new (authStorage: AuthStorage): ModelRegistry;\n  };\n  if (typeof registryClass.create === 'function') {\n    return registryClass.create(authStorage);\n  }\n  return new registryClass(authStorage);\n}\n```\n\npi-coding-agent 0.83 made two breaking changes that both break this path:\n\n1. **`ModelRegistry.create()` was removed.** The `ModelRegistry` constructor now takes a `ModelRuntime` (not an `AuthStorage`). So `new ModelRegistry(authStorage)` sets `this.runtime = undefined`, and the very next call `registry.getAvailable()` -\u003e `this.runtime.getAvailableSnapshot()` throws the error above.\n2. **`AuthStorage` is no longer exported** from the package root (only `readStoredCredential` is). So `import { AuthStorage } from '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent'` now throws a `SyntaxError` at module load — meaning a fresh process restart fails even earlier than the `getAvailableSnapshot` error (the currently-running error is from a process that still has the old, pre-upgrade modules cached in memory).\n\nA secondary issue: `loadModelCatalog` calls `registry.refresh()` fire-and-forget. With the new runtime, `ModelRuntime.refresh()` reloads config, rebuilds providers, and runs availability/auth checks against every provider (network calls). `ModelRuntime.create()` already does an initial refresh, so this is redundant, wasteful on a 30s cache TTL per cwd, and any rejection becomes an unhandled promise rejection.\n\n## Why CI didn't catch it\n\n`test/model-catalog.test.ts` mocks `vi.spyOn(ModelRegistry, 'create')` and `vi.spyOn(AuthStorage, 'create')`, so the tests exercise neither the real construction path nor the real exports.\n\n## Environment\n\n- piscord 1.7.0\n- `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` 0.83.0\n- Node v25.x\n\nI have a fix incoming in a linked PR.","comments":[],"createdAt":"2026-07-30T11:32:21Z","title":"processMessage fails with \"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'getAvailableSnapshot')\" on pi-coding-agent 0.83","url":"https://github.com/Crokily/pi-discord-gateway/issues/14"}
```
</details></tool-use>

See error immediately before any prompt appears\n\n## Expected behavior\n\nSetup wizard starts and prompts for Discord bot token.\n\n## Actual behavior\n\n```\nError: The requested module '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent' does not provide an export named 'AuthStorage'\n```\n\nCrash origin: `dist/agent/model-catalog.js:2`\n```js\nimport { AuthStorage, ModelRegistry, SettingsManager } from '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent';\n```\n\n## Package version\n\n`piscord@1.7.0` / `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@0.84.2`\n\n## Node.js version\n\nv26.7.0\n\n## OS\n\nmacOS 15.7.9\nmacOS\n\n## Additional context\n\n`AuthStorage` class still exists in `dist/core/auth-storage.js` internally but is **not re-exported** from `dist/index.js`. 94	function unquoteEnvValue(value: string): string {
95		const trimmed = value.trim();
96		if (trimmed.length >= 2) {
97			const quote = trimmed[0];
98			if (
99				(quote === '"' || quote === "'") &&
100				trimmed[trimmed.length - 1] === quote
101			) {
102				return trimmed.slice(1, -1).replace(/\\n/g, "\n").replace(/\\r/g, "\r");
103			}
104		}
105		return trimmed;
106	}
107	
108	function parseDotEnvLine(line: string): [string, string] | undefined {
109		const withoutExport = line.trim().replace(/^export\s+/, "");
110		if (!withoutExport || withoutExport.startsWith("#")) return undefined;
111		const eq = withoutExport.indexOf("=");
112		if (eq <= 0) return undefined;
113		const key = withoutExport.slice(0, eq).trim();
114		if (!/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(key)) return undefined;
115	
116		let rawValue = withoutExport.slice(eq + 1).trim();
117		if (!rawValue.startsWith('"') && !rawValue.startsWith("'")) {
118			const comment = rawValue.indexOf(" #");
119			if (comment >= 0) rawValue = rawValue.slice(0, comment).trim();
120		}
121		return [key, unquoteEnvValue(rawValue)];
122	}

139			const [key, value] = parsed;

141		}

250	// Shell-style arg splitter that handles single- and double-quoted tokens.
251	function parseSpawnArgs(raw: string): string[] {
252		const args: string[] = [];
253		let current = "";
254		let inQuote: '"' | "'" | null = null;
255		for (const ch of raw) {
256			if (inQuote) {
257				if (ch === inQuote) inQuote = null;
258				else current += ch;
259			} else if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") {
260				inQuote = ch;
261			} else if (ch === " " || ch === "\t") {
262				if (current) {
263					args.push(current);
264					current = "";
265				}
266			} else {
267				current += ch;
268			}
269		}
270		if (current) args.push(current);
271		return args;
272	}

562				"[discord-bridge] slash command sync skipped: Discord client has no application id yet.",
563			);
564			return;
565		}
566	
567		const guildIds = [...cfg.slashCommandGuildIds].sort();
568		if (guildIds.length === 0) {
569			console.warn(
570				"[discord-bridge] slash command registration requested but PI_DISCORD_SLASH_COMMAND_GUILD_IDS is empty; refusing to register global application commands.",
571			);
572			return;
573		}
574	
575		const commands = collectNativeDiscordCommands();
576		nativeDiscordCommands = new Map(
577			commands.map((command) => [command.discordName, command]),
578		);
579		const payloads = nativeDiscordCommandPayloads(commands);
580		const signature = JSON.stringify({ applicationId, guildIds, payloads });
581		if (nativeDiscordCommandSignature === signature) return;
582	
583		const rest = getDiscordRest(cfg);
584		for (const guildId of guildIds) {
585			await rest.put(Routes.applicationGuildCommands(applicationId, guildId), {
586				body: payloads,
587			});
588		}
589		nativeDiscordCommandSignature = signature;
590	}
591	
592	function scheduleNativeDiscordSlashCommandSync(
593		pi: ExtensionAPI,
594		cfg: Config,
595		c: Client | undefined,
596	): void {
597		if (!c || !cfg.registerSlashCommands) return;
598		if (nativeDiscordCommandSyncInFlight) return;
599		nativeDiscordCommandSyncInFlight = syncNativeDiscordSlashCommands(pi, cfg, c)
600			.catch((err) => {
601				console.error(
602					"[discord-bridge] slash command sync failed:",
603					(err as Error).message,
604				);
605			})
606			.finally(() => {
607				nativeDiscordCommandSyncInFlight = undefined;
608			});
609	}
610	
611	function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
612		return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
613	}
614	
615	function safeJson(value: unknown): string {
616		try {
617			const json = JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
618			return json === undefined ? String(value) : json;
619		} catch {
620			return String(value);
621		}
622	}
623	
624	function parseJsonMaybe(text: string): unknown | undefined {
625		const trimmed = text.trim();
626		if (!trimmed || !/^[{[]/.test(trimmed)) return undefined;
627		try {
628			return JSON.parse(trimmed);
629		} catch {
630			return undefined;
631		}
632	}
633	
634	function isSensitiveKey(key: string): boolean {
635		return /(token|secret|password|passwd|api[_-]?key|authorization|auth|webhook|cookie|private[_-]?key|dsn|database[_-]?url)/i.test(
636			key,
637		);
638	}
639	
640	function escapeRegExp(value: string): string {
641		return value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
642	}
643	
644	function sensitiveEnvValues(): string[] {
645		const values = new Set<string>();
646		for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(process.env)) {
647			const trimmed = value?.trim();
648			if (!trimmed || trimmed.length < 8) continue;
649			if (isSensitiveKey(key) || looksLikeSecret(trimmed)) values.add(trimmed);
650		}
651		return [...values].sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);
652	}
653	
654	function looksLikeSecret(value: string): boolean {
655		return (
656			/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}/.test(value) ||
657			/\b(?:sk|pk|gh[pousr]|xox[baprs])[-_][A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}\b/i.test(value) ||
658			/\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b/.test(value) ||
659			/discord(?:app)?\.com\/api\/webhooks\/\d+\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/i.test(value)
660		);
661	}
662	
663	function redactString(value: string): string {
664		let redacted = value;
665		for (const secret of sensitiveEnvValues()) {
666			redacted = redacted.replace(
667				new RegExp(escapeRegExp(secret), "g"),
668				"<redacted>",
669			);
670		}
671		return redacted
672			.replace(
673				/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}/g,
674				"<redacted-token>",
675			)
676			.replace(
677				/\b(?:sk|pk|gh[pousr]|xox[baprs])[-_][A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}\b/gi,
678				"<redacted-token>",
679			)
680			.replace(/\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b/g, "<redacted-aws-key>")
681			.replace(
682				/discord(?:app)?\.com\/api\/webhooks\/\d+\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/gi,
683				"discord.com/api/webhooks/<redacted>",
684			);
685	}
686	
687	function formatValueForDiscord(key: string, value: unknown): string {
688		if (
689			isSensitiveKey(key) &&
690			value !== undefined &&
691			value !== null &&
692			String(value) !== ""
693		)
694			return "<redacted>";
695		if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") return "(empty)";
696		if (typeof value === "string") {
697			const redacted = redactString(value);
698			return redacted.includes("\n")
699				? clip(redacted, 500)
700				: `"${clip(redacted, 220)}"`;
701		}
702		if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean")
703			return String(value);
704		if (Array.isArray(value)) {
705			const simple = value.every((item) =>
706				["string", "number", "boolean"].includes(typeof item),
707			);
708			if (simple)
709				return (
710					value.map((item) => formatValueForDiscord(key, item)).join(", ") || "[]"
711				);
712			return `[${value.length} item${value.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}]`;
713		}
714		if (isRecord(value))
715			return `{${Object.keys(value).slice(0, 6).join(", ")}${Object.keys(value).length > 6 ? ", …" : ""}}`;
716		return clip(String(value), 220);
717	}
718	
719	function summarizeToolInput(
720		_toolName: string,
721		input: unknown,
722		maxChars: number,
723	): string {
724		if (!isRecord(input))
725			return clip(redactString(safeJson(input ?? {})), maxChars);
726		const preferred = [
727			"query",
728			"queries",
729			"scope",
730			"repo",
731			"branch",
732			"path",
733			"filePath",
734			"url",
735			"urls",
736			"command",
737			"pattern",
738			"lang",
739			"limit",
740			"timeout",
741			"agent",
742			"task",
743			"message",
744		];
745		const keys = [
746			...preferred.filter((key) => key in input),
747			...Object.keys(input).filter((key) => !preferred.includes(key)),
748		].slice(0, 10);
749		if (keys.length === 0) return "No arguments.";
750		const lines = keys.map(
751			(key) => `• **${key}**: ${formatValueForDiscord(key, input[key])}`,
752		);
753		const summary = lines.join("\n");
754		const suffix =
755			Object.keys(input).length > keys.length
756				? "\n• …additional arguments omitted"
757				: "";
758		return clip(summary + suffix, maxChars);
759	}
760	
761	function toolAction(toolName: string): string {
762		const name = toolName.toLowerCase();
763		if (name.includes("memory_graph_search"))
764			return "Searching durable project memory";
765		if (name.includes("memory_graph_remember")) return "Saving a durable memory";
766		if (name === "bash" || name.endsWith(".bash"))
767			return "Running a shell command";
768		if (name === "read" || name.endsWith(".read")) return "Reading a file";
769		if (name === "edit" || name.endsWith(".edit")) return "Editing a file";
770		if (name === "write" || name.endsWith(".write")) return "Writing a file";
771		if (name.includes("web_search")) return "Searching the web";
772		if (name.includes("fetch_content")) return "Fetching web content";
773		if (name.includes("lsp")) return "Querying code intelligence";
774		if (name.includes("ast_grep")) return "Searching code structurally";
775		if (name.includes("subagent")) return "Delegating to a subagent";
776		return "Running tool";
777	}
778	
779	function summarizeMemoryHits(
780		payload: Record<string, unknown>,
781		maxChars: number,
782	): string | undefined {
783		const hits = Array.isArray(payload.hits) ? payload.hits : undefined;
784		if (!hits) return undefined;
785		if (hits.length === 0) return "No matching memories found.";
786		const lines = hits.slice(0, 4).map((hit, index) => {
787			if (!isRecord(hit)) return `• Hit ${index + 1}`;
788			const name =
789				typeof hit.entity_name === "string"
790					? hit.entity_name
791					: `Hit ${index + 1}`;
792			const type =
793				typeof hit.entity_type === "string" ? ` (${hit.entity_type})` : "";
794			const content =
795				typeof hit.content_display === "string"
796					? hit.content_display
797					: typeof hit.content === "string"
798						? hit.content
799						: "";
800			return `• **${clip(redactString(name), 80)}**${type}: ${clip(redactString(content).replace(/\s+/g, " "), 220)}`;
801		});
802		const more =
803			hits.length > 4
804				? `\n• …${hits.length - 4} more hit${hits.length - 4 === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
805				: "";
806		return clip(
807			`Found ${hits.length} memory hit${hits.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}.\n${lines.join("\n")}${more}`,
808			maxChars,
809		);
810	}
811	
812	function summarizeJsonResult(
813		value: unknown,
814		maxChars: number,
815	): string | undefined {
816		if (!isRecord(value)) return undefined;
817		const memory = summarizeMemoryHits(value, maxChars);
818		if (memory) return memory;
819		const lines: string[] = [];
820		for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(value)) {
821			if (isSensitiveKey(key)) continue;
822			if (
823				["content", "text", "stdout", "stderr"].includes(key) &&
824				typeof item === "string"
825			) {
826				const label =
827					key === "stdout" ? "stdout" : key === "stderr" ? "stderr" : key;
828				lines.push(
829					`• **${label}**: ${clip(redactString(item).trim().replace(/\s+/g, " "), 500) || "(empty)"}`,
830				);
831			} else if (Array.isArray(item)) {
832				lines.push(
833					`• **${key}**: ${item.length} item${item.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`,
834				);
835			} else if (isRecord(item)) {
836				lines.push(
837					`• **${key}**: object with ${Object.keys(item).length} key${Object.keys(item).length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`,
838				);
839			} else {
840				lines.push(`• **${key}**: ${formatValueForDiscord(key, item)}`);
841			}
842			if (lines.length >= 8) break;
843		}
844		return lines.length > 0 ? clip(lines.join("\n"), maxChars) : undefined;
845	}
846	
847	function summarizeTextResult(text: string, maxChars: number): string {
848		const lines = redactString(text)
849			.split("\n")
850			.map((line) => line.trim())
851			.filter(Boolean);
852		if (lines.length === 0) return "(empty result)";
853		return clip(lines.slice(0, 10).join("\n"), maxChars);
854	}
855	
856	function summarizeToolResult(
857		_toolName: string,
858		text: string,
859		isError: boolean,
860		maxChars: number,
861	): string {
862		const clean = stripAnsi(text).trim();
863		if (!clean)
864			return isError
865				? "Tool failed without an error message."
866				: "Completed with no text output.";
867		const parsed = parseJsonMaybe(clean);
868		if (parsed !== undefined) {
869			const jsonSummary = summarizeJsonResult(parsed, maxChars);
870			if (jsonSummary) return jsonSummary;
871		}
872		return summarizeTextResult(clean, maxChars);
873	}
874	
875	function formatDuration(ms: number): string {
876		if (!Number.isFinite(ms) || ms < 0) return "—";
877		if (ms < 1000) return `${Math.round(ms)}ms`;
878		if (ms < 60_000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(ms < 10_000 ? 1 : 0)}s`;
879		const minutes = Math.floor(ms / 60_000);
880		const seconds = Math.round((ms % 60_000) / 1000);
881		return seconds === 0 ? `${minutes}m` : `${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;
882	}
883	
884	function toolPayload(
885		cfg: Config,
886		toolName: string,
887		input: unknown,
888		status: "running" | "complete" | "error",
889		resultText?: string,
890		durationMs?: number,
891	): MessageCreateOptions {
892		const isDone = status !== "running";
893		const color =
894			status === "error"
895				? COLOR_TOOL_ERROR
896				: status === "complete"
897					? COLOR_TOOL_SUCCESS
898					: COLOR_TOOL_RUNNING;
899		const icon = status === "error" ? "❌" : status === "complete" ? "✅" : "▶️";
900		const fields: { name: string; value: string; inline: boolean }[] = [
901			{ name: "Action", value: toolAction(toolName), inline: false },
902			{
903				name: "Inputs",
904				value: clip(
905					summarizeToolInput(toolName, input, cfg.toolArgsMaxChars),
906					EMBED_FIELD_MAX_CHARS,
907				),
908				inline: false,
909			},
910		];
911		if (isDone) {
912			fields.push({
913				name: status === "error" ? "Error" : "Result",
914				value: clip(resultText || "Completed.", EMBED_FIELD_MAX_CHARS),
915				inline: false,
916			});
917			if (durationMs !== undefined) {
918				fields.push({
919					name: "Duration",
920					value: formatDuration(durationMs),
921					inline: true,
922				});
923			}
924		}
925		return {
926			content: cfg.prefix ? redactString(cfg.prefix) : undefined,
927			allowedMentions: NO_MENTIONS,
928			embeds: [
929				{
930					title: clip(
931						redactString(
932							`${icon} ${status === "running" ? "Running" : status === "error" ? "Tool failed" : "Tool complete"}: ${toolName}`,
933						),
934						250,
935					),
936					description: `Pi ${status === "running" ? "started" : "finished"} a tool call.`,
937					color,
938					fields,
939					footer: { text: "Pi Discord remote" },
940					timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
941				},
942			],
943		};
944	}
945	
946	class TypingIndicator {
947		private interval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
948		private active = 0;
949	
950		constructor(private readonly relay: DiscordRelay) {}
951	
952		retain(): void {
953			this.active += 1;
954			if (this.interval) return;
955			void this.tick();
956			this.interval = setInterval(() => void this.tick(), 8000);
957		}
958	
959		release(): void {
960			this.active = Math.max(0, this.active - 1);
961			if (this.active === 0) this.stop();
962		}
963	
964		stop(): void {
965			if (this.interval) clearInterval(this.interval);
966			this.interval = undefined;
967			this.active = 0;
968		}
969	
970		private async tick(): Promise<void> {
971			if (this.relay.isMuted()) return;
972			const id = this.relay.getTargetChannelId();
973			if (!id) return;
974			const ch = await this.relay.getChannel(id);
975			if (
976				!ch ||
977				typeof (ch as Partial<TypingCapableChannel>).sendTyping !== "function"
978			)
979				return;
980			try {
981				await (ch as TypingCapableChannel).sendTyping();
982			} catch {
983				/* Discord ratelimit / transient — try again next tick. */
984			}
985		}
986	}
987	
988	class DiscordRelay {
989		private sendQueue: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
990		private streams = new Map<number, StreamBuffer>();
991		private toolMessages = new Map<string, ToolMessageState>();
992		private muted = false;
993		readonly typing = new TypingIndicator(this);
994	
995		constructor(
996			private readonly client: Client,
997			private readonly cfg: Config,
998		) {}
999	
1000		isMuted(): boolean {
1001			return this.muted;
1002		}
1003	
1004		setMuted(muted: boolean): boolean {
1005			const changed = this.muted !== muted;
1006			this.muted = muted;
1007			if (muted) {
1008				this.typing.stop();
1009				for (const stream of this.streams.values()) stream.cancelPending();
1010			}
1011			return changed;
1012		}
1013	
1014		getTargetChannelId(): string {
1015			return this.cfg.activeChannelId || this.cfg.channelId;
1016		}
1017	
1018		setTargetChannelId(channelId: string): void {
1019			this.cfg.activeChannelId = channelId;
1020		}
1021	
1022		async getChannel(id: string): Promise<DiscordChannel | undefined> {
1023			let ch = this.client.channels.cache.get(id) ?? null;
1024			if (!ch) {
1025				ch = await this.client.channels.fetch(id).catch(() => null);
1026			}
1027			if (!ch || !("send" in ch)) return undefined;
1028			return ch as unknown as DiscordChannel;
1029		}
1030	
1031		/**
1032		 * Create a per-session thread inside the *project channel* (not the
1033		 * primary fallback channel). The thread name uses a short 5-char slug
1034		 * of the session ID for readability.
1035		 */
1036		async createSessionThread(sessionId: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
1037			if (!this.cfg.createThreadPerSession) return undefined;
1038	
1039			// Use the active (project) channel if set, otherwise fall back to primary.
1040			const parentId = this.cfg.activeChannelId || this.cfg.channelId;
1041			const parent = await this.getChannel(parentId);
1042			if (!parent || !("threads" in parent)) return undefined;
1043			const threadParent = parent as DiscordThreadCreatableChannel;
1044			const safePrefix =
1045				this.cfg.threadNamePrefix.replace(/[^\w .-]+/g, "-").trim() || "pi";
1046			const slug = sessionSlug(sessionId);
1047			const name = clip(`${safePrefix}-${slug}`, 100);
1048			try {
1049				const thread = await this.serial(() =>
1050					threadParent.threads.create({
1051						name,
1052						autoArchiveDuration: this.cfg.threadAutoArchiveDuration,
1053						reason: "Pi coding agent session started",
1054					}),
1055				);
1056				this.setTargetChannelId(thread.id);
1057				await this.postRaw(
1058					thread.id,
1059					`🧵 Pi session thread created for session \`${slug}\` (full: \`${sessionId}\`).`,
1060				);
1061				return thread.id;
1062			} catch (err) {
1063				console.error(
1064					"[discord-bridge] createSessionThread failed:",
1065					(err as Error).message,
1066				);
1067				return undefined;
1068			}
1069		}
1070	
1071		serial<T>(work: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
1072			const result = this.sendQueue.then(work);
1073			this.sendQueue = result.then(
1074				() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, this.cfg.createIntervalMs)),
1075				() => undefined,
1076			);
1077			return result;
1078		}
1079	
1080		async postRaw(
1081			channelId: string,
1082			text: string,
1083		): Promise<DiscordMessage | undefined> {
1084			if (this.muted) return undefined;
1085			const ch = await this.getChannel(channelId);
1086			if (!ch) return undefined;
1087			const body = clip(
1088				(this.cfg.prefix ? this.cfg.prefix + " " : "") + text,
1089				this.cfg.maxChars,
1090			);
1091			try {
1092				return await this.serial(() => ch.send(textPayload(body)));
1093			} catch (err) {
1094				console.error("[discord-bridge] postRaw failed:", (err as Error).message);
1095				return undefined;
1096			}
1097		}
1098	
1099		async postPayload(
1100			channelId: string,
1101			payload: MessageCreateOptions,
1102		): Promise<DiscordMessage | undefined> {
1103			if (this.muted) return undefined;
1104			const ch = await this.getChannel(channelId);
1105			if (!ch) return undefined;
1106			try {
1107				return await this.serial(() => ch.send(payload));
1108			} catch (err) {
1109				console.error(
1110					"[discord-bridge] postPayload failed:",
1111					(err as Error).message,
1112				);
1113				return undefined;
1114			}
1115		}
1116	
1117		onMessageStart(event: MessageEventLike) {
1118			if (!this.cfg.streamMessages) return;
1119			if (event.message.role !== "assistant") return;
1120			const ts = messageTimestamp(event.message);
1121			if (ts === undefined) return;
1122			if (!this.streams.has(ts)) {
1123				this.streams.set(ts, new StreamBuffer(this, this.cfg));
1124				this.typing.retain();
1125			}
1126		}
1127	
1128		onMessageUpdate(event: MessageEventLike) {
1129			if (!this.cfg.streamMessages) return;
1130			if (event.message.role !== "assistant") return;
1131			const ts = messageTimestamp(event.message);
1132			if (ts === undefined) return;
1133			const text = extractAssistantText(event.message, this.cfg.renderReasoning);
1134			if (!text) return;
1135			const buf = this.streams.get(ts) ?? new StreamBuffer(this, this.cfg);
1136			this.streams.set(ts, buf);
1137			buf.update(stripAnsi(text));
1138		}
1139	
1140		async onMessageEnd(event: MessageEventLike): Promise<boolean> {
1141			if (event.message.role !== "assistant") return false;
1142			const ts = messageTimestamp(event.message);
1143			if (ts === undefined) return false;
1144	
1145			if (this.cfg.streamMessages) {
1146				const buf = this.streams.get(ts);
1147				if (!buf) {
1148					const text = stripAnsi(
1149						extractAssistantText(event.message, this.cfg.renderReasoning),
1150					);
1151					if (!text) return false;
1152					return Boolean(await this.postRaw(this.getTargetChannelId(), text));
1153				}
1154				const sent = await buf.finalize(
1155					stripAnsi(
1156						extractAssistantText(event.message, this.cfg.renderReasoning),
1157					),
1158				);
1159				if (sent) this.streams.delete(ts);
1160				this.typing.release();
1161				return sent;
1162			}
1163	
1164			// Non-streaming: send a single message on completion.
1165			const text = stripAnsi(
1166				extractAssistantText(event.message, this.cfg.renderReasoning),
1167			);
1168			if (!text) return false;
1169			return Boolean(await this.postRaw(this.getTargetChannelId(), text));
1170		}
1171	
1172		async onToolCall(event: ToolCallEvent) {
1173			if (!this.cfg.renderToolCalls) return;
1174			const startedAt = Date.now();
1175			const payload = toolPayload(
1176				this.cfg,
1177				event.toolName,
1178				event.input ?? {},
1179				"running",
1180			);
1181			const msg = await this.postPayload(this.getTargetChannelId(), payload);
1182			this.toolMessages.set(event.toolCallId, {
1183				toolName: event.toolName,
1184				input: event.input ?? {},
1185				msg,
1186				startedAt,
1187			});
1188		}
1189	
1190		async onToolResult(event: ToolResultEvent) {
1191			const entry = this.toolMessages.get(event.toolCallId);
1192			this.toolMessages.delete(event.toolCallId);
1193			if (!this.cfg.renderToolResults) return;
1194			const text = extractTextContent(event.content);
1195			const toolName = entry?.toolName ?? event.toolCallId;
1196			const input = entry?.input ?? {};
1197			const durationMs = entry ? Date.now() - entry.startedAt : undefined;
1198			const result = summarizeToolResult(
1199				toolName,
1200				text,
1201				event.isError,
1202				this.cfg.toolResultMaxChars,
1203			);
1204			const payload = toolPayload(
1205				this.cfg,
1206				toolName,
1207				input,
1208				event.isError ? "error" : "complete",
1209				result,
1210				durationMs,
1211			);
1212			if (entry?.msg) {
1213				if (this.muted) return;
1214				try {
1215					await entry.msg.edit(payload as MessageEditOptions);
1216				} catch (err) {
1217					console.error(
1218						"[discord-bridge] tool result edit failed:",
1219						(err as Error).message,
1220					);
1221				}
1222				return;
1223			}
1224			await this.postPayload(this.getTargetChannelId(), payload);
1225		}
1226	
1227		flushAll(): Promise<unknown> {
1228			return this.sendQueue.catch(() => undefined);
1229		}
1230	
1231		shutdown(): void {
1232			this.typing.stop();
1233		}
1234	}
1235	
1236	class StreamBuffer {
1237		private pages: { msg?: DiscordMessage; body: string }[] = [];
1238		private currentText = "";
1239		private lastEditAt = 0;
1240		private pending: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
1241		private flushing = false;
1242		private finalized = false;
1243	
1244		constructor(
1245			private readonly relay: DiscordRelay,
1246			private readonly cfg: Config,
1247		) {}
1248	
1249		update(text: string): void {
1250			this.currentText = text;
1251			if (this.flushing || this.finalized) return;
1252	
1253			const now = Date.now();
1254			if (now - this.lastEditAt < this.cfg.editIntervalMs) {
1255				if (!this.pending) {
1256					this.pending = setTimeout(
1257						() => {
1258							this.pending = undefined;
1259							void this.flush();
1260						},
1261						this.cfg.editIntervalMs - (now - this.lastEditAt),
1262					);
1263				}
1264				return;
1265			}
1266	
1267			void this.flush();
1268		}
1269	
1270		private async flush(): Promise<void> {
1271			if (this.flushing || this.finalized) return;
1272			this.flushing = true;
1273			const text = this.currentText;
1274			const chunks = this.chunkText(text);
1275			for (let i = 0; i < chunks.length; i++) {
1276				if (i < this.pages.length && this.pages[i].msg) {
1277					try {
1278						await this.pages[i].msg!.edit(
1279							textPayload(chunks[i]) as MessageEditOptions,
1280						);
1281						this.pages[i].body = chunks[i];
1282						continue;
1283					} catch {
1284						/* Fall through to re-send. */
1285					}
1286				}
1287				const msg = await this.relay.postPayload(
1288					this.relay.getTargetChannelId(),
1289					textPayload(chunks[i]),
1290				);
1291				if (i < this.pages.length) {
1292					this.pages[i].body = chunks[i];
1293					this.pages[i].msg = msg ?? undefined;
1294				} else {
1295					this.pages.push({ msg: msg ?? undefined, body: chunks[i] });
1296				}
1297			}
1298			this.lastEditAt = Date.now();
1299			this.flushing = false;
1300		}
1301	
1302		async finalize(finalText: string): Promise<boolean> {
1303			this.finalized = true;
1304			if (this.pending) {
1305				clearTimeout(this.pending);
1306				this.pending = undefined;
1307			}
1308	
1309			const text = finalText || this.currentText;
1310			if (!text) return false;
1311			const chunks = this.chunkText(text);
1312			let sent = false;
1313	
1314			for (let i = 0; i < chunks.length; i++) {
1315				if (i < this.pages.length && this.pages[i].msg) {
1316					try {
1317						await this.pages[i].msg!.edit(
1318							textPayload(chunks[i]) as MessageEditOptions,
1319						);
1320						sent = true;
1321						continue;
1322					} catch {
1323						/* Fall through to re-send. */
1324					}
1325				}
1326				const msg = await this.relay.postPayload(
1327					this.relay.getTargetChannelId(),
1328					textPayload(chunks[i]),
1329				);
1330				if (i < this.pages.length) {
1331					this.pages[i].body = chunks[i];
1332					this.pages[i].msg = msg ?? undefined;
1333				} else {
1334					this.pages.push({ msg: msg ?? undefined, body: chunks[i] });
1335				}
1336				if (msg) sent = true;
1337			}
1338			return sent;
1339		}
1340	
1341		private chunkText(text: string): string[] {
1342			const max = this.cfg.maxChars;
1343			if (text.length <= max) return [text];
1344			const chunks: string[] = [];
1345			let remaining = text;
1346			while (remaining.length > 0) {
1347				if (remaining.length <= max) {
1348					chunks.push(remaining);
1349					break;
1350				}
1351				let breakAt = remaining.lastIndexOf("\n", max);
1352				if (breakAt < max * 0.3) breakAt = remaining.lastIndexOf(" ", max);
1353				if (breakAt < max * 0.3) breakAt = max;
1354				chunks.push(remaining.slice(0, breakAt));
1355				remaining = remaining.slice(breakAt).trimStart();
1356			}
1357			return chunks;
1358		}
1359	
1360		cancelPending(): void {
1361			if (this.pending) {
1362				clearTimeout(this.pending);
1363				this.pending = undefined;
1364			}
1365		}
1366	}
1367	
1368	// ─── Discord command bridge ────────────────────────────────────────────────
1369	
1370	interface DiscordRemoteSharedState {
1371		commandCtx?: ExtensionCommandContext;
1372		armedSessionId?: string;
1373	}
1374	
1375	const sharedState = ((
1376		globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
1377			__piDiscordRemoteState?: DiscordRemoteSharedState;
1378		}
1379	).__piDiscordRemoteState ??= {});
1380	
1381	let client: Client | undefined;
1382	let relay: DiscordRelay | undefined;
1383	let lastCtx: ExtensionContext | undefined;
1384	let bootInFlight: Promise<Client | undefined> | undefined;
1385	let launcherServer: HttpServer | undefined;
1386	const relayedTimestamps = new Set<number>();
1387	const sessionThreadIds = new Map<string, string>();
1388	/** Map: cwd → Discord channel ID for per-project channels. */
1389	const projectChannels = new Map<string, string>();
1390	
1391	function safeContextSessionId(
1392		ctx: ExtensionContext | ExtensionCommandContext | undefined,
1393	): string | undefined {
1394		if (!ctx) return undefined;
1395		try {
1396			return ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId();
1397		} catch {
1398			return undefined;
1399		}
1400	}
1401	
1402	function armDiscordBridge(ctx: ExtensionCommandContext): string {
1403		const sessionId = ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId();
1404		sharedState.commandCtx = ctx;
1405		sharedState.armedSessionId = sessionId;
1406		return sessionId;
1407	}
1408	
1409	function clearDiscordBridgeArm(): void {
1410		sharedState.commandCtx = undefined;
1411		sharedState.armedSessionId = undefined;
1412	}
1413	
1414	function getArmedCommandCtx(): ExtensionCommandContext | undefined {
1415		const ctx = sharedState.commandCtx;
1416		const ctxSessionId = safeContextSessionId(ctx);
1417		const activeSessionId = safeContextSessionId(lastCtx);
1418		if (
1419			!ctx ||
1420			!ctxSessionId ||
1421			sharedState.armedSessionId !== ctxSessionId ||
1422			(activeSessionId !== undefined && activeSessionId !== ctxSessionId)
1423		) {
1424			clearDiscordBridgeArm();
1425			return undefined;
1426		}
1427		return ctx;
1428	}
1429	
1430	function refreshDiscordBridgeArmForSession(ctx: ExtensionContext): void {
1431		const activeSessionId = safeContextSessionId(ctx);
1432		if (!activeSessionId || !sharedState.commandCtx) return;
1433		const armedSessionId = safeContextSessionId(sharedState.commandCtx);
1434		if (armedSessionId !== activeSessionId) clearDiscordBridgeArm();
1435	}

1437	// ─── Per-project channel creation ──────────────────────────────────────────
1438	
1439	/**
1440	 * Derive a Discord-safe channel name from the current working directory.
1441	 * E.g. "C:\Users\foo\projects\my-app" → "📁 my-app"
1442	 */
1443	function projectNameFromCwd(cwd: string): string {
1444		// Take the last directory component
1445		const segments = cwd.replace(/\\/g, "/").split("/").filter(Boolean);
1446		const leaf = segments[segments.length - 1] || "untitled";
1447		// Discord channel names: lowercase, no spaces, max 100 chars
1448		return (
1449			leaf
1450				.toLowerCase()
1451				.replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]+/g, "-")
1452				.replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
1453				.slice(0, 100) || "untitled"
1454		);
1455	}
1456	
1457	/**
1458	 * Find (or create) a Discord text channel for the given project cwd.
1459	 * Channel name is derived from the directory name.
1460	 * Returns the channel ID.
1461	 */
1462	async function ensureProjectChannel(
1463		c: Client,
1464		cfg: Config,
1465		cwd: string,
1466	): Promise<string | undefined> {
1467		// Check cache first
1468		const cached = projectChannels.get(cwd);
1469		if (cached) {
1470			// Verify it still exists
1471			const existing = c.channels.cache.get(cached);
1472			if (existing) return cached;
1473			projectChannels.delete(cwd);
1474		}
1475	
1476		if (!cfg.guildId) {
1477			console.warn(
1478				"[discord-bridge] PI_DISCORD_GUILD_ID not set — cannot create per-project channels.",
1479			);
1480			return undefined;
1481		}
1482	
1483		const name = projectNameFromCwd(cwd);
1484	
1485		try {
1486			const guild = await c.guilds.fetch(cfg.guildId).catch((err) => {
1487				console.error("[discord-bridge] guild fetch error:", err.message);
1488				return null;
1489			});
1490			if (!guild) {
1491				console.error("[discord-bridge] failed to fetch guild", cfg.guildId);
1492				return undefined;
1493			}
1494	
1495			// Fetch channels to populate cache (cache may be empty at boot)
1496			await guild.channels.fetch().catch((err) => {
1497				console.warn(
1498					"[discord-bridge] guild channels fetch warning:",
1499					err.message,
1500				);
1501			});
1502	
1503			// Check if a channel with this name already exists
1504			const existing = guild.channels.cache.find(
1505				(ch) => ch.isTextBased() && !ch.isThread() && ch.name === name,
1506			) as TextChannel | undefined;
1507	
1508			if (existing) {
1509				projectChannels.set(cwd, existing.id);
1510				return existing.id;
1511			}
1512	
1513			// Create a new text channel
1514			const createOptions: { name: string; reason: string; type?: number } = {
1515				name,
1516				reason: `Pi coding agent project channel for ${name}`,
1517			};
1518			const channel = await guild.channels.create(createOptions);
1519	
1520			projectChannels.set(cwd, channel.id);
1521			return channel.id;
1522		} catch (err) {
1523			console.error(
1524				"[discord-bridge] ensureProjectChannel failed:",
1525				(err as Error).message,
1526			);
1527			return undefined;
1528		}
1529	}

1531	// ─── Discord interaction / slash command handling ─────────────────────────
1532	
1533	async function replyNativeDiscordInteraction(
1534		interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction,
1535		content: string,
1536	): Promise<void> {
1537		const payload = discordInteractionPayload(content);
1538		try {
1539			if (interaction.replied || interaction.deferred) {
1540				await interaction.followUp(payload);
1541			} else {
1542				await interaction.reply(payload);
1543			}
1544		} catch {
1545			try {
1546				await interaction.editReply(payload);
1547			} catch {
1548				/* best-effort */
1549			}
1550		}
1551	}
1552	
1553	async function editNativeDiscordInteraction(
1554		interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction,
1555		content: string,
1556	): Promise<void> {
1557		const payload = discordInteractionPayload(content);
1558		try {
1559			await interaction.editReply(payload);
1560		} catch {
1561			try {
1562				await interaction.followUp(payload);
1563			} catch {
1564				/* best-effort */
1565			}
1566		}
1567	}
1568	
1569	async function handleNativeDiscordInteraction(
1570		pi: ExtensionAPI,
1571		cfg: Config,
1572		interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction,
1573	): Promise<void> {
1574		const commandName = interaction.commandName;
1575		const entry = nativeDiscordCommands.get(commandName);
1576		if (!entry) return;
1577	
1578		const args = interaction.options.getString("args") ?? "";
1579		const mapped = entry.piName;
1580	
1581		switch (mapped) {
1582			case "commands":
1583			case "help": {
1584				await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(
1585					interaction,
1586					clip(buildNativeDiscordCommandList(pi), cfg.maxChars),
1587				);
1588				return;
1589			}
1590			case "abort": {
1591				if (lastCtx && !lastCtx.isIdle()) lastCtx.abort();
1592				await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(interaction, "Abort requested.");
1593				return;
1594			}
1595			case "mute":
1596			case "discord-mute": {
1597				const activeRelay = await waitForRelay();
1598				if (!activeRelay) {
1599					await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(
1600						interaction,
1601						"Discord relay is not running yet — try again in a moment.",
1602					);
1603					return;
1604				}
1605				const changed = activeRelay.setMuted(true);
1606				await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(
1607					interaction,
1608					changed ? "Discord output muted." : "Already muted.",
1609				);
1610				return;
1611			}
1612			case "unmute":
1613			case "discord-unmute": {
1614				const activeRelay = await waitForRelay();
1615				if (!activeRelay) {
1616					await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(
1617						interaction,
1618						"Discord relay is not running yet — try again in a moment.",
1619					);
1620					return;
1621				}
1622				const changed = activeRelay.setMuted(false);
1623				await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(
1624					interaction,
1625					changed ? "Discord output resumed." : "Already unmuted.",
1626				);
1627				return;
1628			}
1629			case "session": {
1630				const sessionId = lastCtx?.sessionManager.getSessionId() ?? "unknown";
1631				const threadId = sessionThreadIds.get(sessionId) ?? cfg.activeChannelId;
1632				await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(
1633					interaction,
1634					`session=${sessionId}\nthread=${threadId || "(none)"}`,
1635				);
1636				return;
1637			}
1638			case "compact": {
1639				lastCtx?.compact();
1640				await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(interaction, "Compaction requested.");
1641				return;
1642			}
1643			case "new": {
1644				await interaction.deferReply({ ephemeral: true }).catch(() => undefined);
1645				try {
1646					const result = await doNewSession(cfg, args);
1647					if (result.method === "spawn") {
1648						await editNativeDiscordInteraction(
1649							interaction,
1650							result.ok
1651								? "Spawning new Pi session — it will announce itself in Discord shortly."
1652								: `error: ${result.error ?? "spawn failed"}`,
1653						);
1654					} else {
1655						await editNativeDiscordInteraction(
1656							interaction,
1657							result.cancelled
1658								? "Session creation cancelled."
1659								: result.ok
1660									? "New Pi session created."
1661									: `error: ${result.error ?? "session creation failed"}`,
1662						);
1663					}
1664				} catch (err) {
1665					await editNativeDiscordInteraction(
1666						interaction,
1667						`error: ${(err as Error).message}`,
1668					);
1669				}
1670				return;
1671			}
1672			case "discord-arm": {
1673				await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(
1674					interaction,
1675					"Run `/discord-arm` in the local Pi TUI to pre-arm in-process session replacement for `/new`. When not armed, `/new` falls back to spawning a new Pi process automatically (configure with PI_DISCORD_SPAWN_COMMAND/PI_DISCORD_SPAWN_ARGS).",
1676				);
1677				return;
1678			}
1679			case "discord-status": {
1680				if (bootInFlight) await bootInFlight.catch(() => undefined);
1681				await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(interaction, statusText(cfg));
1682				return;
1683			}
1684			case "discord-test": {
1685				const activeRelay = await waitForRelay();
1686				const text = args || "pi-discord-bridge test ping";
1687				const msg = await activeRelay?.postRaw(
1688					activeRelay.getTargetChannelId(),
1689					text,
1690				);
1691				await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(
1692					interaction,
1693					msg ? "Sent." : "Send failed (see stderr).",
1694				);
1695				return;
1696			}
1697			case "discord-reconnect": {
1698				await interaction.deferReply({ ephemeral: true }).catch(() => undefined);
1699				if (bootInFlight) await bootInFlight.catch(() => undefined);
1700				if (relay) relay.shutdown();
1701				if (client) await client.destroy().catch(() => undefined);
1702				client = undefined;
1703				relay = undefined;
1704				resetDiscordRest();
1705				bootInFlight = bootClient(pi, cfg).finally(() => {
1706					bootInFlight = undefined;
1707				});
1708				const newClient = await bootInFlight;
1709				await editNativeDiscordInteraction(
1710					interaction,
1711					`Reconnect complete. ready=${newClient?.isReady() ?? false}`,
1712				);
1713				return;
1714			}
1715			case "discord-launcher-status": {
1716				const lines = [
1717					`enabled=${cfg.launcherEnabled}`,
1718					`port=${cfg.launcherPort}`,
1719					`running=${launcherServer?.listening ?? false}`,
1720					`spawn_command=${cfg.spawnCommand || "(none)"}`,
1721					`spawn_args=${cfg.spawnArgs.join(" ") || "(none)"}`,
1722					`secret=${cfg.launcherSecret ? "set" : "not set"}`,
1723				].join("\n");
1724				await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(interaction, lines);
1725				return;
1726			}
1727			default: {
1728				await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(
1729					interaction,
1730					"Unsupported Discord bridge command.",
1731				);
1732			}
1733		}
1734	}
1735	
1736	async function handleDiscordCommand(
1737		pi: ExtensionAPI,
1738		cfg: Config,
1739		msg: DiscordMessage,
1740		text: string,
1741	): Promise<boolean> {
1742		const slash = text.startsWith("/") ? text.slice(1) : text.slice(1);
1743		const space = slash.indexOf(" ");
1744		const command = (space >= 0 ? slash.slice(0, space) : slash).toLowerCase();
1745		const args = space >= 0 ? slash.slice(space + 1).trim() : "";
1746	
1747		const entry = nativeDiscordCommands.get(command);
1748		if (!entry) return false;
1749	
1750		const mapped = entry.piName;
1751		switch (mapped) {
1752			case "commands":
1753			case "help": {
1754				await msg.reply(clip(buildNativeDiscordCommandList(pi), cfg.maxChars));
1755				return true;
1756			}
1757			case "abort": {
1758				if (lastCtx && !lastCtx.isIdle()) lastCtx.abort();
1759				await msg.react("🛑").catch(() => undefined);
1760				return true;
1761			}
1762			case "mute":
1763			case "discord-mute": {
1764				const activeRelay = await waitForRelay();
1765				if (activeRelay) activeRelay.setMuted(true);
1766				await msg.react("🔇").catch(() => undefined);
1767				return true;
1768			}
1769			case "unmute":
1770			case "discord-unmute": {
1771				const activeRelay = await waitForRelay();
1772				if (activeRelay) activeRelay.setMuted(false);
1773				await msg.react("🔊").catch(() => undefined);
1774				return true;
1775			}
1776			case "session": {
1777				const sessionId = safeContextSessionId(lastCtx) ?? "unknown";
1778				const threadId = sessionThreadIds.get(sessionId) ?? cfg.activeChannelId;
1779				await msg.reply(`session=${sessionId}\nthread=${threadId || "(none)"}`);
1780				return true;
1781			}
1782			case "compact": {
1783				lastCtx?.compact();
1784				await msg.react("📦").catch(() => undefined);
1785				return true;
1786			}
1787			case "new": {
1788				await msg.react("⏳").catch(() => undefined);
1789				const result = await doNewSession(cfg, args);
1790				if (result.method === "spawn") {
1791					await msg.reply(
1792						result.ok
1793							? "Spawning new Pi session…"
1794							: `error: ${result.error ?? "spawn failed"}`,
1795					);
1796				} else {
1797					await msg.reply(
1798						result.cancelled
1799							? "Session creation cancelled."
1800							: result.ok
1801								? "New Pi session created."
1802								: `error: ${result.error ?? "session creation failed"}`,
1803					);
1804				}
1805				return true;
1806			}
1807			case "discord-status": {
1808				if (bootInFlight) await bootInFlight.catch(() => undefined);
1809				await msg.reply(statusText(cfg));
1810				return true;
1811			}
1812			case "discord-test": {
1813				const activeRelay = await waitForRelay();
1814				const testText = args || "pi-discord-bridge test ping";
1815				const testMsg = await activeRelay?.postRaw(
1816					activeRelay.getTargetChannelId(),
1817					testText,
1818				);
1819				await msg.reply(testMsg ? "Sent." : "Send failed (see stderr).");
1820				return true;
1821			}
1822			case "discord-reconnect": {
1823				await msg.react("⏳").catch(() => undefined);
1824				if (bootInFlight) await bootInFlight.catch(() => undefined);
1825				if (relay) relay.shutdown();
1826				if (client) await client.destroy().catch(() => undefined);
1827				client = undefined;
1828				relay = undefined;
1829				resetDiscordRest();
1830				bootInFlight = bootClient(pi, cfg).finally(() => {
1831					bootInFlight = undefined;
1832				});
1833				await bootInFlight;
1834				await msg.reply("Reconnect complete.");
1835				return true;
1836			}
1837			case "discord-arm": {
1838				await msg.reply(
1839					"Run `/discord-arm` in the local Pi TUI to pre-arm in-process session replacement for `/new`.",
1840				);
1841				return true;
1842			}
1843			case "discord-launcher-status": {
1844				await msg.reply(
1845					[
1846						`enabled=${cfg.launcherEnabled}`,
1847						`port=${cfg.launcherPort}`,
1848						`running=${launcherServer?.listening ?? false}`,
1849						`spawn_command=${cfg.spawnCommand || "(none)"}`,
1850						`spawn_args=${cfg.spawnArgs.join(" ") || "(none)"}`,
1851						`secret=${cfg.launcherSecret ? "set" : "not set"}`,
1852					].join("\n"),
1853				);
1854				return true;
1855			}
1856			default:
1857				return false;
1858		}
1859	}
1860	
1861	function restoreThreadBindings(ctx: ExtensionContext, cfg: Config): void {
1862		sessionThreadIds.clear();
1863		for (const entry of ctx.sessionManager.getEntries()) {
1864			if (entry.type !== "custom" || entry.customType !== THREAD_BINDING_TYPE)
1865				continue;
1866			const data = entry.data as
1867				| { sessionId?: string; threadId?: string }
1868				| undefined;
1869			if (
1870				typeof data?.sessionId === "string" &&
1871				typeof data.threadId === "string"
1872			) {
1873				sessionThreadIds.set(data.sessionId, data.threadId);
1874			}
1875		}
1876		const currentSessionId = ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId();
1877		cfg.activeChannelId = sessionThreadIds.get(currentSessionId) ?? cfg.channelId;
1878	}
1879	
1880	function activeSessionThreadId(): string | undefined {
1881		const sessionId = safeContextSessionId(lastCtx);
1882		if (!sessionId) return undefined;
1883		return sessionThreadIds.get(sessionId);
1884	}
1885	
1886	function isInboundOriginAllowed(cfg: Config, channelId: string): boolean {
1887		// Allow if it's the configured single channel
1888		if (cfg.channelId && channelId === cfg.channelId) return true;
1889		// Allow if it's the active session thread
1890		if (channelId === activeSessionThreadId()) return true;
1891		// Allow if it's a known project channel
1892		for (const [, chId] of projectChannels) {
1893			if (chId === channelId) return true;
1894		}
1895		return false;
1896	}

1898	// ─── Discord client boot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
1899	
1900	function waitForClientReady(c: Client): Promise<void> {
1901		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
1902			if (c.isReady()) {
1903				resolve();
1904				return;
1905			}
1906			const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
1907				reject(new Error("Client ready timeout (30s)"));
1908			}, 30_000);
1909			c.once(Events.ClientReady, () => {
1910				clearTimeout(timeout);
1911				resolve();
1912			});
1913		});
1914	}
1915	
1916	async function bootClient(
1917		pi: ExtensionAPI,
1918		cfg: Config,
1919	): Promise<Client | undefined> {
1920		if (client) return client;
1921		const c = new Client({
1922			intents: [
1923				GatewayIntentBits.Guilds,
1924				GatewayIntentBits.GuildMessages,
1925				GatewayIntentBits.MessageContent,
1926				GatewayIntentBits.DirectMessages,
1927				GatewayIntentBits.GuildMessageReactions,
1928				GatewayIntentBits.DirectMessageReactions,
1929			],
1930		});
1931		c.on(Events.Error, (err) =>
1932			console.error("[discord-bridge] client error:", err.message),
1933		);
1934	
1935		c.on(Events.MessageReactionAdd, async (reaction, user) => {
1936			if (user.bot) return;
1937			if (reaction.emoji.name !== "🛑") return;
1938			if (!cfg.userIds.has(user.id)) return;
1939	
1940			let message = reaction.message;
1941			if (message.partial) {
1942				try {
1943					message = await message.fetch();
1944				} catch {
1945					return;
1946				}
1947			}
1948			if (!message.author?.bot || message.author.id !== c.user?.id) return;
1949	
1950			if (!isInboundOriginAllowed(cfg, message.channelId)) return;
1951	
1952			if (lastCtx && !lastCtx.isIdle()) {
1953				lastCtx.abort();
1954				await message.react("🛑").catch(() => undefined);
1955			}
1956		});
1957		c.on(Events.InteractionCreate, async (interaction) => {
1958			if (!interaction.isChatInputCommand()) return;
1959			await handleNativeDiscordInteraction(pi, cfg, interaction).catch(
1960				async (err) => {
1961					console.error(
1962						"[discord-bridge] interaction failed:",
1963						(err as Error).message,
1964					);
1965					await replyNativeDiscordInteraction(
1966						interaction,
1967						`error: ${(err as Error).message}`,
1968					);
1969				},
1970			);
1971		});
1972	
1973		c.on(Events.MessageCreate, async (msg) => {
1974			if (msg.author.bot) return;
1975			if (!isInboundOriginAllowed(cfg, msg.channelId)) return;
1976			if (!cfg.userIds.has(msg.author.id)) return;
1977			const text = msg.content.trim();
1978			if (!text) return;
1979	
1980			if (text.startsWith("/") || text.startsWith("!")) {
1981				const handled = await handleDiscordCommand(pi, cfg, msg, text);
1982				if (handled) return;
1983			}
1984	
1985			if (text === "!abort") {
1986				if (lastCtx && !lastCtx.isIdle()) lastCtx.abort();
1987				await msg.react("🛑").catch(() => undefined);
1988				return;
1989			}
1990	
1991			const idle = lastCtx ? lastCtx.isIdle() : true;
1992			try {
1993				if (idle) {
1994					await pi.sendUserMessage(`${cfg.steerLabel} ${text}`);
1995					await msg.react("✅").catch(() => undefined);
1996				} else {
1997					await pi.sendUserMessage(`${cfg.steerLabel} ${text}`, {
1998						deliverAs: "steer",
1999					});
2000					await msg.react("📥").catch(() => undefined);
2001				}
2002			} catch (err) {
2003				await msg
2004					.reply(`error: ${(err as Error).message}`)
2005					.catch(() => undefined);
2006			}
2007		});
2008	
2009		try {
2010			await c.login(cfg.botToken);
2011			await waitForClientReady(c);
2012			await syncNativeDiscordSlashCommands(pi, cfg, c).catch((err) => {
2013				console.error(
2014					"[discord-bridge] slash command sync failed:",
2015					(err as Error).message,
2016				);
2017			});
2018		} catch (err) {
2019			console.error("[discord-bridge] login failed:", (err as Error).message);
2020			try {
2021				await c.destroy();
2022			} catch {
2023				/* ignore */
2024			}
2025			return undefined;
2026		}
2027		client = c;
2028		relay = new DiscordRelay(c, cfg);
2029		return c;
2030	}
2031	
2032	function alreadyRelayed(message: AgentMessage): boolean {
2033		const ts = messageTimestamp(message);
2034		if (ts === undefined) return false;
2035		return relayedTimestamps.has(ts);
2036	}
2037	
2038	function markRelayed(pi: ExtensionAPI, message: AgentMessage): void {
2039		const ts = messageTimestamp(message);
2040		if (ts === undefined) return;
2041		if (relayedTimestamps.has(ts)) return;
2042		relayedTimestamps.add(ts);
2043		pi.appendEntry(RELAYED_TYPE, { timestamp: ts, role: message.role });
2044	}
2045	
2046	function restoreRelayed(ctx: ExtensionContext): void {
2047		relayedTimestamps.clear();
2048		for (const entry of ctx.sessionManager.getEntries()) {
2049			if (entry.type === "custom" && entry.customType === RELAYED_TYPE) {
2050				const data = entry.data as { timestamp?: number } | undefined;
2051				if (typeof data?.timestamp === "number")
2052					relayedTimestamps.add(data.timestamp);
2053			}
2054		}
2055	}

2057	async function waitForRelay(): Promise<DiscordRelay | undefined> {

2059		return relay;
2060	}

2109	// ─── Session launcher ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
2110	
2111	function readBody(req: IncomingMessage): Promise<string> {
2112		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
2113			const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
2114			req.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => chunks.push(chunk));
2115			req.on("end", () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8")));
2116			req.on("error", reject);
2117		});
2118	}
2119	
2120	async function doNewSession(
2121		cfg: Config,
2122		args: string,
2123	): Promise<{
2124		ok: boolean;
2125		method: string;
2126		cancelled?: boolean;
2127		pid?: number;
2128		error?: string;
2129	}> {
2130		const armedCtx = getArmedCommandCtx();
2131		if (armedCtx) {
2132			const result = await armedCtx.newSession({
2133				withSession: async (newCtx) => {
2134					lastCtx = newCtx;
2135					armDiscordBridge(newCtx);
2136					if (args) await newCtx.sendUserMessage(`${cfg.steerLabel} ${args}`);
2137				},
2138			});
2139			return {
2140				ok: !result.cancelled,
2141				method: "newSession",
2142				cancelled: result.cancelled,
2143			};
2144		}
2145	
2146		if (!cfg.spawnCommand) {
2147			return {
2148				ok: false,
2149				method: "none",
2150				error:
2151					"not armed and PI_DISCORD_SPAWN_COMMAND is not set; run /discord-arm in the Pi TUI or configure a spawn command",
2152			};
2153		}
2154	
2155		const spawnEnv: Record<string, string> = {};
2156		for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(process.env)) {
2157			if (v !== undefined) spawnEnv[k] = v;
2158		}
2159		spawnEnv["PI_DISCORD_LAUNCHER_ENABLED"] = "false";
2160	
2161		const proc = spawn(cfg.spawnCommand, cfg.spawnArgs, {
2162			env: spawnEnv,
2163			detached: true,
2164			stdio: "ignore",
2165		});
2166		proc.unref();
2167		return { ok: true, method: "spawn", pid: proc.pid };
2168	}
2169	
2170	function startLauncherServer(cfg: Config): void {
2171		if (!cfg.launcherEnabled) return;
2172	
2173		const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
2174			res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
2175	
2176			if (req.method === "GET" && req.url === "/health") {
2177				res.writeHead(200);
2178				res.end(
2179					JSON.stringify({
2180						ok: true,
2181						ready: client?.isReady() ?? false,
2182						armed: Boolean(getArmedCommandCtx()),
2183					}),
2184				);
2185				return;
2186			}
2187	
2188			if (req.method === "POST" && req.url === "/new-session") {
2189				let data: { secret?: string; args?: string };
2190				try {
2191					const raw = await readBody(req);
2192					data = JSON.parse(raw) as { secret?: string; args?: string };
2193				} catch {
2194					res.writeHead(400);
2195					res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "invalid JSON body" }));
2196					return;
2197				}
2198	
2199				if (cfg.launcherSecret && data.secret !== cfg.launcherSecret) {
2200					res.writeHead(401);
2201					res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "unauthorized" }));
2202					return;
2203				}
2204	
2205				try {
2206					const result = await doNewSession(cfg, (data.args ?? "").trim());
2207					res.writeHead(
2208						result.ok ? (result.method === "spawn" ? 202 : 200) : 500,
2209					);
2210					res.end(JSON.stringify(result));
2211				} catch (err) {
2212					res.writeHead(500);
2213					res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: (err as Error).message }));
2214				}
2215				return;
2216			}
2217	
2218			res.writeHead(404);
2219			res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "not found" }));
2220		});
2221	
2222		server.on("error", (err: Error & { code?: string }) => {
2223			if (err.code === "EADDRINUSE") {
2224				console.warn(
2225					`[discord-bridge] launcher port ${cfg.launcherPort} already in use; this instance will not serve /new-session via HTTP.`,
2226				);
2227			} else {
2228				console.error("[discord-bridge] launcher server error:", err.message);
2229			}
2230			launcherServer = undefined;
2231		});
2232	
2233		server.listen(cfg.launcherPort, "127.0.0.1", () => {
2234			launcherServer = server;
2235			if (!cfg.launcherSecret) {
2236				console.warn(
2237					"[discord-bridge] ⚠️  launcher server is running WITHOUT a secret — " +
2238						"set PI_DISCORD_LAUNCHER_SECRET to restrict /new-session access.",
2239				);
2240			}
2241		});
2242	}
2243	
2244	function stopLauncherServer(): void {
2245		if (launcherServer) {
2246			launcherServer.close();
2247			launcherServer = undefined;
2248		}
2249	}
2250	
2251	// ─── Extension entry point ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
2252	
2253	export default function discordRemote(pi: ExtensionAPI): void {
2254		// Load .env from ~/.pi (not process.cwd())
2255		loadProjectDotEnv();
2256		const cfg = loadConfig();
2257		if (!cfg.enabled) return;
2258		if (!cfg.botToken || cfg.userIds.size === 0) {
2259			console.error(
2260				"[discord-bridge] refusing to start: PI_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN and PI_DISCORD_USER_IDS are required.",
2261			);
2262			return;
2263		}
2264		if (cfg.createChannelPerProject) {
2265			if (!cfg.guildId) {
2266				console.error(
2267					"[discord-bridge] PI_DISCORD_CREATE_CHANNEL_PER_PROJECT=true requires PI_DISCORD_GUILD_ID.",
2268				);
2269				return;
2270			}
2271		} else {
2272			if (!cfg.channelId) {
2273				console.error(
2274					"[discord-bridge] PI_DISCORD_CREATE_CHANNEL_PER_PROJECT=false requires PI_DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID.",
2275				);
2276				return;
2277			}
2278		}
2279	
2280		pi.on("session_start", async (_event, ctx) => {
2281			lastCtx = ctx;
2282			refreshDiscordBridgeArmForSession(ctx);
2283			restoreRelayed(ctx);
2284			restoreThreadBindings(ctx, cfg);
2285			if (!launcherServer) startLauncherServer(cfg);
2286			if (!client && !bootInFlight) {
2287				bootInFlight = bootClient(pi, cfg).finally(() => {
2288					bootInFlight = undefined;
2289				});
2290			} else {
2291				scheduleNativeDiscordSlashCommandSync(pi, cfg, client);
2292			}
2293	
2294			// ── Per-project channel + thread creation ─────────────────────────
2295			const sessionId = ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId();
2296			if (!sessionThreadIds.has(sessionId)) {
2297				// Must wait for the Discord client to finish booting before we can
2298				// create channels or threads.
2299				if (bootInFlight) await bootInFlight.catch(() => undefined);
2300	
2301				if (!client || !relay) {
2302					console.error(
2303						"[discord-bridge] Discord client or relay not available after boot — skipping channel/thread creation.",
2304					);
2305					return;
2306				}
2307	
2308				try {
2309					if (cfg.createChannelPerProject) {
2310						// Create (or reuse) a per-project channel named after cwd
2311						const cwd = process.cwd();
2312						const projectChannelId = await ensureProjectChannel(client, cfg, cwd);
2313						if (projectChannelId) {
2314							cfg.activeChannelId = projectChannelId;
2315						}
2316					} else {
2317						cfg.activeChannelId = cfg.channelId;
2318					}
2319	
2320					// Create the session thread inside the active channel
2321					const threadId = await relay.createSessionThread(sessionId);
2322					if (threadId) {
2323						sessionThreadIds.set(sessionId, threadId);
2324						pi.appendEntry(THREAD_BINDING_TYPE, { sessionId, threadId });
2325					} else {
2326						console.error("[discord-bridge] failed to create session thread");
2327					}
2328				} catch (err) {
2329					console.error(
2330						"[discord-bridge] channel/thread setup failed:",
2331						(err as Error).message,
2332					);
2333				}
2334			}
2335		});
2336	
2337		pi.on("session_shutdown", async () => {

2340			if (relay) {

2346				try {
2347					await client.destroy();
2348				} catch (err) {
2349					console.error(
2350						"[discord-bridge] destroy failed:",
2351						(err as Error).message,
2352					);
2353				}
2354			}
2355			client = undefined;
2356			relay = undefined;
2357			resetDiscordRest();
2358			cfg.activeChannelId = cfg.channelId;
2359		});
2360	
2361		pi.on("input", async (event: InputEvent, ctx) => {
2362			lastCtx = ctx;
2363			if (!cfg.renderUserInput) return;
2364			if (event.source !== "interactive") return;
2365			const text = (event.text ?? "").trim();
2366			if (!text) return;
2367			const activeRelay = await waitForRelay();
2368			await activeRelay?.postRaw(
2369				activeRelay.getTargetChannelId(),

2371			);
2372		});
2373	
2374		pi.on("message_start", async (event, ctx) => {
2375			lastCtx = ctx;

2377			const activeRelay = await waitForRelay();
2378			activeRelay?.onMessageStart(event);
2379		});
2380	
2381		pi.on("message_update", async (event, ctx) => {

2384			const activeRelay = await waitForRelay();
2385			activeRelay?.onMessageUpdate(event);
2386		});
2387	
2388		pi.on("message_end", async (event, ctx) => {

2396	
2397		pi.on("tool_call", async (event, ctx) => {

2400			await activeRelay?.onToolCall(event);

2402

```text
1	# Pi Discord Remote
2	
3	A Pi extension that bridges your Pi coding sessions to Discord. Every project gets its own channel, every session gets its own thread — monitor, steer, and control Pi from Discord in real time.
4	
5	## Features
6	
7	- **Per-project channels** — a dedicated Discord channel is created for each project (named after the working directory), keeping your server organized
8	- **Session threads** — each Pi session spawns a thread inside the project channel with a short, readable slug (`pi-a1b2c`)
9	- **Global config** — set your `.env` once in `~/.pi/.env`, works across all projects
10	- **Two-way control** — send messages in Discord to steer Pi, or react with 🛑 to abort
11	- **Tool call streaming** — optionally watch tool calls and results arrive live in Discord
12	- **Slash commands** — register bridge commands as native Discord slash commands
13	
14	## Prerequisites
15	
16	- [Pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi)
17	- A [Discord bot](https://discord.com/developers/applications) in your server with these permissions:
18	  - Send Messages
19	  - Read Message History
20	  - Create Public Threads
21	  - Manage Threads
22	  - Add Reactions
23	  - Manage Channels *(needed for per-project channel creation)*
24	
25	## Installation
26	
27	### npm (recommended)
28	
29	Inside Pi, run:
30	
31	```
32	/pi-install npm:pi-discord-bridge
33	```
34	
35	Or manually add to `~/.pi/agent/settings.json`:
36	
37	```json
38	{
39	  "packages": [
40	    "npm:pi-discord-bridge"
41	  ]
42	}
43	```
44	
45	### Local (from source)
46	
47	```bash
48	cp -r pi-discord-bridge ~/.pi/agent/extensions/discord-bridge
49	cd ~/.pi/agent/extensions/discord-bridge && npm install
50	```
51	
52	Then use `"ext:discord-bridge"` in settings.json instead.
53	
54	### Config
55	
56	Either way, set up your environment:
57	
58	```bash
59	cp .env.example ~/.pi/.env
60	# Edit ~/.pi/.env with your bot token, channel IDs, etc.
61	```
62	
63	Restart Pi.
64	
65	## Configuration
66	
67	All settings go in `~/.pi/.env`. See [`.env.example`](.env.example) for the full list.
68	
69	| Variable | Default | Description |
70	| --- | --- | --- |
71	| `PI_DISCORD_ENABLED` | `false` | Master switch |
72	| `PI_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` | — | Discord bot token |
73	| `PI_DISCORD_USER_IDS` | — | Allowed Discord user IDs (comma-separated) |
74	| `PI_DISCORD_CREATE_CHANNEL_PER_PROJECT` | `true` | `true` = auto-create a channel per project (requires `PI_DISCORD_GUILD_ID`); `false` = send everything to `PI_DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID` |
75	| `PI_DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID` | — | Target channel when `CREATE_CHANNEL_PER_PROJECT=false` |
76	| `PI_DISCORD_GUILD_ID` | — | Guild for per-project channel creation (required when toggle is `true`) |
77	| `PI_DISCORD_STREAM_MESSAGES` | `false` | Live-edit messages as the assistant streams |
78	| `PI_DISCORD_CREATE_THREAD_PER_SESSION` | `true` | One thread per Pi session |
79	| `PI_DISCORD_THREAD_NAME_PREFIX` | `pi` | Thread name prefix |
80	| `PI_DISCORD_RENDER_TOOL_CALLS` | `true` | Show tool calls in Discord |
81	| `PI_DISCORD_RENDER_TOOL_RESULTS` | `true` | Show tool results in Discord |
82	| `PI_DISCORD_RENDER_USER_INPUT` | `true` | Echo user messages to Discord |
83	| `PI_DISCORD_RENDER_REASONING` | `false` | Show chain-of-thought |
84	
85	## How it works
86	
87	```
88	Server
89	├── #general              (your existing channel)
90	├── #my-app               (auto-created for ~/projects/my-app)
91	│   ├── pi-a1b2c          (session thread)
92	│   └── pi-f3d4e          (another session thread)
93	└── #api-server           (auto-created for ~/projects/api-server)
94	    └── pi-b7c8d          (session thread)
95	```
96	
97	Each time you start Pi in a project directory, the extension:
98	
99	1. Creates (or reuses) a text channel named after the project directory
100	2. Creates a session thread with a 5-character slug inside that channel
101	3. Sends all assistant messages, tool calls, and results to that thread
102	
103	## Discord commands
104	
105	| Command | Description |
106	| --- | --- |
107	| `/session` | Current session and thread info |
108	| `/abort` | Abort the current turn (or react 🛑) |
109	| `/compact` | Trigger context compaction |
110	| `/new [args]` | Start a new Pi session |
111	| `/mute` / `/unmute` | Suppress/resume Discord output |
112	| `/discord-status` | Full status and config dump |
113	| `/discord-test [msg]` | Send a test message |
114	| `/discord-reconnect` | Reconnect the bot |
115	
116	You can also just type naturally — messages are forwarded to Pi as input.
117	
118	## Pi commands
119	
120	| Command | Description |
121	| --- | --- |
122	| `/discord-status` | Connection status, channels, config |
123	| `/discord-test [msg]` | Send a test message |
124	| `/discord-reconnect` | Reconnect the bot |
125	| `/discord-mute` / `/discord-unmute` | Mute/unmute Discord output |
126	| `/discord-arm` | Arm in-process session replacement |
127	| `/discord-launcher-status` | HTTP launcher info |
128	
129	## License
130	
131	MIT
132
```
</details></tool-use>

23	// Agent drives the pi coding agent CLI. Default transport is `pi --mode rpc`
24	// as a persistent subprocess so extension notifications can arrive after a
25	// turn. Set transport="json" in options to use the legacy one-process-per-Send
26	// `pi --mode json -p` transport.
27	type Agent struct {
28		cmd        string // path to pi binary
29		workDir    string
30		model      string
31		mode       string // "default" | "yolo"
32		thinking   string // reasoning effort: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh
33		transport  string // "rpc" (default) | "json"
34		sessionEnv []string
35		mu         sync.Mutex
36	}
37	
38	func New(opts map[string]any) (core.Agent, error) {
39		workDir, _ := opts["work_dir"].(string)
40		if workDir == "" {
41			workDir = "."
42		}
43		model, _ := opts["model"].(string)
44		mode, _ := opts["mode"].(string)
45		mode = normalizeMode(mode)
46	
47		cmd, _ := opts["cmd"].(string)
48		if cmd == "" {
49			cmd = "pi"
50		}
51	
52		if _, err := exec.LookPath(cmd); err != nil {
53			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: '%s' not found in PATH, install with: npm install -g @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent", cmd)
54		}
55	
56		transport, _ := opts["transport"].(string)
57		transport = normalizeTransport(transport)
58	
59		return &Agent{
60			cmd:       cmd,
61			workDir:   workDir,
62			model:     model,
63			mode:      mode,
64			transport: transport,
65		}, nil
66	}
67	
68	func normalizeTransport(raw string) string {
69		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(raw)) {
70		case "json":
71			return "json"
72		default:
73			return "rpc"
74		}
75	}
76	
77	func normalizeMode(raw string) string {
78		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(raw)) {
79		case "yolo", "bypass", "auto-approve":
80			return "yolo"
81		default:
82			return "default"
83		}
84	}

89	func (a *Agent) CompressCommand() string { return "/compact" }

284	// ── Session helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────
285	
286	// findSessionFile locates the .jsonl file for a given session UUID in sessDir.
287	// Session files are named: <timestamp>_<uuid>.jsonl — this function extracts
288	// the UUID portion and matches exactly to avoid partial-match vulnerabilities.
289	func findSessionFile(sessDir, sessionID string) string {
290		entries, err := os.ReadDir(sessDir)
291		if err != nil {
292			return ""
293		}
294		for _, entry := range entries {
295			name := entry.Name()
296			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".jsonl") {
297				continue
298			}
299			// Extract UUID: strip .jsonl, then take everything after the last "_".
300			base := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".jsonl")
301			if idx := strings.LastIndex(base, "_"); idx >= 0 {
302				if base[idx+1:] == sessionID {
303					return filepath.Join(sessDir, name)
304				}
305			}
306		}
307		return ""
308	}
309	
310	// piSessionDir returns the pi session directory for the given workDir.
311	// Pi encodes the absolute path as: replace "/" with "-", wrap with "--".
312	// e.g. /home/user/project → --home-user-project--
313	func piSessionDir(workDir string) string {
314		homeDir, err := os.UserHomeDir()
315		if err != nil {
316			return ""
317		}
318		absDir, err := filepath.Abs(workDir)
319		if err != nil {
320			return ""
321		}
322		encoded := "--" + strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimPrefix(absDir, "/"), "/", "-") + "--"
323		return filepath.Join(homeDir, ".pi", "agent", "sessions", encoded)
324	}
325	
326	// scanPiSession reads a pi session .jsonl file and extracts the session ID,
327	// a summary (first user message), and a message count.
328	func scanPiSession(path string) (sessionID, summary string, msgCount int) {
329		f, err := os.Open(path)
330		if err != nil {
331			return "", "", 0
332		}
333		defer f.Close()
334	
335		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
336		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 64*1024), 1*1024*1024)
337	
338		for scanner.Scan() {
339			var entry map[string]any
340			if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &entry); err != nil {
341				continue
342			}
343			switch entry["type"] {
344			case "session":
345				if id, ok := entry["id"].(string); ok {
346					sessionID = id
347				}
348			case "message":
349				msg, _ := entry["message"].(map[string]any)
350				if msg == nil {
351					continue
352				}
353				role, _ := msg["role"].(string)
354				if role == "user" || role == "assistant" {
355					msgCount++
356				}
357				// Use first user message as summary.
358				if role == "user" && summary == "" {
359					content, _ := msg["content"].([]any)
360					for _, c := range content {
361						item, _ := c.(map[string]any)
362						if item != nil {
363							if text, ok := item["text"].(string); ok && text != "" {
364								summary = text
365								runes := []rune(summary)
366								if len(runes) > 80 {
367									summary = string(runes[:80]) + "..."
368								}
369								break
370							}
371						}
372					}
373				}
374			}
375		}
376		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
377			slog.Warn("pi: scan session error", "path", path, "error", err)
378		}
379		return
380	}
381	
382	// readPiHistory reads user/assistant messages from a pi session file.
383	func readPiHistory(path string, limit int) ([]core.HistoryEntry, error) {
384		f, err := os.Open(path)
385		if err != nil {
386			return nil, err
387		}
388		defer f.Close()
389	
390		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
391		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 64*1024), 1*1024*1024)
392	
393		var all []core.HistoryEntry
394		for scanner.Scan() {
395			var entry map[string]any
396			if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &entry); err != nil {
397				continue
398			}
399			if entry["type"] != "message" {
400				continue
401			}
402			msg, _ := entry["message"].(map[string]any)
403			if msg == nil {
404				continue
405			}
406			role, _ := msg["role"].(string)
407			if role != "user" && role != "assistant" {
408				continue
409			}
410	
411			var text string
412			content, _ := msg["content"].([]any)
413			for _, c := range content {
414				item, _ := c.(map[string]any)
415				if item != nil {
416					if t, ok := item["text"].(string); ok && t != "" {
417						text = t
418						break
419					}
420				}
421			}
422			if text == "" {
423				continue
424			}
425			all = append(all, core.HistoryEntry{Role: role, Content: text})
426		}
427		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
428			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: read history: %w", err)
429		}
430	
431		if limit > 0 && len(all) > limit {
432			all = all[len(all)-limit:]
433		}
434		return all, nil
435	}
436

33	func (b *boundedStderrBuffer) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
34		n := len(p)
35		remaining := maxCapturedStderrBytes - b.buf.Len()
36		if remaining > 0 {
37			if remaining > len(p) {
38				remaining = len(p)
39			}
40			_, _ = b.buf.Write(p[:remaining])
41		}
42		if remaining < len(p) {
43			b.truncated = true
44		}
45		return n, nil
46	}

49		if !b.truncated {

51		}

53	}

99	func newPiSession(ctx context.Context, cmd, workDir, model, mode, thinking, resumeID string, extraEnv []string) (*piSession, error) {
100		sessionCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
101	
102		s := &piSession{
103			cmd:      cmd,
104			workDir:  workDir,
105			model:    model,
106			mode:     mode,
107			thinking: thinking,
108			extraEnv: extraEnv,
109			events:   make(chan core.Event, 64),
110			ctx:      sessionCtx,
111			cancel:   cancel,
112		}
113		s.alive.Store(true)
114	
115		if resumeID != "" && resumeID != core.ContinueSession {
116			s.sessionID.Store(resumeID)
117		}
118	
119		return s, nil
120	}

122	func (s *piSession) Send(prompt string, images []core.ImageAttachment, files []core.FileAttachment) error {
123		s.resetResponseState()
124	
125		// Clean up attachments from previous turns.
126		cleanAttachments(s.workDir)
127	
128		// Images keep their existing inline behavior (Telegram already caps
129		// photo sizes; the model can handle them as multimodal input).
130		var atFiles []string
131		if len(images) > 0 {
132			atFiles = append(atFiles, saveImagesToDisk(s.workDir, images)...)
133		}
134		// File attachments are classified: inline-safe text/code keeps the
135		// `@<path>` inline behavior, everything else (PDFs, audio, video,
136		// docs, large logs) is surfaced as a path reference in the prompt so
137		// the model uses its `read` tool / domain skills instead of bloating
138		// the context window. See attachments.go for the classification rules.
139		attached := classifyFileAttachments(s.workDir, files)
140		atFiles = append(atFiles, attached.inlinePaths...)
141		if prefix := buildAttachmentPrefix(attached.referencePaths, files); prefix != "" {
142			prompt = prefix + prompt
143		}
144		if !s.alive.Load() {
145			return fmt.Errorf("session is closed")
146		}
147	
148		args := []string{"--mode", "json", "-p"}
149	
150		sid := s.CurrentSessionID()
151		if sid != "" {
152			args = append(args, "--session", sid)
153		}
154	
155		if s.model != "" {
156			args = append(args, "--model", s.model)
157		}
158	
159		if s.mode == "yolo" {
160			args = append(args, "--auto-approve")
161		}
162	
163		if s.thinking != "" {
164			args = append(args, "--thinking", s.thinking)
165		}
166	
167		// Pass attachments as @file arguments
168		for _, f := range atFiles {
169			args = append(args, "@"+f)
170		}
171	
172		// Append prompt as positional arg
173		args = append(args, prompt)
174	
175		slog.Debug("piSession: launching", "resume", sid != "", "args", core.RedactArgs(args))
176	
177		cmd := exec.CommandContext(s.ctx, s.cmd, args...)
178		cmd.Dir = s.workDir
179		env := os.Environ()
180		if len(s.extraEnv) > 0 {
181			env = core.MergeEnv(env, s.extraEnv)
182		}
183		cmd.Env = env
184	
185		stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
186		if err != nil {
187			return fmt.Errorf("piSession: stdout pipe: %w", err)
188		}
189	
190		var stderrBuf boundedStderrBuffer
191		cmd.Stderr = &stderrBuf
192	
193		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
194			return fmt.Errorf("piSession: start: %w", err)
195		}
196	
197		s.wg.Add(1)
198		go s.readLoop(cmd, stdout, &stderrBuf)
199	
200		return nil
201	}

207	func (s *piSession) CompactContextWithContext(ctx context.Context) error {
208		if ctx == nil {
209			ctx = context.Background()
210		}
211		if !s.alive.Load() {
212			return fmt.Errorf("session is closed")
213		}
214		sid := s.CurrentSessionID()
215		if sid == "" {
216			return fmt.Errorf("piSession: cannot compact before session id is known")
217		}

219		rpc, err := newPiRPCSession(ctx, s.cmd, s.workDir, s.model, s.mode, s.thinking, sid, s.extraEnv)
220		if err != nil {
221			return err

223		defer func() { _ = rpc.Close() }()
224		return rpc.CompactContextWithContext(ctx)
