1760	
1761	func (s *piRPCSession) Alive() bool { return s.alive.Load() }
1762	
1763	func (s *piRPCSession) noteProtocolEvent(eventType string) {
1764		if eventType == "" {
1765			return
1766		}
1767		s.healthMu.Lock()
1768		s.lastProtocolEvent = eventType
1769		s.healthActivitySeq++
1770		s.healthMu.Unlock()
1771	}
1772	
1773	func (s *piRPCSession) setHealthPhase(phase core.StallPhase, compacting bool) {
1774		s.healthMu.Lock()
1775		s.healthPhase = phase
1776		s.isCompacting = compacting
1777		s.healthMu.Unlock()
1778	}
1779	
1780	// ProbeStall performs bounded read-only reconciliation. get_state supplies
1781	// operation flags; a bounded tail read of its sessionFile supplies an opaque
1782	// durable leaf/file cursor without transporting or logging message bodies.
1783	func (s *piRPCSession) ProbeStall(ctx context.Context) (core.StallProbeSnapshot, error) {
1784		snapshot := core.StallProbeSnapshot{
1785			ProcessAlive: s.Alive(),
1786			Generation:   s.generation.Load(),
1787		}
1788		s.procMu.Lock()
1789		if s.proc != nil && s.proc.Process != nil {
1790			snapshot.PID = s.proc.Process.Pid
1791		}
1792		s.procMu.Unlock()
1793		if !snapshot.ProcessAlive {
1794			snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseProcessDead
1795			return snapshot, nil
1796		}
1797	
1798		s.healthMu.Lock()
1799		snapshot.Phase = s.healthPhase
1800		snapshot.ActivitySeq = s.healthActivitySeq
1801		snapshot.IsCompacting = s.isCompacting
1802		snapshot.LastEventType = s.lastProtocolEvent
1803		s.healthMu.Unlock()
1804		s.turnMu.Lock()
1805		snapshot.PromptPending = s.promptPending
1806		turnActive := s.turn.active
1807		s.turnMu.Unlock()
1808	
1809		resp, err := s.callWithTimeoutContext(ctx, map[string]any{"type": "get_state"}, 0)
1810		if err != nil {
1811			if !s.Alive() {
1812				snapshot.ProcessAlive = false
1813				snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseTransportBroken
1814			}
1815			return snapshot, err
1816		}
1817		if !resp.success {
1818			return snapshot, fmt.Errorf("get_state rejected: %s", resp.errMsg)
1819		}
1820		var state struct {
1821			IsStreaming         bool   `json:"isStreaming"`
1822			IsCompacting        bool   `json:"isCompacting"`
1823			SessionFile         string `json:"sessionFile"`
1824			MessageCount        int    `json:"messageCount"`
1825			PendingMessageCount int    `json:"pendingMessageCount"`
1826		}
1827		if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.data, &state); err != nil {
1828			return snapshot, fmt.Errorf("decode get_state: %w", err)
1829		}
1830		snapshot.TransportResponsive = true
1831		snapshot.IsStreaming = state.IsStreaming
1832		snapshot.IsCompacting = state.IsCompacting
1833		snapshot.PendingMessageCount = state.PendingMessageCount
1834		if snapshot.PromptPending {
1835			snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseAwaitingAcceptance
1836		} else if state.IsCompacting {
1837			snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseCompacting
1838		} else if state.IsStreaming {
1839			switch snapshot.Phase {
1840			case core.StallPhaseTool, core.StallPhaseRetrying:
1841			default:
1842				snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseStreaming
1843			}
1844		} else if !turnActive {
1845			snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseSettled
1846		}
1847		cursor, err := boundedDurableCursor(ctx, state.SessionFile, state.MessageCount)
1848		if err != nil {
1849			// get_state responsiveness is still useful, but durable reconciliation
1850			// failure must count as a failed probe rather than healthy silence.
1851			return snapshot, fmt.Errorf("read durable cursor: %w", err)
1852		}
1853		snapshot.Cursor = cursor
1854		return snapshot, nil
1855	}
1856	
1857	// InterruptStall serializes Pi's native abort through the prompt/compact
1858	// mutation gate and never submits or replays user input.
1859	func (s *piRPCSession) InterruptStall(ctx context.Context) error {
1860		if err := s.acquireMutating(ctx, "abort"); err != nil {
1861			return fmt.Errorf("admit stalled-operation abort: %w", err)
1862		}
1863		defer s.releaseMutating()
1864	
1865		// Revalidate after acquiring the mutation gate. Settlement or a queued turn
1866		// may have won while core was scheduling recovery. Never abort unknown prompt
1867		// acceptance, an idle/new generation, or manual compaction (Pi RPC abort does
1868		// not cancel manual compaction).
1869		s.turnMu.Lock()
1870		promptPending := s.promptPending
1871		s.turnMu.Unlock()
1872		s.healthMu.Lock()
1873		phase := s.healthPhase
1874		s.healthMu.Unlock()
1875		if promptPending {
1876			return nil
1877		}
1878		switch phase {
1879		case core.StallPhaseRunning, core.StallPhaseStreaming, core.StallPhaseTool, core.StallPhaseRetrying:
1880		default:
1881			return nil
1882		}
1883	
1884		resp, err := s.callWithTimeoutContext(ctx, map[string]any{"type": "abort"}, 0)
1885		if err != nil {
1886			return fmt.Errorf("abort stalled operation: %w", err)
1887		}
1888		if !resp.success {
1889			return fmt.Errorf("abort stalled operation rejected: %s", resp.errMsg)
1890		}
1891		return nil
1892	}
1893	
1894	func boundedDurableCursor(ctx context.Context, path string, messageCount int) (string, error) {
1895		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
1896			return "", err
1897		}
1898		if path == "" {
1899			return fmt.Sprintf("messages:%d", messageCount), nil
1900		}
1901		f, err := os.Open(path)
1902		if err != nil {
1903			return "", err
1904		}
1905		defer f.Close()
1906		info, err := f.Stat()
1907		if err != nil {
1908			return "", err
1909		}
1910		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
1911			return "", err
1912		}
1913		const tailLimit int64 = 64 * 1024
1914		size := info.Size()
1915		start := size - tailLimit
1916		if start < 0 {
1917			start = 0
1918		}
1919		buf := make([]byte, size-start)
1920		if len(buf) > 0 {
1921			if _, err := f.ReadAt(buf, start); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
1922				return "", err
1923			}
1924		}
1925		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
1926			return "", err
1927		}
1928		lines := bytes.Split(buf, []byte{'\n'})
1929		leaf := ""
1930		for i := len(lines) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
1931			line := bytes.TrimSpace(lines[i])
1932			if len(line) == 0 || (start > 0 && i == 0) {
1933				continue
1934			}
1935			var entry struct {
1936				ID string `json:"id"`
1937			}
1938			if json.Unmarshal(line, &entry) == nil && entry.ID != "" {
1939				leaf = entry.ID
1940				break
1941			}
1942		}
1943		return fmt.Sprintf("messages:%d:size:%d:leaf:%s", messageCount, size, leaf), nil
1944	}
1945	
1946	func (s *piRPCSession) Close() error {
1947		s.closeOnce.Do(func() {
1948			s.closing.Store(true)
1949			s.alive.Store(false)
1950			s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseProcessDead, false)
1951			// Try a graceful shutdown by closing stdin first.
1952			s.procMu.Lock()
1953			stdin := s.stdin
1954			proc := s.proc
1955			s.procMu.Unlock()
1956			if stdin != nil {
1957				_ = stdin.Close()
1958			}
1959			if proc != nil && proc.Process != nil {
1960				_ = proc.Process.Signal(os.Interrupt)
1961			}
1962			// Wake every ACK waiter before waiting for process teardown. Calls that
1963			// completed their write report acceptance/outcome unknown.
1964			s.cancelPending(&rpcTransportError{cause: errors.New("pi RPC session closed")})
1965			if s.cancel != nil {
1966				s.cancel()
1967			}
1968			done := make(chan struct{})
1969			go func() {
1970				s.wg.Wait()
1971				close(done)
1972			}()
1973			select {
1974			case <-done:
1975			case <-time.After(8 * time.Second):
1976				if proc != nil && proc.Process != nil {
1977					_ = proc.Process.Kill()
1978				}
1979				slog.Warn("piRPCSession: close timed out, killed")
1980			}
1981			s.closeEvents()
1982		})
1983		return nil
1984	}

1986	// idKey converts a JSON id (string or number) to a stable map key.
1987	func idKey(raw json.RawMessage) string {
1988		raw = bytes.TrimSpace(raw)
1989		if len(raw) == 0 {
1990			return ""
1991		}
1992		var s string
1993		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &s) == nil {
1994			return s
1995		}
1996		var n json.Number
1997		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &n) == nil {
1998			return string(n)
1999		}
2000		return string(raw)
2001	}
2002	
2003	func truncBytes(b []byte, n int) string {
2004		if len(b) <= n {
2005			return string(b)
2006		}
2007		return string(b[:n]) + "..."
2008	}

155	func NewBridgeServer(port int, token, path string, corsOrigins []string) *BridgeServer {

157	}

162		return newBridgeServer(port, token, path, corsOrigins, true)
163	}

165	func newBridgeServer(port int, token, path string, corsOrigins []string, insecure bool) *BridgeServer {
166		if port <= 0 {
167			port = 9810
168		}
169		if path == "" {
170			path = "/bridge/ws"
171		}
172		if !strings.HasPrefix(path, "/") {
173			path = "/" + path
174		}
175	
176		// Validate security settings
177		if token == "" && !insecure {
178			slog.Error("bridge: token is required when insecure mode is not enabled",
179				"help", "set bridge.token in config, or use insecure=true for local development only")
180			return nil
181		}
182		if insecure && token == "" {
183			slog.Warn("bridge: running in INSECURE mode without authentication - only use for local development!")
184		}
185	
186		return &BridgeServer{
187			port:        port,
188			token:       token,
189			path:        path,
190			corsOrigins: corsOrigins,
191			insecure:    insecure,
192			adapters:    make(map[string]*bridgeAdapter),
193			engines:     make(map[string]*bridgeEngineRef),
194		}
195	}

202	// RegisterEngine associates a project engine with its BridgePlatform.
203	func (bs *BridgeServer) RegisterEngine(projectName string, engine *Engine, bp *BridgePlatform) {
204		bs.enginesMu.Lock()
205		defer bs.enginesMu.Unlock()
206		if err := bp.Start(engine.handleMessage); err != nil {
207			slog.Warn("bridge: platform start failed", "project", projectName, "error", err)
208		}
209		bp.SetCardNavigationHandler(engine.handleCardNav)
210		bs.engines[projectName] = &bridgeEngineRef{engine: engine, platform: bp}
211	}

213	// Start launches the HTTP/WebSocket server.
214	func (bs *BridgeServer) Start() {
215		mux := http.NewServeMux()
216		mux.HandleFunc(bs.path, bs.handleWS)
217	
218		// Session management REST endpoints (with CORS support)
219		mux.HandleFunc("/bridge/sessions", bs.corsHTTP(bs.authHTTP(bs.handleSessions)))
220		mux.HandleFunc("/bridge/sessions/", bs.corsHTTP(bs.authHTTP(bs.handleSessionRoutes)))
221	
222		addr := fmt.Sprintf(":%d", bs.port)
223		bs.server = &http.Server{Addr: addr, Handler: mux}
224	
225		go func() {
226			slog.Info("bridge: server started", "addr", addr, "path", bs.path)
227			if err := bs.server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
228				slog.Error("bridge: server error", "error", err)
229			}
230		}()
231	}

233	// corsHTTP wraps a handler with CORS headers. OPTIONS preflight is handled directly.
234	func (bs *BridgeServer) corsHTTP(handler http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc {
235		return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
236			bs.setCORS(w, r)
237			if r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
238				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
239				return
240			}
241			handler(w, r)
242		}
243	}
244	
245	// setCORS sets Access-Control-* headers when the request origin matches cors_origins.
246	func (bs *BridgeServer) setCORS(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
247		if len(bs.corsOrigins) == 0 {
248			return
249		}
250		origin := r.Header.Get("Origin")
251		for _, o := range bs.corsOrigins {
252			if o == "*" || o == origin {
253				w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", origin)
254				w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS")
255				w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Authorization, Content-Type")
256				w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Max-Age", "86400")
257				break
258			}
259		}
260	}
261	
262	// Stop shuts down the server and closes all adapter connections.
263	func (bs *BridgeServer) Stop() {
264		bs.mu.Lock()
265		for _, a := range bs.adapters {
266			a.conn.Close()
267		}
268		bs.adapters = make(map[string]*bridgeAdapter)
269		bs.mu.Unlock()
270	
271		if bs.server != nil {
272			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
273			defer cancel()
274			if err := bs.server.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
275				slog.Debug("bridge: server shutdown failed", "error", err)
276			}
277		}
278	}

280	// ConnectedAdapters returns the names of currently connected adapters.
281	func (bs *BridgeServer) ConnectedAdapters() []string {
282		bs.mu.RLock()
283		defer bs.mu.RUnlock()
284		names := make([]string, 0, len(bs.adapters))
285		for name := range bs.adapters {
286			names = append(names, name)
287		}
288		return names
289	}

347	func (bp *BridgePlatform) ReconstructReplyCtx(sessionKey string) (any, error) {
348		platform := bp.server.platformFromSessionKey(sessionKey)
349		if platform == "" {
350			return nil, fmt.Errorf("bridge: cannot determine adapter from session key %q", sessionKey)
351		}
352		a := bp.server.getAdapter(platform)
353		if a == nil {
354			return nil, fmt.Errorf("bridge: adapter %q not connected", platform)
355		}
356		if !a.capabilities["reconstruct_reply"] {
357			return nil, fmt.Errorf("bridge: adapter %q does not support reconstruct_reply", platform)
358		}
359		replyCtx, err := buildBridgeReconstructReplyCtx(bp.project, sessionKey)
360		if err != nil {
361			return nil, err
362		}
363		return newBridgeReplyCtx(a, sessionKey, replyCtx), nil
364	}

366	func newBridgeReplyCtx(a *bridgeAdapter, sessionKey, replyCtx string) *bridgeReplyCtx {
367		rc := &bridgeReplyCtx{
368			SessionKey: sessionKey,
369			ReplyCtx:   replyCtx,
370		}
371		if a == nil {
372			return rc
373		}
374		rc.Platform = a.platform
375		rc.progressStyle = bridgeProgressStyleForAdapter(a)
376		rc.supportsProgressCardPayload = bridgeSupportsProgressCardPayloadForAdapter(a)
377		return rc
378	}

380	func bridgeProgressStyleForAdapter(a *bridgeAdapter) string {
381		if a == nil {
382			return progressStyleLegacy
383		}
384		if style, ok := bridgeMetadataString(a.metadata, "progress_style"); ok {
385			return normalizeProgressStyle(style)
386		}
387		if a.capabilities["preview"] && a.capabilities["update_message"] {
388			if a.capabilities["card"] {
389				return progressStyleCard
390			}
391			return progressStyleCompact
392		}
393		return progressStyleLegacy
394	}

396	func bridgeSupportsProgressCardPayloadForAdapter(a *bridgeAdapter) bool {
397		if a == nil {
398			return false
399		}
400		if supported, ok := bridgeMetadataBool(a.metadata, "supports_progress_card_payload"); ok {
401			return supported
402		}
403		adapterName, _ := bridgeMetadataString(a.metadata, "adapter")
404		return adapterName == "bot-gateway" && a.capabilities["preview"] && a.capabilities["update_message"]
405	}

407	func bridgeMetadataString(metadata map[string]any, key string) (string, bool) {
408		if metadata == nil {
409			return "", false
410		}
411		raw, ok := metadata[key]
412		if !ok {
413			return "", false
414		}
415		value, ok := raw.(string)
416		if !ok {
417			return "", false
418		}
419		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
420		if value == "" {
421			return "", false
422		}
423		return value, true
424	}
425	
426	func bridgeMetadataBool(metadata map[string]any, key string) (bool, bool) {
427		if metadata == nil {
428			return false, false
429		}
430		raw, ok := metadata[key]
431		if !ok {
432			return false, false
433		}
434		value, ok := raw.(bool)
435		if !ok {
436			return false, false
437		}
438		return value, true
439	}
440	
441	func buildBridgeReconstructReplyCtx(project, sessionKey string) (string, error) {
442		chatID, err := bridgeTransportChatID(sessionKey)
443		if err != nil {
444			return "", err
445		}
446		payload := bridgeReconstructReplyCtxPayload{
447			Kind:                bridgeReconstructReplyCtxKind,
448			Version:             1,
449			SenderProject:       project,
450			TransportChatID:     chatID,
451			TransportSessionKey: sessionKey,
452		}
453		data, err := json.Marshal(payload)
454		if err != nil {
455			return "", fmt.Errorf("bridge: marshal reconstruct reply ctx: %w", err)
456		}
457		return string(data), nil
458	}
459	
460	func bridgeTransportChatID(sessionKey string) (string, error) {
461		parts := strings.SplitN(sessionKey, ":", 3)
462		if len(parts) < 2 || parts[1] == "" {
463			return "", fmt.Errorf("bridge: invalid session key %q", sessionKey)
464		}
465		if parts[0] == "slack" {
466			chatID := extractChannelID(sessionKey)
467			if chatID == "" {
468				return "", fmt.Errorf("bridge: invalid slack session key %q", sessionKey)
469			}
470			return chatID, nil
471		}
472		return parts[1], nil
473	}

531	func (bp *BridgePlatform) SendPreviewStart(ctx context.Context, replyCtx any, content string) (previewHandle any, err error) {
532		rc, ok := replyCtx.(*bridgeReplyCtx)
533		if !ok {
534			return nil, fmt.Errorf("bridge: invalid reply context")
535		}
536		a := bp.server.getAdapter(rc.Platform)
537		if a == nil || !a.capabilities["preview"] {
538			return nil, ErrNotSupported
539		}
540	
541		refID := fmt.Sprintf("prev-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
542		ch := make(chan string, 1)
543	
544		a.previewMu.Lock()
545		a.previewRequests[refID] = ch
546		a.previewMu.Unlock()
547	
548		if err := bp.server.sendToAdapter(rc.Platform, map[string]any{
549			"type":        "preview_start",
550			"ref_id":      refID,
551			"session_key": rc.SessionKey,
552			"reply_ctx":   rc.ReplyCtx,
553			"content":     content,
554		}); err != nil {
555			a.previewMu.Lock()
556			delete(a.previewRequests, refID)
557			a.previewMu.Unlock()
558			return nil, err
559		}
560	
561		select {
562		case handle := <-ch:
563			return newBridgeReplyCtx(a, rc.SessionKey, handle), nil
564		case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
565			a.previewMu.Lock()
566			delete(a.previewRequests, refID)
567			a.previewMu.Unlock()
568			return nil, fmt.Errorf("bridge: preview_ack timeout")
569		case <-ctx.Done():
570			a.previewMu.Lock()
571			delete(a.previewRequests, refID)
572			a.previewMu.Unlock()
573			return nil, ctx.Err()
574		}
575	}

676	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
677	// WebSocket connection handling (on BridgeServer)
678	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
679	
680	// checkOrigin validates the WebSocket origin against CORS origins.
681	// In insecure mode, it allows all origins. Otherwise, it checks against CORS origins or same host.
682	func (bs *BridgeServer) checkOrigin(r *http.Request) bool {
683		// In insecure mode, allow all origins (for local development)
684		if bs.insecure {
685			return true
686		}
687	
688		origin := r.Header.Get("Origin")
689		if origin == "" {
690			// No origin header (e.g., non-browser client) - allow only if authenticated
691			// The authentication check happens before this, so we allow
692			return true
693		}
694	
695		// If CORS origins are configured, check against them
696		if len(bs.corsOrigins) > 0 {
697			for _, o := range bs.corsOrigins {
698				if o == "*" || o == origin {
699					return true
700				}
701			}
702			slog.Warn("bridge: websocket origin rejected", "origin", origin, "allowed", bs.corsOrigins)
703			return false
704		}
705	
706		// No CORS configured - require same-host (origin must match host)
707		host := r.Host
708		if host == "" {
709			host = r.URL.Host
710		}
711		// Parse origin to get host
712		if idx := strings.Index(origin, "://"); idx > 0 {
713			originHost := origin[idx+3:]
714			if originHost == host {
715				return true
716			}
717		}
718		slog.Warn("bridge: websocket origin mismatch", "origin", origin, "host", host)
719		return false
720	}
721	
722	func (bs *BridgeServer) handleWS(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
723		if !bs.authenticate(r) {
724			http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
725			return
726		}
727	
728		// Use a custom upgrader with origin checking
729		upgrader := websocket.Upgrader{
730			CheckOrigin: bs.checkOrigin,
731		}
732	
733		conn, err := upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
734		if err != nil {
735			slog.Error("bridge: websocket upgrade failed", "error", err)
736			return
737		}
738	
739		slog.Info("bridge: new connection", "remote", conn.RemoteAddr())
740		bs.handleConnection(conn)
741	}
742	
743	func (bs *BridgeServer) handleConnection(conn *websocket.Conn) {
744		defer conn.Close()
745	
746		if err := conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(90 * time.Second)); err != nil {
747			slog.Debug("bridge: set read deadline failed", "error", err)
748			return
749		}
750		conn.SetPongHandler(func(string) error {
751			return conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(90 * time.Second))
752		})
753	
754		// First message must be "register"
755		_, raw, err := conn.ReadMessage()
756		if err != nil {
757			slog.Error("bridge: read register failed", "error", err)
758			return
759		}
760	
761		var reg bridgeRegister
762		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &reg); err != nil || reg.Type != "register" {
763			if err := writeJSON(conn, nil, map[string]any{"type": "register_ack", "ok": false, "error": "first message must be register"}); err != nil {
764				slog.Debug("bridge: write register ack failed", "error", err)
765			}
766			return
767		}
768	
769		if reg.Platform == "" {
770			if err := writeJSON(conn, nil, map[string]any{"type": "register_ack", "ok": false, "error": "platform name is required"}); err != nil {
771				slog.Debug("bridge: write register ack failed", "error", err)
772			}
773			return
774		}
775	
776		caps := make(map[string]bool, len(reg.Capabilities))
777		for _, c := range reg.Capabilities {
778			caps[c] = true
779		}
780		caps["text"] = true
781	
782		adapter := &bridgeAdapter{
783			platform:        reg.Platform,
784			capabilities:    caps,
785			metadata:        reg.Metadata,
786			conn:            conn,
787			server:          bs,
788			previewRequests: make(map[string]chan string),
789		}
790	
791		bs.mu.Lock()
792		if old, exists := bs.adapters[reg.Platform]; exists {
793			old.conn.Close()
794			slog.Info("bridge: replaced existing adapter", "platform", reg.Platform)
795		}
796		bs.adapters[reg.Platform] = adapter
797		bs.mu.Unlock()
798	
799		if err := writeJSON(conn, &adapter.writeMu, map[string]any{"type": "register_ack", "ok": true}); err != nil {
800			slog.Debug("bridge: write register ack failed", "error", err)
801			return
802		}
803	
804		if bridgeMetadataStringListContains(reg.Metadata, "control_plane", bridgeCapabilitiesSnapshotProto) {
805			if err := writeJSON(conn, &adapter.writeMu, bs.buildCapabilitiesSnapshot()); err != nil {
806				slog.Debug("bridge: write capabilities snapshot failed", "platform", reg.Platform, "error", err)
807				return
808			}
809		}
810	
811		slog.Info("bridge: adapter registered", "platform", reg.Platform, "capabilities", reg.Capabilities)
812	
813		defer func() {
814			bs.mu.Lock()
815			if bs.adapters[reg.Platform] == adapter {
816				delete(bs.adapters, reg.Platform)
817			}
818			bs.mu.Unlock()
819			slog.Info("bridge: adapter disconnected", "platform", reg.Platform)
820		}()
821	
822		for {
823			if err := conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(90 * time.Second)); err != nil {
824				slog.Debug("bridge: set read deadline failed", "platform", reg.Platform, "error", err)
825				return
826			}
827			_, raw, err := conn.ReadMessage()
828			if err != nil {
829				if websocket.IsUnexpectedCloseError(err, websocket.CloseGoingAway, websocket.CloseNormalClosure) {
830					slog.Debug("bridge: read error", "platform", reg.Platform, "error", err)
831				}
832				return
833			}
834	
835			var base bridgeMsg
836			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &base); err != nil {
837				slog.Debug("bridge: invalid JSON", "platform", reg.Platform, "error", err)
838				continue
839			}
840	
841			switch base.Type {
842			case "message":
843				adapter.handleMessage(raw)
844			case "card_action":
845				adapter.handleCardAction(raw)
846			case "preview_ack":
847				adapter.handlePreviewAck(raw)
848			case "ping":
849				if err := writeJSON(conn, &adapter.writeMu, map[string]any{"type": "pong", "ts": time.Now().UnixMilli()}); err != nil {
850					slog.Debug("bridge: write pong failed", "platform", reg.Platform, "error", err)
851					return
852				}
853			default:
854				slog.Debug("bridge: unknown message type", "platform", reg.Platform, "type", base.Type)
855			}
856		}
857	}
858	
859	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
860	// Adapter message handlers
861	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
862	
863	func (a *bridgeAdapter) handleMessage(raw json.RawMessage) {
864		var m bridgeMessage
865		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &m); err != nil {
866			slog.Debug("bridge: invalid message payload", "error", err)
867			return
868		}
869	
870		if m.SessionKey == "" || m.UserID == "" {
871			slog.Debug("bridge: message missing required fields", "platform", a.platform)
872			return
873		}
874	
875		ref := a.server.resolveEngine(m.SessionKey, m.Project)
876		if ref == nil {
877			slog.Warn("bridge: no engine for session", "platform", a.platform, "session_key", m.SessionKey, "project", m.Project)
878			return
879		}
880	
881		msg := &Message{
882			SessionKey: m.SessionKey,
883			Platform:   a.platform,
884			MessageID:  m.MsgID,
885			UserID:     m.UserID,
886			UserName:   m.UserName,
887			Content:    m.Content,
888			ReplyCtx:   newBridgeReplyCtx(a, m.SessionKey, m.ReplyCtx),
889		}
890	
891		for _, img := range m.Images {
892			data, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(img.Data)
893			if err != nil {
894				slog.Debug("bridge: invalid image base64", "error", err)
895				continue
896			}
897			msg.Images = append(msg.Images, ImageAttachment{
898				MimeType: img.MimeType, Data: data, FileName: img.FileName,
899			})
900		}
901	
902		for _, f := range m.Files {
903			data, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(f.Data)
904			if err != nil {
905				slog.Debug("bridge: invalid file base64", "error", err)
906				continue
907			}
908			msg.Files = append(msg.Files, FileAttachment{
909				MimeType: f.MimeType, Data: data, FileName: f.FileName,
910			})
911		}
912	
913		if m.Audio != nil {
914			if data, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(m.Audio.Data); err == nil {
915				msg.Audio = &AudioAttachment{
916					MimeType: m.Audio.MimeType, Data: data,
917					Format: m.Audio.Format, Duration: m.Audio.Duration,
918				}
919			}
920		}
921	
922		slog.Info("bridge: message received",
923			"platform", a.platform, "session_key", m.SessionKey,
924			"user", m.UserID, "content_len", len(m.Content),
925		)
926	
927		if ref.platform.handler != nil {
928			ref.platform.handler(ref.platform, msg)
929		}
930	}
931	
932	func (a *bridgeAdapter) handleCardAction(raw json.RawMessage) {
933		var ca bridgeCardAction
934		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &ca); err != nil {
935			slog.Debug("bridge: invalid card_action payload", "error", err)
936			return
937		}
938	
939		slog.Debug("bridge: card_action", "platform", a.platform, "action", ca.Action, "session_key", ca.SessionKey, "project", ca.Project)
940	
941		ref := a.server.resolveEngine(ca.SessionKey, ca.Project)
942		if ref == nil {
943			return
944		}
945	
946		// perm: — permission response; convert to a regular message for the engine
947		if strings.HasPrefix(ca.Action, "perm:") {
948			var responseText string
949			switch ca.Action {
950			case "perm:allow":
951				responseText = "allow"
952			case "perm:deny":
953				responseText = "deny"
954			case "perm:allow_all":
955				responseText = "allow all"
956			default:
957				return
958			}
959			a.dispatchAsMessage(ref, ca.SessionKey, ca.ReplyCtx, responseText)
960			return
961		}
962	
963		// askq: — AskUserQuestion answer; forward as a regular message
964		if strings.HasPrefix(ca.Action, "askq:") {
965			a.dispatchAsMessage(ref, ca.SessionKey, ca.ReplyCtx, ca.Action)
966			return
967		}
968	
969		// cmd: — command shortcut from a card button; forward as a message
970		if strings.HasPrefix(ca.Action, "cmd:") {
971			cmdText := strings.TrimPrefix(ca.Action, "cmd:")
972			a.dispatchAsMessage(ref, ca.SessionKey, ca.ReplyCtx, cmdText)
973			return
974		}
975	
976		// nav: / act: — card navigation and in-place updates
977		if ref.platform.navHandler == nil {
978			return
979		}
980	
981		card := ref.platform.navHandler(ca.Action, ca.SessionKey)
982		if card == nil {
983			return
984		}
985	
986		if a.capabilities["card"] {
987			_ = a.server.sendToAdapter(a.platform, map[string]any{
988				"type":        "card",
989				"session_key": ca.SessionKey,
990				"reply_ctx":   ca.ReplyCtx,
991				"card":        serializeCard(card),
992			})
993		} else {
994			rc := newBridgeReplyCtx(a, ca.SessionKey, ca.ReplyCtx)
995			_ = ref.platform.Reply(context.Background(), rc, card.RenderText())
996		}
997	}
998	
999	// dispatchAsMessage converts a card action into a regular user message
1000	// and dispatches it to the engine's message handler.
1001	func (a *bridgeAdapter) dispatchAsMessage(ref *bridgeEngineRef, sessionKey, replyCtx, content string) {
1002		if ref.platform.handler == nil {
1003			return
1004		}
1005		msg := &Message{
1006			SessionKey: sessionKey,
1007			Platform:   a.platform,
1008			UserID:     "web-admin",
1009			UserName:   "Web Admin",
1010			Content:    content,
1011			ReplyCtx:   newBridgeReplyCtx(a, sessionKey, replyCtx),
1012		}
1013		go ref.platform.handler(ref.platform, msg)
1014	}
1015	
1016	func (a *bridgeAdapter) handlePreviewAck(raw json.RawMessage) {
1017		var ack bridgePreviewAck
1018		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &ack); err != nil {
1019			return
1020		}
1021	
1022		a.previewMu.Lock()
1023		ch, ok := a.previewRequests[ack.RefID]
1024		if ok {
1025			delete(a.previewRequests, ack.RefID)
1026		}
1027		a.previewMu.Unlock()
1028	
1029		if ok {
1030			ch <- ack.PreviewHandle
1031		}
1032	}

1034	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1035	// Session management REST API (on BridgeServer)
1036	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1037	
1038	// authHTTP wraps an HTTP handler with token authentication.
1039	func (bs *BridgeServer) authHTTP(handler http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc {
1040		return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
1041			if !bs.authenticate(r) {
1042				bridgeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
1043				return
1044			}
1045			handler(w, r)
1046		}
1047	}
1048	
1049	func bridgeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
1050		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
1051		w.WriteHeader(status)

1070	// handleSessions handles GET /bridge/sessions and POST /bridge/sessions.
1071	func (bs *BridgeServer) handleSessions(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
1072		switch r.Method {
1073		case http.MethodGet:
1074			sessionKey := r.URL.Query().Get("session_key")
1075			if sessionKey == "" {
1076				bridgeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "session_key query parameter is required")
1077				return
1078			}
1079			project := r.URL.Query().Get("project")
1080			ref := bs.resolveEngineForSessionKey(sessionKey, project)
1081			if ref == nil {
1082				bridgeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "no engine found for session key")
1083				return
1084			}
1085	
1086			sessions := ref.engine.sessions.ListSessions(sessionKey)
1087			activeID := ref.engine.sessions.ActiveSessionID(sessionKey)
1088	
1089			list := make([]map[string]any, len(sessions))
1090			for i, s := range sessions {
1091				list[i] = map[string]any{
1092					"id":            s.ID,
1093					"name":          s.GetName(),
1094					"history_count": len(s.History),
1095				}
1096			}
1097	
1098			bridgeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
1099				"sessions":          list,
1100				"active_session_id": activeID,
1101			})
1102	
1103		case http.MethodPost:
1104			var body struct {
1105				SessionKey string `json:"session_key"`
1106				Name       string `json:"name"`
1107				Project    string `json:"project,omitempty"`
1108			}
1109			if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
1110				bridgeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid JSON: "+err.Error())
1111				return
1112			}
1113			if body.SessionKey == "" {
1114				bridgeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "session_key is required")
1115				return
1116			}
1117			ref := bs.resolveEngineForSessionKey(body.SessionKey, body.Project)
1118			if ref == nil {
1119				bridgeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "no engine found for session key")
1120				return
1121			}
1122			name := body.Name
1123			if name == "" {
1124				name = "default"
1125			}
1126			s := ref.engine.sessions.NewSession(body.SessionKey, name)
1127			bridgeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
1128				"id":      s.ID,
1129				"name":    s.GetName(),
1130				"message": "session created",
1131			})
1132	
1133		default:
1134			bridgeError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "GET or POST only")
1135		}
1136	}

1138	// handleSessionRoutes dispatches /bridge/sessions/{sub} routes.
1139	func (bs *BridgeServer) handleSessionRoutes(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
1140		sub := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/bridge/sessions/")
1141		if sub == "" {
1142			bridgeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "session id required")
1143			return
1144		}
1145	
1146		// POST /bridge/sessions/switch
1147		if sub == "switch" {
1148			bs.handleSessionSwitch(w, r)
1149			return
1150		}
1151	
1152		// GET or DELETE /bridge/sessions/{id}
1153		sessionKey := r.URL.Query().Get("session_key")
1154		if sessionKey == "" {
1155			bridgeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "session_key query parameter is required")
1156			return
1157		}
1158		project := r.URL.Query().Get("project")
1159		ref := bs.resolveEngineForSessionKey(sessionKey, project)
1160		if ref == nil {
1161			bridgeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "no engine found for session key")
1162			return
1163		}
1164	
1165		switch r.Method {
1166		case http.MethodGet:
1167			s := ref.engine.sessions.FindByID(sub)
1168			if s == nil {
1169				bridgeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "session not found")
1170				return
1171			}
1172			histLimit := 50
1173			if v := r.URL.Query().Get("history_limit"); v != "" {
1174				if n, err := strconv.Atoi(v); err == nil && n > 0 {
1175					histLimit = n
1176				}
1177			}
1178			hist := s.GetHistory(histLimit)
1179			histJSON := make([]map[string]any, len(hist))
1180			for i, h := range hist {
1181				histJSON[i] = map[string]any{
1182					"role":    h.Role,
1183					"content": h.Content,
1184				}
1185			}
1186			bridgeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
1187				"id":      s.ID,
1188				"name":    s.GetName(),
1189				"history": histJSON,
1190			})
1191	
1192		case http.MethodDelete:
1193			if ref.engine.sessions.DeleteByID(sub) {
1194				bridgeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"message": "session deleted"})
1195			} else {
1196				bridgeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "session not found")
1197			}
1198	
1199		default:
1200			bridgeError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "GET or DELETE only")
1201		}
1202	}

1204	// handleSessionSwitch handles POST /bridge/sessions/switch.
1205	func (bs *BridgeServer) handleSessionSwitch(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
1206		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
1207			bridgeError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "POST only")
1208			return
1209		}
1210		var body struct {
1211			SessionKey string `json:"session_key"`
1212			Target     string `json:"target"`
1213			Project    string `json:"project,omitempty"`
1214		}
1215		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
1216			bridgeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid JSON: "+err.Error())
1217			return
1218		}
1219		if body.SessionKey == "" || body.Target == "" {
1220			bridgeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "session_key and target are required")
1221			return
1222		}
1223		ref := bs.resolveEngineForSessionKey(body.SessionKey, body.Project)
1224		if ref == nil {
1225			bridgeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "no engine found for session key")
1226			return
1227		}
1228		s, err := ref.engine.sessions.SwitchSession(body.SessionKey, body.Target)
1229		if err != nil {
1230			bridgeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
1231			return
1232		}
1233		bridgeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
1234			"message":           "session switched",
1235			"active_session_id": s.ID,
1236		})
1237	}

1243	func (bs *BridgeServer) authenticate(r *http.Request) bool {
1244		// If token is not set, only allow in insecure mode
1245		if bs.token == "" {
1246			return bs.insecure
1247		}
1248		if auth := r.Header.Get("Authorization"); auth != "" {
1249			if strings.HasPrefix(auth, "Bearer ") {
1250				return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(auth[7:]), []byte(bs.token)) == 1
1251			}
1252		}
1253		if tok := r.Header.Get("X-Bridge-Token"); tok != "" {
1254			return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(tok), []byte(bs.token)) == 1
1255		}
1256		if tok := r.URL.Query().Get("token"); tok != "" {
1257			return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(tok), []byte(bs.token)) == 1
1258		}
1259		return false
1260	}

1278	func bridgeMetadataStringListContains(metadata map[string]any, key, want string) bool {
1279		if metadata == nil || key == "" || want == "" {
1280			return false
1281		}
1282		raw, ok := metadata[key]
1283		if !ok {
1284			return false
1285		}
1286		items, ok := raw.([]any)
1287		if !ok {
1288			if stringsList, ok := raw.([]string); ok {
1289				for _, item := range stringsList {
1290					if strings.TrimSpace(item) == want {
1291						return true
1292					}
1293				}
1294			}
1295			return false
1296		}
1297		for _, item := range items {
1298			if s, ok := item.(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(s) == want {
1299				return true
1300			}
1301		}
1302		return false
1303	}

1306		if idx := strings.Index(sessionKey, ":"); idx > 0 {

1310			bs.mu.RUnlock()

1318	// resolveEngine finds the engine to handle a message.
1319	// It first tries to match by project name, then by session_key ownership,
1320	// and finally falls back to the single-engine case.
1321	func (bs *BridgeServer) resolveEngine(sessionKey, project string) *bridgeEngineRef {
1322		bs.enginesMu.RLock()
1323		defer bs.enginesMu.RUnlock()
1324	
1325		if project != "" {
1326			if ref, ok := bs.engines[project]; ok {
1327				return ref
1328			}
1329		}
1330	
1331		if len(bs.engines) == 1 {
1332			for _, ref := range bs.engines {
1333				return ref
1334			}
1335		}
1336	
1337		// Try to find the engine that owns sessions for this key.
1338		for _, ref := range bs.engines {
1339			if sessions := ref.engine.sessions.ListSessions(sessionKey); len(sessions) > 0 {
1340				return ref
1341			}
1342		}
1343	
1344		return nil
1345	}

1349			mu.Lock()
1350			defer mu.Unlock()
1351		}
1352		return conn.WriteJSON(v)
1353	}

1355	// serializeCard converts a Card into a JSON-friendly map for the bridge protocol.
1356	func serializeCard(c *Card) map[string]any {
1357		result := make(map[string]any)
1358		if c.Header != nil {
1359			result["header"] = map[string]string{
1360				"title": c.Header.Title,
1361				"color": c.Header.Color,
1362			}
1363		}
1364		var elements []map[string]any
1365		for _, elem := range c.Elements {
1366			switch e := elem.(type) {
1367			case CardMarkdown:
1368				elements = append(elements, map[string]any{"type": "markdown", "content": e.Content})
1369			case CardDivider:
1370				elements = append(elements, map[string]any{"type": "divider"})
1371			case CardActions:
1372				var btns []map[string]any
1373				for _, b := range e.Buttons {
1374					btns = append(btns, map[string]any{
1375						"text": b.Text, "btn_type": b.Type, "value": b.Value,
1376					})
1377				}
1378				elements = append(elements, map[string]any{
1379					"type": "actions", "buttons": btns, "layout": string(e.Layout),
1380				})
1381			case CardNote:
1382				m := map[string]any{"type": "note", "text": e.Text}
1383				if e.Tag != "" {
1384					m["tag"] = e.Tag
1385				}
1386				elements = append(elements, m)
1387			case CardListItem:
1388				elements = append(elements, map[string]any{
1389					"type": "list_item", "text": e.Text,
1390					"btn_text": e.BtnText, "btn_type": e.BtnType, "btn_value": e.BtnValue,
1391				})
1392			case CardSelect:
1393				var opts []map[string]string
1394				for _, o := range e.Options {
1395					opts = append(opts, map[string]string{"text": o.Text, "value": o.Value})
1396				}
1397				elements = append(elements, map[string]any{
1398					"type": "select", "placeholder": e.Placeholder,
1399					"options": opts, "init_value": e.InitValue,
1400				})
1401			}
1402		}
1403		result["elements"] = elements
1404		return result
1405	}

346	function findModelTableHeader(lines: string[]): ModelTableHeader | undefined {
347	  for (const [index, line] of lines.entries()) {
348	    const headers = line.split(/\s+/);

359	export function parsePiModelList(output: string): AvailableModelInfo[] {
360	  const lines = output

92	// ============================================================================
93	// Session Key Resolution
94	// ============================================================================
95	
96	/**
97	 * Resolve a session key from an inbound message source.
98	 * @param agentId - Optional agent ID (defaults to legacy AGENT_ID for backward compatibility)
99	 */
100	export function resolveSessionKey(source: MessageSource, config: Config, agentId?: string): SessionKey {
101	  const { channel, accountId, chatType, chatId, threadId, topicId } = source;
102	  const resolvedAgentId = agentId ?? AGENT_ID;
103	
104	  // DM routing
105	  if (chatType === "dm") {
106	    return resolveDmSessionKey(source, config, resolvedAgentId);
107	  }
108	
109	  // Group / channel / thread routing
110	  let key = `agent:${resolvedAgentId}:${channel}`;
111	  if (channel === "telegram") {
112	    key += `:account:${accountId ?? "default"}`;
113	  }
114	
115	  if (chatType === "group") {
116	    key += `:group:${chatId}`;
117	    if (topicId) {
118	      key += `:topic:${topicId}`;
119	    }
120	  } else if (chatType === "channel") {
121	    key += `:channel:${chatId}`;
122	    if (threadId) {
123	      key += `:thread:${threadId}`;
124	    }
125	  } else if (chatType === "thread") {
126	    key += `:channel:${chatId}:thread:${threadId ?? chatId}`;
127	  }
128	
129	  return key;
130	}
131	
132	/**
133	 * Resolve DM session key based on dmScope config.
134	 * @param agentId - Agent ID for the session key
135	 */
136	function resolveDmSessionKey(source: MessageSource, config: Config, agentId: string = AGENT_ID): SessionKey {
137	  const { dmScope } = config.session;
138	  const { channel, accountId, senderId } = source;
139	  const accountPart = channel === "telegram" ? `:account:${accountId ?? "default"}` : "";
140	
141	  switch (dmScope) {
142	    case "main":
143	      // All DMs collapse to the main session (OpenClaw default)
144	      return channel === "telegram"
145	        ? `agent:${agentId}:${channel}${accountPart}:main`
146	        : `agent:${agentId}:main:main`;
147	
148	    case "per-peer":
149	      return channel === "telegram"
150	        ? `agent:${agentId}:${channel}${accountPart}:dm:${senderId}`
151	        : `agent:${agentId}:dm:${senderId}`;
152	
153	    case "per-channel-peer":
154	      return `agent:${agentId}:${channel}${accountPart}:dm:${senderId}`;
155	
156	    case "per-account-channel-peer": {
157	      const genericAccountPart = accountId ? `:account:${accountId}` : "";
158	      const scopedAccountPart = channel === "telegram" ? accountPart : genericAccountPart;
159	      return `agent:${agentId}:${channel}${scopedAccountPart}:dm:${senderId}`;
160	    }
161	
162	    default:
163	      return channel === "telegram"
164	        ? `agent:${agentId}:${channel}${accountPart}:main`
165	        : `agent:${agentId}:main:main`;
166	  }
167	}

173	/**
174	 * Resolve the role for a session based on channel configuration.
175	 *
176	 * Priority (most specific first):
177	 *   1. Discord guild channel-level role
178	 *   2. Discord guild-level role
179	 *   3. Telegram topic-level role
180	 *   4. Telegram group-level role
181	 *   5. Channel-level default role
182	 *   6. Global default (null → use default role from role-persona)
183	 */
184	export function resolveRoleForSessionDetailed(source: MessageSource, config: Config): RoleResolution {
185	  const { channel, accountId, chatType, chatId, guildId, topicId } = source;
186	
187	  // Discord: check guild > channel hierarchy
188	  if (channel === "discord" && config.channels.discord) {
189	    const dc = config.channels.discord as any;
190	    if (guildId && dc.guilds?.[guildId]) {
191	      const guild = dc.guilds[guildId];
192	      // Channel-level role
193	      if (chatId && guild.channels?.[chatId]?.role) {
194	        return { role: guild.channels[chatId].role, source: "discord.channel" };
195	      }
196	      // Guild-level role
197	      if (guild.role) return { role: guild.role, source: "discord.guild" };
198	    }
199	    if (dc.role) return { role: dc.role, source: "discord.channel-default" };
200	  }
201	
202	  // Telegram: check topic > group > account > channel hierarchy
203	  if (channel === "telegram" && config.channels.telegram) {
204	    const tg = config.channels.telegram as any;
205	    const accountCfg = accountId ? tg.accounts?.[accountId] : undefined;
206	    const groups = accountCfg?.groups ?? tg.groups;
207	
208	    if (chatType === "group" && topicId) {
209	      const groupTopicRole = groups?.[chatId]?.topics?.[topicId]?.role;
210	      if (groupTopicRole) return { role: groupTopicRole, source: "telegram.topic" };
211	
212	      const wildcardGroupTopicRole = groups?.["*"]?.topics?.[topicId]?.role;
213	      if (wildcardGroupTopicRole) return { role: wildcardGroupTopicRole, source: "telegram.topic-wildcard" };
214	    }
215	
216	    if (chatType === "group" && groups?.[chatId]?.role) {
217	      return { role: groups[chatId].role, source: "telegram.group" };
218	    }
219	    if (chatType === "group" && groups?.["*"]?.role) {
220	      return { role: groups["*"].role, source: "telegram.group-wildcard" };
221	    }
222	    if (accountCfg?.role) return { role: accountCfg.role, source: "telegram.account" };
223	    if (tg.role) return { role: tg.role, source: "telegram.channel-default" };
224	  }
225	
226	  // Generic channel-level role
227	  const channelConfig = config.channels[channel];
228	  if (channelConfig && typeof channelConfig === "object" && "role" in channelConfig) {
229	    return { role: (channelConfig as any).role ?? null, source: "channel-default" };
230	  }
231	
232	  return { role: null, source: "default" };
233	}
234	
235	export function resolveRoleForSession(source: MessageSource, config: Config): string | null {
236	  return resolveRoleForSessionDetailed(source, config).role;
237	}

270	    const accountCfg = accountId ? tg.accounts?.[accountId] : undefined;
271	    const groups = accountCfg?.groups ?? tg.groups;

276

288	    if (tg.model) return { model: tg.model, source: "telegram.channel-default" };

296	  return { model: null, source: "default" };

418	// ============================================================================
419	// Agent Resolution (v3 Multi-Agent Routing)
420	// ============================================================================
421	
422	/**
423	 * Resolve which agent should handle this message.
424	 * Three-layer routing (first match wins):
425	 *   Layer 1: Static binding — config.agents.bindings[] match
426	 *   Layer 2: Prefix command — /{agentId} strips prefix
427	 *   Layer 3: Default agent
428	 */
429	export function resolveAgentRoute(
430	  source: MessageSource,
431	  text: string,
432	  config: Config,
433	): AgentRouteResolution {
434	  const agents = config.agents;
435	  if (!agents?.list?.length) {
436	    return { agentId: DEFAULT_AGENT_ID, text, source: "single-agent" };
437	  }
438	
439	  const agentIds = new Set(agents.list.map((a) => a.id));
440	
441	  // Layer 1: Static binding
442	  if (agents.bindings?.length) {
443	    const bound = matchBinding(source, agents.bindings);
444	    if (bound && agentIds.has(bound.agentId)) {
445	      return { agentId: bound.agentId, text, source: "binding", bindingScore: bound.score };
446	    }
447	  }
448	
449	  // Layer 2: Prefix command — /{agentId} <rest>
450	  const prefixMatch = text.match(/^\/(\S+)(?:\s+(.*))?$/s);
451	  if (prefixMatch) {
452	    const prefix = prefixMatch[1]!;
453	    if (agentIds.has(prefix)) {
454	      return { agentId: prefix, text: prefixMatch[2]?.trim() || "", source: "prefix" };
455	    }
456	  }
457	
458	  // Layer 3: Default
459	  return { agentId: agents.default || DEFAULT_AGENT_ID, text, source: "default" };
460	}
461	
462	export function resolveAgentId(
463	  source: MessageSource,
464	  text: string,
465	  config: Config,
466	): { agentId: string; text: string } {
467	  const resolved = resolveAgentRoute(source, text, config);
468	  return { agentId: resolved.agentId, text: resolved.text };
469	}
470	
471	/**
472	 * Static binding matcher (OpenClaw-aligned tiers via weighted score):
473	 * peer(8) > parentPeer(7) > guild+roles(6+4) > guild(4) > account(2) > channel(1).
474	 */
475	function matchBinding(
476	  source: MessageSource,
477	  bindings: NonNullable<Config["agents"]>["bindings"],
478	): { agentId: string; score: number } | null {
479	  if (!bindings) return null;
480	  let bestMatch: string | null = null;
481	  let bestScore = -1;
482	
483	  for (const binding of bindings) {
484	    const m = binding.match;
485	    let score = 0;
486	    let matched = true;
487	
488	    if (m.channel) {
489	      if (m.channel !== source.channel) { matched = false; continue; }
490	      score += 1;
491	    }
492	    if (m.accountId) {
493	      if (m.accountId !== source.accountId) { matched = false; continue; }
494	      score += 2;
495	    }
496	    if (m.guildId) {
497	      if (m.guildId !== source.guildId) { matched = false; continue; }
498	      score += 4;
499	    }
500	    if (m.roles?.length) {
501	      const memberRoles = source.memberRoleIds ?? [];
502	      const hasAnyRole = m.roles.some((role) => memberRoles.includes(role));
503	      if (!hasAnyRole) { matched = false; continue; }
504	      score += 6;
505	    }
506	    if (m.peer) {
507	      if (m.peer.kind && m.peer.kind !== source.chatType) { matched = false; continue; }
508	      if (m.peer.id && m.peer.id !== source.chatId && m.peer.id !== source.senderId) { matched = false; continue; }
509	      score += 8;
510	    }
511	    if (m.parentPeer) {
512	      const parent = source.parentPeer;
513	      if (!parent) { matched = false; continue; }
514	      if (m.parentPeer.kind && m.parentPeer.kind !== parent.kind) { matched = false; continue; }
515	      if (m.parentPeer.id && m.parentPeer.id !== parent.id) { matched = false; continue; }
516	      score += 7;
517	    }
518	
519	    if (matched && score > bestScore) {
520	      bestScore = score;
521	      bestMatch = binding.agentId;
522	    }
523	  }
524	  return bestMatch ? { agentId: bestMatch, score: bestScore } : null;
525	}

527	// ============================================================================
528	// Role → CWD Mapping (for pi --mode rpc process)
529	// ============================================================================
530	
531	import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
532	import { join } from "node:path";
533	import { homedir } from "node:os";
534	
535	/**
536	 * Get the CWD that maps to a role for the RPC process.
537	 * Also ensures the role mapping exists in role-persona's config.json.
538	 */
539	export function getCwdForRole(role: string, config: Config, agentId?: string): string {
540	  // 1) Explicit role->workspace mapping has highest priority
541	  const configured = config.roles.workspaceDirs?.[role];
542	  if (configured) {
543	    const resolved = configured.replace(/^~/, homedir());
544	    ensureDir(resolved);
545	    ensureRoleMapping(resolved, role, config);
546	    return resolved;
547	  }
548	
549	  // 2) Fallback to selected agent workspace (if configured)
550	  const agent = findAgentDefinition(config, agentId);
551	  if (agent?.workspace?.trim()) {
552	    const resolved = agent.workspace.replace(/^~/, homedir());
553	    ensureDir(resolved);
554	    ensureRoleMapping(resolved, role, config);
555	    return resolved;
556	  }
557	
558	  // 3) Default: ~/.pi/gateway/workspaces/{role}
559	  const defaultDir = join(homedir(), ".pi", "gateway", "workspaces", role);
560	  ensureDir(defaultDir);
561	  ensureRoleMapping(defaultDir, role, config);
562	  return defaultDir;
563	}
564	
565	/**
566	 * Ensure role-persona's config.json has a CWD → role mapping.
567	 * This allows pi's role-persona extension to auto-resolve the role from CWD.
568	 */
569	function ensureRoleMapping(cwd: string, role: string, config: Config): void {
570	  try {
571	    const rolesDir = resolveRolesDir(config);
572	    const roleConfigFile = join(rolesDir, "config.json");
573	    ensureDir(rolesDir);
574	
575	    let roleConfig: { mappings: Record<string, string>; defaultRole?: string; disabledPaths?: string[] };
576	
577	    if (existsSync(roleConfigFile)) {
578	      roleConfig = JSON.parse(readFileSync(roleConfigFile, "utf-8"));
579	    } else {
580	      roleConfig = { mappings: {}, defaultRole: "default" };
581	    }
582	
583	    if (!roleConfig.mappings) roleConfig.mappings = {};
584	
585	    // Only update if mapping doesn't exist or is different
586	    if (roleConfig.mappings[cwd] !== role) {
587	      roleConfig.mappings[cwd] = role;
588	      writeFileSync(roleConfigFile, JSON.stringify(roleConfig, null, 2), "utf-8");
589	    }
590	  } catch {
591	    // Non-fatal: role-persona will fall back to default role
592	  }
593	}
594	
595	export function resolveRolesDir(config: Config): string {
596	  const envRolesDir = process.env.PI_AGENT_ROLES_DIR?.trim();
597	  if (envRolesDir) return envRolesDir;
598	
599	  const runtimeAgentDir = config.agent.runtime?.agentDir?.trim();
600	  if (runtimeAgentDir) {
601	    return join(runtimeAgentDir.replace(/^~/, homedir()), "roles");
602	  }
603	  return join(homedir(), ".pi", "agent", "roles");
604	}
605	
606	function ensureDir(dir: string): void {
607	  if (!existsSync(dir)) {
608	    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
609	  }
610	}

25	async function rpcFileLog(clientId: string, direction: ">>>" | "<<<", line: string): Promise<void> {
26	  try {
27	    await ensureLogDir();
28	    const ts = new Date().toISOString();
29	    await appendFile(RPC_LOG_PATH, `${ts} [${clientId}] ${direction} ${line}\n`);
30	  } catch {
31	    // Non-critical — don't break RPC flow for log failures
32	  }

35	/** Bun Subprocess with piped stdio — we assert the types since Bun.spawn with "pipe" guarantees them */
36	interface PipedSubprocess {
37	  readonly pid: number;
38	  readonly exitCode: number | null;
39	  readonly exited: Promise<number>;
40	  readonly stdin: { write(data: string | Uint8Array): number; flush(): void; end(): void };
41	  readonly stdout: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>;
42	  readonly stderr: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>;
43	  kill(signal?: string): void;
44	}

50	export type RpcEventListener = (event: RpcWireEvent) => void;
51	
52	export interface RpcClientOptions {
53	  /** Path to pi CLI binary. Default: "pi" */
54	  piCliPath?: string;
55	  /** Working directory for the pi process */
56	  cwd?: string;
57	  /** Capability signature used for pool reuse isolation. */
58	  signature?: string;
59	  /** Hard constraint signature (role+cwd+tools+env). Must match exactly for reuse. */
60	  hardSignature?: string;
61	  /** Soft resources loaded into this process. Superset check for flexible reuse. */
62	  softResources?: { skills: string[]; extensions: string[]; promptTemplates: string[] };
63	  /** Environment variables to pass */
64	  env?: Record<string, string>;
65	  /** Additional CLI arguments */
66	  args?: string[];
67	}

69	interface PendingRequest {
70	  resolve: (response: RpcResponse) => void;
71	  reject: (error: Error) => void;
72	  timeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
73	}

79	export class RpcClient {
80	  readonly id: string;

94	   * Optional external handler for extension UI requests.
95	   * Return true if handled (forwarded to WS client), false to fall back to auto-cancel.

100	  constructor(
101	    id: string,
102	    private options: RpcClientOptions = {},
103	  ) {
104	    this.id = id;
105	    this.log = createLogger(`rpc:${id}`);
106	  }

108	  // ==========================================================================
109	  // Lifecycle
110	  // ==========================================================================
111	
112	  async start(): Promise<void> {
113	    if (this.proc) throw new Error("RPC client already started");
114	
115	    const piPath = this.options.piCliPath ?? "pi";
116	    // NOTE: We intentionally do NOT pass --no-session here.
117	    // Session persistence is controlled via --session-dir (set by rpc-pool).
118	    // This allows pi to write JSONL transcripts for debugging.
119	    const args = ["--mode", "rpc"];
120	    if (this.options.args) args.push(...this.options.args);
121	
122	    this.log.info(`Starting: ${piPath} ${args.join(" ")} (cwd: ${this.options.cwd ?? process.cwd()})`);
123	
124	    this.proc = Bun.spawn([piPath, ...args], {
125	      cwd: this.options.cwd,
126	      env: { ...process.env, ...this.options.env },
127	      stdin: "pipe",
128	      stdout: "pipe",
129	      stderr: "pipe",
130	    }) as PipedSubprocess;
131	
132	    // Collect stderr
133	    this.collectStderr();
134	
135	    // Start reading stdout lines
136	    this.startReadLoop();
137	
138	    // Wait for process to stabilize
139	    await Bun.sleep(200);
140	
141	    if (this.proc.exitCode !== null) {
142	      throw new Error(`pi process exited immediately (code ${this.proc.exitCode}). stderr: ${this.stderr}`);
143	    }
144	
145	    this.log.info("Started successfully");
146	  }
147	
148	  async stop(): Promise<void> {
149	    if (!this.proc) return;
150	
151	    this.log.info("Stopping...");
152	
153	    // Cancel pending requests
154	    for (const [id, pending] of this.pendingRequests) {
155	      clearTimeout(pending.timeout);
156	      pending.reject(new Error("RPC client stopping"));
157	      this.pendingRequests.delete(id);
158	    }
159	
160	    this.proc.kill("SIGTERM");
161	
162	    // Wait up to 2s, then force kill
163	    const exitPromise = this.proc.exited;
164	    const timeout = setTimeout(() => this.proc?.kill("SIGKILL"), 2000);
165	    await exitPromise;
166	    clearTimeout(timeout);
167	
168	    this.proc = null;
169	    this.readLoop = null;
170	    this.log.info("Stopped");
171	  }

205	  /**
206	   * Active health check — sends a lightweight RPC command and expects a response.
207	   * Detects zombie/hung processes that still have exitCode === null but are unresponsive.
208	   * Returns false if the process doesn't respond within timeoutMs.
209	   */
210	  async healthCheck(timeoutMs = 5_000): Promise<boolean> {
211	    if (!this.isAlive) return false;
212	    try {
213	      await Promise.race([
214	        this.getState(),
215	        new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
216	          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("health check timeout")), timeoutMs),
217	        ),
218	      ]);
219	      return true;
220	    } catch {
221	      return false;
222	    }
223	  }

234	    };

391	  /**
392	   * Wait for the agent to become idle (agent_end event).
393	   */
394	  waitForIdle(timeoutMs = 120_000): Promise<void> {
395	    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
396	      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
397	        unsub();
398	        reject(new Error(`Timeout waiting for agent_end (${timeoutMs}ms)`));
399	      }, timeoutMs);
400	
401	      const unsub = this.onEvent((event) => {
402	        if (event.type === "agent_end") {
403	          clearTimeout(timer);
404	          unsub();
405	          resolve();
406	        }
407	      });
408	    });
409	  }

411	  /**
412	   * Send prompt and collect the full assistant text.
413	   */
414	  async promptAndCollect(
415	    message: string,
416	    timeoutMs = 120_000,
417	    streamingBehavior?: "steer" | "followUp",
418	  ): Promise<string> {
419	    let text = "";
420	    const unsub = this.onEvent((event) => {
421	      if (event.type === "message_update") {
422	        const ame = (event as any).assistantMessageEvent as AssistantMessageEvent | undefined;
423	        if (ame?.type === "text_delta" && ame.delta) {
424	          text += ame.delta;
425	        }
426	      }
427	    });
428	
429	    await this.prompt(message, undefined, streamingBehavior);
430	    await this.waitForIdle(timeoutMs);
431	    unsub();
432	    return text;
433	  }

435	  // ==========================================================================
436	  // Internal
437	  // ==========================================================================
438	
439	  private async send(command: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<RpcResponse> {
440	    if (!this.proc) throw new Error("RPC client not started");
441	
442	    const id = `req_${++this.requestCounter}`;
443	    const fullCommand = { ...command, id };
444	
445	    this.lastActivity = Date.now();
446	
447	    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
448	      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
449	        this.pendingRequests.delete(id);
450	        reject(new Error(`RPC timeout for ${command.type} (30s). stderr: ${this.stderr.slice(-500)}`));
451	      }, 30_000);
452	
453	      this.pendingRequests.set(id, { resolve, reject, timeout });
454	
455	      const line = JSON.stringify(fullCommand) + "\n";
456	      // Debug: log command (truncate image data)
457	      const debugCmd = { ...fullCommand } as Record<string, unknown>;
458	      if (debugCmd.images && Array.isArray(debugCmd.images)) {
459	        debugCmd.images = (debugCmd.images as any[]).map((img: any) => ({
460	          ...img,
461	          data: img.data ? `[${img.data.length} chars]` : undefined,
462	        }));
463	      }
464	      this.log.info(`RPC send: ${JSON.stringify(debugCmd).slice(0, 500)}`);
465	      void rpcFileLog(this.id, ">>>", JSON.stringify(debugCmd));
466	
467	      if (!this.safeStdinWrite(line)) {
468	        this.pendingRequests.delete(id);
469	        clearTimeout(timeout);
470	        reject(new Error(`RPC stdin broken for ${command.type} (process likely crashed)`));
471	      }
472	    });
473	  }
474	
475	  private handleLine(line: string): void {
476	    if (!line.trim()) return;
477	    void rpcFileLog(this.id, "<<<", line);
478	
479	    try {
480	      const data = JSON.parse(line);
481	
482	      // Response to a pending request
483	      if (data.type === "response" && data.id && this.pendingRequests.has(data.id)) {
484	        const pending = this.pendingRequests.get(data.id)!;
485	        this.pendingRequests.delete(data.id);
486	        clearTimeout(pending.timeout);
487	
488	        if (!data.success) {
489	          pending.reject(new Error(data.error ?? `RPC error for ${data.command}`));
490	        } else {
491	          pending.resolve(data as RpcResponse);
492	        }
493	        return;
494	      }
495	
496	      // Auto-handle extension UI requests (headless mode)
497	      // pi extensions may request TUI interactions (select, confirm, input, etc.)
498	      // In headless/gateway mode we auto-respond to prevent hanging.
499	      if (data.type === "extension_ui_request") {
500	        this.handleExtensionUIRequest(data);
501	        // Still emit as event so listeners can observe
502	      }
503	
504	      // Agent event
505	      for (const listener of this.eventListeners) {
506	        try {
507	          listener(data as AgentEvent);
508	        } catch (err) {
509	          this.log.error("Event listener error:", err);
510	        }
511	      }
512	    } catch {
513	      // Non-JSON line (e.g. pi startup output) — ignore
514	    }
515	  }
516	
517	  /**
518	   * Auto-respond to extension UI requests in headless mode.
519	   *
520	   * pi extensions can emit these when they need user interaction:
521	   *   select   -> pick from options (auto: first option or cancel)
522	   *   confirm  -> yes/no (auto: confirm)
523	   *   input    -> text input (auto: cancel)
524	   *   editor   -> text editor (auto: cancel)
525	   *   notify   -> notification (no response needed, but we ack anyway)
526	   *   setStatus/setWidget/setTitle/set_editor_text -> UI updates (no response needed)
527	   */
528	  private handleExtensionUIRequest(data: Record<string, unknown>): void {
529	    const id = data.id as string;
530	    const method = data.method as string;
531	
532	    if (!id || !method) return;
533	
534	    // Try external handler first (WS forwarding to WebChat frontend)
535	    if (this.extensionUIHandler && this.proc) {
536	      const writeToRpc = (msg: string) => { this.proc?.stdin.write(msg + "\n"); };
537	      if (this.extensionUIHandler(data, writeToRpc)) return;
538	    }
539	
540	    // Fallback: auto-respond in headless mode
541	    let response: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
542	
543	    switch (method) {
544	      case "select": {
545	        // Auto-select first option if available, otherwise cancel
546	        const options = data.options as string[] | undefined;
547	        if (options && options.length > 0) {
548	          response = { type: "extension_ui_response", id, value: options[0] };
549	          this.log.debug(`Extension UI auto-select: "${options[0]}" (from ${options.length} options)`);
550	        } else {
551	          response = { type: "extension_ui_response", id, cancelled: true };
552	          this.log.debug("Extension UI auto-cancel select (no options)");
553	        }
554	        break;
555	      }
556	      case "confirm":
557	        // Auto-confirm
558	        response = { type: "extension_ui_response", id, confirmed: true };
559	        this.log.debug(`Extension UI auto-confirm: "${data.title}"`);
560	        break;
561	      case "input":
562	        // Cancel text input (can't type in headless mode)
563	        response = { type: "extension_ui_response", id, cancelled: true };
564	        this.log.debug(`Extension UI auto-cancel input: "${data.title}"`);
565	        break;
566	      case "editor":
567	        // Cancel editor (can't edit in headless mode)
568	        response = { type: "extension_ui_response", id, cancelled: true };
569	        this.log.debug(`Extension UI auto-cancel editor: "${data.title}"`);
570	        break;
571	      case "notify":
572	      case "setStatus":
573	      case "setWidget":
574	      case "setTitle":
575	      case "set_editor_text":
576	        // These are fire-and-forget UI updates, no response needed
577	        // But some implementations may still wait, so ack with cancel
578	        response = { type: "extension_ui_response", id, cancelled: true };
579	        break;
580	      default:
581	        // Unknown method — cancel to unblock
582	        response = { type: "extension_ui_response", id, cancelled: true };
583	        this.log.debug(`Extension UI auto-cancel unknown method: "${method}"`);
584	    }
585	
586	    if (response && this.proc) {
587	      this.safeStdinWrite(JSON.stringify(response) + "\n");
588	    }
589	  }
590	
591	  /**
592	   * Safe stdin write — catches broken pipe errors when process has died
593	   * between isAlive check and actual write.
594	   * Returns true if write succeeded, false if pipe is broken.
595	   */
596	  private safeStdinWrite(data: string): boolean {
597	    try {
598	      this.proc?.stdin.write(data);
599	      return true;
600	    } catch (err) {
601	      this.log.warn(`stdin write failed (process ${this.id} likely crashed): ${err}`);
602	      return false;
603	    }
604	  }
605	
606	  private startReadLoop(): void {
607	    if (!this.proc) return;
608	
609	    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
610	    let buffer = "";
611	    const stdout = this.proc.stdout;
612	
613	    this.readLoop = (async () => {
614	      const reader = (stdout as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>).getReader();
615	      try {
616	        while (true) {
617	          const { done, value } = await reader.read();
618	          if (done) break;
619	
620	          buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
621	          const lines = buffer.split("\n");
622	          buffer = lines.pop() ?? "";
623	
624	          for (const line of lines) {
625	            this.handleLine(line);
626	          }
627	        }
628	      } catch {
629	        // Stream closed
630	      }
631	
632	      if (buffer.trim()) {
633	        this.handleLine(buffer);
634	      }
635	    })();
636	  }
637	
638	  private collectStderr(): void {
639	    if (!this.proc) return;
640	
641	    const stderr = this.proc.stderr;
642	    (async () => {
643	      const reader = (stderr as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>).getReader();
644	      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
645	      try {
646	        while (true) {
647	          const { done, value } = await reader.read();
648	          if (done) break;
649	          this.stderr += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
650	          if (this.stderr.length > 10_000) {
651	            this.stderr = this.stderr.slice(-5_000);
652	          }

4	 * Design:

24	/** Check if `superset` contains all elements of `subset`. */
25	function isSuperset(superset: string[], subset: string[]): boolean {
26	  if (subset.length === 0) return true;

28	  return subset.every(s => set.has(s));

129	  async acquire(sessionKey: SessionKey, profile: CapabilityProfile, priority?: number): Promise<RpcClient> {

164	        if (!client.isIdle || !client.isAlive) continue;
165	        if (this.matchesProfile(client, profile)) {

171	          try {

179	        if (!hardCandidate && this.matchesHardProfile(client, profile)) {

190	        try {

195	        }

198	    } else {

200	    }
201	
202	    // At capacity?
203	    if (this.clients.size >= this.poolConfig.max) {
204	      // Evict the least recently used idle process
205	      const evicted = this.evictLeastRecentIdle();
206	      if (!evicted) {

602	    } catch (retryErr) {
603	      this.clients.delete(id);
604	      throw retryErr;
605	    }
606	
607	    return client;
608	  }
609	
610	  private evictLeastRecentIdle(): boolean {
611	    let oldest: RpcClient | null = null;
612	    for (const client of this.clients.values()) {
613	      if (client.isIdle && client.isAlive) {
614	        if (!oldest || client.lastActivity < oldest.lastActivity) {
615	          oldest = client;
616	        }
617	      }
618	    }
619	
620	    if (!oldest) return false;
621	
622	    this.log.debug(`Evicting idle process ${oldest.id}`);
623	    const evictedSessionKey = oldest.sessionKey;
624	    this.clients.delete(oldest.id);
625	    if (evictedSessionKey) {
626	      this.sessionBindings.delete(evictedSessionKey);
627	      this.onSessionEnd?.(evictedSessionKey);
628	    }
629	    oldest.stop().catch(() => {});
630	    this.metrics?.incProcessKill();
631	    return true;
632	  }
633	
634	  private async maintenance(): Promise<void> {
635	    // Guard against concurrent maintenance runs (if previous run takes >30s)
636	    if (this.maintenanceRunning) return;
637	    this.maintenanceRunning = true;
638	
639	    try {
640	      await this.maintenanceInner();
641	    } catch (err) {
642	      this.log.error("Maintenance error:", err);
643	    } finally {
644	      this.maintenanceRunning = false;
645	    }
646	  }
647	
648	  private async maintenanceInner(): Promise<void> {
649	    const now = Date.now();
650	    const idleTimeout = this.poolConfig.idleTimeoutMs;
651	    const crashedSessions: { sessionKey: SessionKey; profile: CapabilityProfile }[] = [];
652	
653	    for (const [id, client] of this.clients) {
654	      // Remove dead processes
655	      if (!client.isAlive) {
656	        this.log.warn(`Process ${id} died, removing from pool`);
657	        const sessionKey = client.sessionKey;
658	        if (sessionKey) {
659	          this.sessionBindings.delete(sessionKey);
660	          // Collect crashed active sessions for recovery instead of just notifying end
661	          const profile = this.buildDefaultProfile();
662	          crashedSessions.push({ sessionKey, profile });
663	        }
664	        this.clients.delete(id);
665	        this.metrics?.incProcessCrash();
666	        continue;
667	      }
668	
669	      // Active health check for non-idle processes (detect hung/zombie)
670	      if (!client.isIdle && now - client.lastActivity > 60_000) {
671	        const healthy = await client.healthCheck(5_000);
672	        if (!healthy) {
673	          this.log.warn(`Process ${id} failed health check (hung/zombie), killing`);
674	          const sessionKey = client.sessionKey;
675	          await client.stop().catch(() => {});
676	          if (sessionKey) {
677	            this.sessionBindings.delete(sessionKey);
678	            const profile = this.buildDefaultProfile();
679	            crashedSessions.push({ sessionKey, profile });
680	          }
681	          this.clients.delete(id);
682	          this.metrics?.incProcessCrash();
683	          continue;
684	        }
685	      }
686	
687	      // Reclaim idle processes beyond min
688	      if (
689	        client.isIdle &&
690	        this.clients.size > this.poolConfig.min &&
691	        now - client.lastActivity > idleTimeout
692	      ) {
693	        this.log.debug(`Reclaiming idle process ${id} (idle ${Math.round((now - client.lastActivity) / 1000)}s)`);
694	        if (client.sessionKey) {
695	          this.sessionBindings.delete(client.sessionKey);
696	          this.onSessionEnd?.(client.sessionKey);
697	        }
698	        this.clients.delete(id);
699	        client.stop().catch(() => {});
700	        this.metrics?.incProcessKill();
701	      }
702	    }
703	
704	    // Crash recovery: attempt to respawn processes for active sessions
705	    for (const { sessionKey, profile } of crashedSessions) {
706	      try {
707	        this.log.info(`Attempting crash recovery for session ${sessionKey}`);
708	        const newClient = await this.spawnClientWithRetry(profile, sessionKey);
709	        newClient.sessionKey = sessionKey;
710	        this.sessionBindings.set(sessionKey, newClient.id);
711	        await this.initializeRpcState(newClient);
712	        this.log.info(`Crash recovery succeeded for ${sessionKey} → ${newClient.id}`);
713	      } catch (err) {
714	        this.log.error(`Crash recovery failed for ${sessionKey}: ${err}`);
715	        this.onSessionEnd?.(sessionKey);
716	      }
717	    }
718	
719	    // Ensure min processes
720	    while (this.clients.size < this.poolConfig.min) {
721	      try {
722	        await this.spawnClient(this.buildDefaultProfile());
723	      } catch (err) {
724	        this.log.error("Failed to spawn replacement process:", err);
725	        break;
726	      }
727	    }
728	  }
729	}

733	 */
734	export function stripModelArgs(args: string[]): string[] {
735	  const result: string[] = [];
736	  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
737	    if (args[i] === "--provider" || args[i] === "--model") {
738	      i++; // skip the value
739	      continue;
740	    }
741	    result.push(args[i]);
742	  }
743	  return result;
744	}
