```text
269	function mergeGatewayConfig(value: unknown): GatewayConfig {
270		if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) {
271			throw new Error("Gateway config must be a JSON object");
272		}
273		const parsed = value as Partial<GatewayConfig>;
274		const healthConfig = normalizeGatewayHealthConfig(parsed);
275		if (!healthConfig) throw new Error("Invalid gateway host, port, or tokens");
276		if (
277			parsed.security === null ||
278			(parsed.security !== undefined &&
279				(typeof parsed.security !== "object" || Array.isArray(parsed.security)))
280		) {
281			throw new Error("config.security must be an object");
282		}
283		if (
284			parsed.sessions === null ||
285			(parsed.sessions !== undefined &&
286				(typeof parsed.sessions !== "object" || Array.isArray(parsed.sessions)))
287		) {
288			throw new Error("config.sessions must be an object");
289		}
290	
291		const security: Partial<GatewayConfig["security"]> = parsed.security ?? {};
292		const sessions: Partial<GatewayConfig["sessions"]> = parsed.sessions ?? {};
293		const rateLimit: Partial<GatewayConfig["security"]["rateLimit"]> =
294			security.rateLimit ?? {};
295		const merged = {
296			...DEFAULT_CONFIG,
297			...parsed,
298			...healthConfig,
299			security: {
300				...DEFAULT_CONFIG.security,
301				...security,
302				rateLimit: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.security.rateLimit, ...rateLimit },
303			},
304			sessions: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.sessions, ...sessions },
305			platforms: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.platforms, ...(parsed.platforms ?? {}) },
306		} as GatewayConfig;
307	
308		if (!(["daily", "idle", "both"] as string[]).includes(merged.sessions.resetPolicy)) {
309			throw new Error("Invalid sessions.resetPolicy");
310		}
311		if (
312			!Number.isInteger(merged.sessions.dailyHour) ||
313			merged.sessions.dailyHour < 0 ||
314			merged.sessions.dailyHour > 23 ||
315			!Number.isFinite(merged.sessions.idleMinutes) ||
316			merged.sessions.idleMinutes <= 0
317		) {
318			throw new Error("Invalid session reset timing");
319		}
320		return merged;
321	}
322	
323	function loadConfig(): GatewayConfig {
324		try {
325			if (!existsSync(GATEWAY_CONFIG_FILE)) {
326				const packageRoot = getPackageRoot(import.meta.url);
327				const defaultConfigPath = join(
328					packageRoot,
329					"config",
330					"config.default.json",
331				);
332				if (existsSync(defaultConfigPath)) {
333					mkdirSync(GATEWAY_CONFIG_DIR, { recursive: true });
334					copyFileSync(defaultConfigPath, GATEWAY_CONFIG_FILE);
335					logger.info("[gateway] Seeded default config at", GATEWAY_CONFIG_FILE);
336				}
337			}
338			if (existsSync(GATEWAY_CONFIG_FILE)) {
339				return mergeGatewayConfig(
340					JSON.parse(readFileSync(GATEWAY_CONFIG_FILE, "utf-8")),
341				);
342			}
343		} catch (err) {
344			logger.error(
345				"[gateway] Failed to parse config file — using defaults. Error:",
346				err,
347			);
348		}
349		return mergeGatewayConfig({});
350	}
351	
352	// Token auth
353	function verifyToken(token: string): boolean {
354		if (config.tokens.length === 0) return true;
355		return config.tokens.includes(token);
356	}
357	
358	function authenticate(req: IncomingMessage): boolean {
359		const auth = req.headers.authorization;
360		if (!auth) return verifyToken("");
361		if (auth.startsWith("Bearer ")) return verifyToken(auth.slice(7));
362		return false;
363	}
364	
365	// WebSocket helpers
366	function sendWs(ws: WebSocket, msg: object): void {
367		if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
368			ws.send(JSON.stringify(msg));
369		}
370	}
371	
372	function broadcastClients(event: string, data: unknown): void {
373		for (const ws of state.clients.values()) {
374			sendWs(ws, { type: event, data });
375		}
376	}
377	
378	// RPC to pi agent
379	function createRpcProcess(): any {
380		const extensionPath = join(
381			getPackageRoot(import.meta.url),
382			"dist",
383			"extensions",
384			"pi-gateway-ask-user-rpc.js",
385		);
386		const proc = spawn(
387			"pi",
388			[
389				"--mode",
390				"rpc",
391				"--extension",
392				extensionPath,
393			],
394			{
395				stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
396				env: {
397					...process.env,
398					OLLAMA_HOST: process.env.OLLAMA_HOST || "localhost:11434",
399				},
400			},
401		);
402	
403		// Give the interactive bridge a way to write to pi's stdin
404		setStdinWriter((line: string) => {
405			if (proc.stdin?.writable) {
406				proc.stdin.write(line);
407			}
408		});
409	
410		let lineBuffer = "";
411		proc.stdout?.on("data", (data: Buffer) => {
412			lineBuffer += data.toString();
413			const lines = lineBuffer.split("\n");
414			// Keep the last (possibly incomplete) chunk in the buffer
415			lineBuffer = lines.pop() || "";
416	
417			for (const line of lines) {
418				if (!line) continue;
419				try {
420					const msg = JSON.parse(line);
421	
422					if (msg.id) {
423						const idx = pendingRequests.findIndex((r) => r.id === msg.id);
424						if (idx !== -1) {
425							const req = pendingRequests.splice(idx, 1)[0];
426							req.resolve(msg);
427						}
428					}
429	
430					// agent_end carries the full response — resolve pending completions
431					if (msg.type === "agent_end") {
432						const text = extractAgentEndText(msg);
433						logger.info(
434							`[gateway] agent_end received, text length: ${text.length}`,
435						);
436						const completion = pendingCompletions.shift();
437						if (completion) {
438							clearTimeout(completion.timer);
439							completion.resolve(text);
440						}
441						// Clean up any pending interactive prompts
442						cleanupPendingUiRequests();
443						setActiveChannel(null);
444					}
445	
446					// Handle extension UI requests (select, confirm, input, etc.)
447					if (msg.type === "extension_ui_request") {
448						const active = getActiveChannel();
449						if (active) {
450							const adapter = state.adapters.get(active.platform);
451							if (adapter) {
452								// Flush full accumulated text into the placeholder NOW
453								flushHandler?.();
454								handleExtensionUiRequest(msg, adapter).catch((err) => {
455									logger.error(
456										"[gateway] Failed to handle extension UI request:",
457										err,
458									);
459								});
460							}
461						}
462					}
463	
464					// Stream text deltas to active completion
465					if (
466						msg.type === "message_update" &&
467						msg.assistantMessageEvent?.type === "text_delta" &&
468						typeof msg.assistantMessageEvent.delta === "string"
469					) {
470						const completion = pendingCompletions[0];
471						if (completion?.onStream) {
472							completion.streamedText += msg.assistantMessageEvent.delta;
473							completion.onStream(completion.streamedText);
474						}
475					}
476	
477					// Broadcast events
478					if (msg.type === "response") {
479						broadcastClients("response", msg);
480					} else {
481						broadcastClients("event", msg);
482					}
483				} catch {
484					logger.debug("[gateway] Failed to parse RPC line:", line.slice(0, 200));
485				}
486			}
487		});
488	
489		proc.stderr?.on("data", (data: Buffer) => {
490			logger.info("[gateway] pi stderr:", data.toString().trim());
491		});
492	
493		proc.on("exit", (code: number) => {
494			logger.info("[gateway] pi process exited");
495			// Flush any remaining line in the buffer (could be a large agent_end)
496			if (lineBuffer.trim()) {
497				try {
498					const msg = JSON.parse(lineBuffer.trim());
499					if (msg.type === "agent_end") {
500						const text = extractAgentEndText(msg);
501						logger.info(
502							`[gateway] agent_end flushed from buffer on exit, text length: ${text.length}`,
503						);
504						const completion = pendingCompletions.shift();
505						if (completion) {
506							clearTimeout(completion.timer);
507							completion.resolve(text);
508						}
509					}
510				} catch {
511					logger.debug("[gateway] Unparseable data in stdout buffer on exit");
512				}
513			}
514			// Reject any remaining pending completions so they don't hang forever
515			while (pendingCompletions.length > 0) {
516				const completion = pendingCompletions.shift()!;
517				clearTimeout(completion.timer);
518				completion.reject(new Error(`pi process exited with code ${code}`));
519			}
520			// Clean up any pending interactive UI requests
521			cleanupPendingUiRequests();
522			setActiveChannel(null);
523			rpcProcess = null;
524			broadcastClients("agent_disconnected", { code });
525		});
526	
527		return proc;
528	}
529	
530	async function sendRpc(
531		command: string,
532		data: Record<string, unknown> = {},
533	): Promise<unknown> {
534		if (!rpcProcess) throw new Error("pi agent not running");
535	
536		const id = randomBytes(8).toString("hex");
537		const payload = { id, type: command, ...data };
538	
539		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
540			pendingRequests.push({ id, resolve, reject });
541	
542			try {
543				rpcProcess.stdin.write(JSON.stringify(payload) + "\n");
544			} catch (err) {
545				const idx = pendingRequests.findIndex((r) => r.id === id);
546				if (idx !== -1) pendingRequests.splice(idx, 1);
547				reject(err);
548			}
549	
550			setTimeout(() => {
551				const idx = pendingRequests.findIndex((r) => r.id === id);
552				if (idx !== -1) {
553					pendingRequests.splice(idx, 1);
554					reject(new Error("Request timeout"));
555				}
556			}, 30000);
557		});
558	}
559	
560	// Extract assistant response text from agent_end.messages
561	function extractAgentEndText(agentEndMsg: Record<string, unknown>): string {
562		const messages = agentEndMsg.messages as
563			| Array<Record<string, unknown>>
564			| undefined;
565		if (!messages) return "";
566	
567		const parts: string[] = [];
568		for (const msg of messages) {
569			if (msg.role === "assistant") {
570				const content = msg.content;
571				if (Array.isArray(content)) {
572					for (const block of content as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) {
573						if (block.type === "text" && typeof block.text === "string") {
574							parts.push(block.text as string);
575						}
576					}
577				}
578			}
579		}
580		return parts.join("\n");
581	}
582	
583	// Send a prompt to pi and wait for agent_end to get the full response text.
584	// Unlike sendRpc (which resolves with the ACK), this resolves with the
585	// actual assistant response text after the agent finishes processing.
586	// If onStream is provided, it is called with accumulated text as deltas arrive.
587	async function sendPromptRpc(
588		message: string,
589		onStream?: (text: string) => void,
590	): Promise<string> {
591		if (!rpcProcess) throw new Error("pi agent not running");
592	
593		// Send the prompt and wait for the ACK (so we know the prompt was accepted)
594		const ackResponse = await sendRpc("prompt", { message });
595		const ack = ackResponse as Record<string, unknown>;
596		if (!ack.success) {
597			throw new Error(`Prompt rejected: ${JSON.stringify(ackResponse)}`);
598		}
599	
600		logger.info("[gateway] Prompt ACK received, waiting for agent_end...");
601	
602		// Wait for agent_end to deliver the full response
603		const timeoutMs = config.promptTimeoutMs ?? 300000;
604		const minutes = Math.round(timeoutMs / 60000);
605		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
606			const timer = setTimeout(() => {
607				const idx = pendingCompletions.findIndex((c) => c.timer === timer);
608				if (idx !== -1) pendingCompletions.splice(idx, 1);
609				reject(
610					new Error(
611						`Prompt completion timeout — no agent_end received within ${minutes} minute${minutes === 1 ? "" : "s"}`,
612					),
613				);
614			}, timeoutMs);
615	
616			pendingCompletions.push({
617				resolve,
618				reject,
619				timer,
620				onStream,
621				streamedText: "",
622			});
623		});
624	}
625	
626	const adapterCallbacks: AdapterCallbacks = {
627		onMessage: async (message: PlatformMessage) => {
628			// Get or create session for this chat
629			const session = getOrCreateSession(
630				message.platform,
631				message.channelId,
632				message.userId,
633				{
634					resetPolicy: config.sessions.resetPolicy,
635					dailyHour: config.sessions.dailyHour,
636					idleMinutes: config.sessions.idleMinutes,
637				},
638			);
639	
640			// Check allowlist
641			if (!isUserAllowed(message.platform as Platform, message.userId)) {
642				logger.info(`[gateway] User ${message.userId} not in allowlist`);
643				const adapter = state.adapters.get(message.platform);
644				if (adapter) {
645					await adapter.sendMessage(
646						message.channelId,
647						"You are not allowed to use this agent. Contact the administrator to request access.",
648					);
649				}
650				return;
651			}
652	
653			// Store session reference
654			state.sessions.set(`${message.platform}:${message.channelId}`, session);
655	
656			// ── Admin/allowed model commands ──
657			const modelMatch = message.content.match(/^\/model(?:\s+(.+))?/i);
658			const modelCallback = message.content.match(/^Callback:\s*model:(.+)/i);
659	
660			if (
661				(modelMatch || modelCallback) &&
662				isUserAllowed(message.platform as Platform, message.userId)
663			) {
664				const adapter = state.adapters.get(message.platform);
665				if (!rpcProcess) {
666					if (adapter) {
667						await adapter.sendMessage(message.channelId, "Agent not running.");
668					}
669					return;
670				}
671	
672				// Handle callback from inline keyboard
673				if (modelCallback) {
674					const key = modelCallback[1].trim();
675					const [provider, modelId] = key.split("/");
676					if (!provider || !modelId) return;
677	
678					// Only admins can actually switch models
679					if (!isAdmin(message.platform as Platform, message.userId)) {
680						if (adapter) {
681							await adapter.sendMessage(
682								message.channelId,
683								"Only admins can switch models.",
684							);
685						}
686						return;
687					}
688	
689					try {
690						const result = (await sendRpc("set_model", {
691							provider,
692							modelId,
693						})) as {
694							success: boolean;
695							error?: string;
696							data?: { name: string };
697						};
698						if (result.success) {
699							const name = result.data?.name || `${provider}/${modelId}`;
700							if (adapter) {
701								await adapter.sendMessage(
702									message.channelId,
703									`✅ Model changed to ${name}`,
704								);
705							}
706							logger.info(
707								`[gateway] Admin ${message.userId} switched model to ${provider}/${modelId}`,
708							);
709						} else {
710							if (adapter) {
711								await adapter.sendMessage(
712									message.channelId,
713									`❌ Failed: ${result.error || "unknown"}`,
714								);
715							}
716						}
717					} catch (err) {
718						logger.error("[gateway] Model switch failed:", err);
719					}
720					return;
721				}
722	
723				const arg = (modelMatch?.[1] || "").trim().toLowerCase();
724	
725				// /model (no args) or /model list → show available models
726				if (!arg || arg === "list") {
727					try {
728						const result = (await sendRpc("get_available_models")) as {
729							success: boolean;
730							data?: {
731								models: Array<{
732									provider: string;
733									id: string;
734									name: string;
735								}>;
736							};
737						};
738						if (result.success && result.data) {
739							const models = result.data.models;
740	
741							// Try inline keyboard for Telegram
742							const telegram = adapter as unknown as {
743								sendButtons?: (
744									ch: string,
745									text: string,
746									btns: Array<Array<{ text: string; data: string }>>,
747								) => Promise<string>;
748							};
749							if (telegram?.sendButtons) {
750								const buttons = models.map((m) => [
751									{
752										text: `${m.name} (${m.provider})`,
753										data: `model:${m.provider}/${m.id}`,
754									},
755								]);
756								await telegram.sendButtons(
757									message.channelId,
758									"<b>Available models</b>\nTap to switch:",
759									buttons,
760								);
761							} else if (adapter) {
762								// Text fallback
763								const list = models
764									.map((m) => `• ${m.provider}/${m.id} — ${m.name}`)
765									.join("\n");
766								await adapter.sendMessage(
767									message.channelId,
768									`Available models:\n${list}\n\nUse \`/model provider/id\` to switch.`,
769								);
770							}
771						} else if (adapter) {
772							await adapter.sendMessage(
773								message.channelId,
774								"Could not retrieve model list.",
775							);
776						}
777					} catch (err) {
778						logger.error("[gateway] Failed to list models:", err);
779						if (adapter) {
780							await adapter.sendMessage(
781								message.channelId,
782								"Failed to retrieve model list.",
783							);
784						}
785					}
786					return;
787				}
788	
789				// /model provider/modelId — only admins can switch
790				if (!isAdmin(message.platform as Platform, message.userId)) {
791					if (adapter) {
792						await adapter.sendMessage(
793							message.channelId,
794							"Only admins can switch models. Use `/model` to see available models.",
795						);
796					}
797					return;
798				}
799	
800				const [provider, modelId] = arg.split("/");
801				if (!provider || !modelId) {
802					if (adapter) {
803						await adapter.sendMessage(
804							message.channelId,
805							"Usage: `/model provider/modelId`\n`/model` to see available models.",
806						);
807					}
808					return;
809				}
810	
811				try {
812					const result = (await sendRpc("set_model", {
813						provider,
814						modelId,
815					})) as { success: boolean; error?: string; data?: { name: string } };
816					if (result.success) {
817						const name = result.data?.name || `${provider}/${modelId}`;
818						if (adapter) {
819							await adapter.sendMessage(
820								message.channelId,
821								`✅ Model changed to ${name}`,
822							);
823						}
824						logger.info(
825							`[gateway] Admin ${message.userId} switched model to ${provider}/${modelId}`,
826						);
827					} else {
828						if (adapter) {
829							await adapter.sendMessage(
830								message.channelId,
831								`❌ Failed: ${result.error || "unknown"}`,
832							);
833						}
834					}
835				} catch (err) {
836					logger.error("[gateway] Failed to change model:", err);
837					if (adapter) {
838						await adapter.sendMessage(
839							message.channelId,
840							"Failed to change model.",
841						);
842					}
843				}
844				return;
845			}
846	
847			// ── Admin restart command ──
848			if (/^\/restart$/i.test(message.content.trim())) {
849				if (!isAdmin(message.platform as Platform, message.userId)) {
850					// Non-admin: let pi handle it as a normal prompt
851				} else if (IS_DAEMON) {
852					// In daemon mode: restart the entire gateway
853					const adapter = state.adapters.get(message.platform);
854					if (adapter) {
855						await adapter.sendMessage(
856							message.channelId,
857							"♻️ Restarting gateway daemon…",
858						);
859					}
860					// Send SIGHUP to self for graceful restart
861					process.kill(process.pid, "SIGHUP");
862					return;
863				} else {
864					const adapter = state.adapters.get(message.platform);
865					if (adapter) {
866						await adapter.sendMessage(
867							message.channelId,
868							"♻️ Restarting pi agent…",
869						);
870					}
871	
872					// Kill and restart the pi RPC process
873					if (rpcProcess) {
874						rpcProcess.kill();
875						rpcProcess = null;
876					}
877					// Reject any pending completions
878					while (pendingCompletions.length > 0) {
879						const c = pendingCompletions.shift()!;
880						clearTimeout(c.timer);
881						c.reject(new Error("Agent restarted by admin"));
882					}
883					rpcProcess = createRpcProcess();
884	
885					logger.info(`[gateway] Admin ${message.userId} restarted pi agent`);
886	
887					if (adapter) {
888						await adapter.sendMessage(
889							message.channelId,
890							"✅ Pi agent restarted.",
891						);
892					}
893					return;
894				}
895			}
896	
897			// Send to pi agent with tool policy guard
898			if (rpcProcess) {
899				const adapter = state.adapters.get(message.platform);
900				const guard = buildPolicyGuard(message.platform, message.userId);
901	
902				// Send an initial placeholder message so we can stream edits into it
903				let sentId: string | undefined;
904				if (adapter) {
905					try {
906						await adapter.setTyping(message.channelId, true);
907						sentId = await adapter.sendMessage(message.channelId, "⏳ Thinking…");
908					} catch {
909						// If sendMessage itself fails, don't even try to process
910						logger.error("[gateway] Failed to send initial placeholder message");
911						return;
912					}
913				}
914	
915				// Keep the typing indicator alive while waiting for a response.
916				// Telegram's typing action lasts ~5s, so send a heartbeat every 4s.
917				let typingInterval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
918				if (adapter) {
919					typingInterval = setInterval(() => {
920						adapter!.setTyping(message.channelId, true).catch(() => {});
921					}, 4000);
922				}
923	
924				// Track which channel triggered this prompt for UI request routing
925				setActiveChannel({
926					platform: message.platform,
927					channelId: message.channelId,
928				});
929	
930				let preText = "";
931	
932				// When extension_ui_request arrives (select prompt about to show),
933				// flush full accumulated text into the placeholder
934				setFlushHandler(() => {
935					if (!adapter) return;
936					const completion = pendingCompletions[0];
937					if (completion?.streamedText && sentId) {
938						preText = completion.streamedText;
939						adapter
940							.editMessage(message.channelId, sentId, completion.streamedText)
941							.catch(() => {});
942					}
943				});
944				// When user clicks (via handleInteractiveResponse), invalidate
945				// old placeholder and redirect to fresh message
946				setStreamRedirectHandler(() => {
947					if (!adapter) return;
948					const completion = pendingCompletions[0];
949					if (completion) completion.streamedText = "";
950					sentId = undefined;
951					adapter
952						.sendMessage(message.channelId, "⏳ Thinking…")
953						.then((newId) => {
954							sentId = newId;
955						})
956						.catch(() => {});
957				});
958	
959				try {
960					logger.info(
961						`[gateway] Sending prompt from ${message.platform}/${message.userId} (session: ${session.id.slice(0, 12)}...)`,
962					);
963	
964					// Stream deltas into the placeholder message, then wait for agent_end
965					let lastEditTime = 0;
966					const EDIT_THROTTLE_MS = 400; // max 2.5 edits/sec to avoid rate limits
967					const responseText = await sendPromptRpc(
968						`${guard}\n\n${message.content}`,
969						adapter && sentId
970							? (streamText: string) => {
971									const now = Date.now();
972									const currentId = sentId;
973									if (currentId && now - lastEditTime >= EDIT_THROTTLE_MS) {
974										lastEditTime = now;
975										adapter
976											.editMessage(message.channelId, currentId, streamText)
977											.catch(() => {});
978									}
979								}
980							: undefined,
981					);
982	
983					logger.info(
984						`[gateway] Response received, length: ${responseText.length}, sending back to ${message.platform}/${message.channelId}`,
985					);
986	
987					if (responseText && adapter) {
988						// Walk char-by-char to strip pre-question text from the full
989						// agent_end response when a flush happened
990						let finalText = responseText;
991						if (preText) {
992							let pos = 0;
993							while (
994								pos < preText.length &&
995								pos < responseText.length &&
996								preText[pos] === responseText[pos]
997							) {
998								pos++;
999							}
1000							if (pos >= preText.length) {
1001								finalText = responseText.slice(pos).trim();
1002							}
1003						}
1004						if (sentId) {
1005							await adapter.editMessage(message.channelId, sentId, finalText);
1006						} else {
1007							await adapter.sendMessage(message.channelId, finalText);
1008						}
1009						clearInterval(typingInterval);
1010						await adapter.setTyping(message.channelId, false);
1011						logger.info("[gateway] Response sent to platform successfully");
1012					} else if (!responseText && adapter) {
1013						logger.warn("[gateway] Response text was empty — nothing to send");
1014						if (sentId) {
1015							await adapter.editMessage(
1016								message.channelId,
1017								sentId,
1018								"I processed your message but had no text response. Please try again.",
1019							);
1020						} else {
1021							await adapter.sendMessage(
1022								message.channelId,
1023								"I processed your message but had no text response. Please try again.",
1024							);
1025						}
1026						clearInterval(typingInterval);
1027						await adapter.setTyping(message.channelId, false);
1028					}
1029				} catch (err) {
1030					logger.error("[gateway] RPC error processing message:", err);
1031					clearInterval(typingInterval);
1032					if (adapter) {
1033						try {
1034							const errorMsg =
1035								"Sorry, I encountered an error processing your message. Please try again.";
1036							if (sentId) {
1037								await adapter.editMessage(message.channelId, sentId, errorMsg);
1038							} else {
1039								await adapter.sendMessage(message.channelId, errorMsg);
1040							}
1041							await adapter.setTyping(message.channelId, false);
1042						} catch (sendErr) {
1043							logger.error("[gateway] Failed to send error message:", sendErr);
1044						}
1045					}
1046				}
1047			} else {
1048				logger.warn("[gateway] pi agent not running — cannot process message");
1049			}
1050		},
1051		onInteractiveResponse: (response: InteractiveResponse) => {
1052			handleInteractiveResponse(response);
1053		},
1054		onDisconnect: () => {
1055			logger.info("[gateway] Platform adapter disconnected");
1056			void updateStatus();
1057		},
1058	};

1161	// Cron job for background tasks and session cleanup
1162	function startCron(): void {
1163		cronInterval = setInterval(async () => {
1164			// Check for pending background results
1165			for (const session of state.sessions.values()) {
1166				const pending = getPendingResultsForSession(session.id);
1167				for (const task of pending) {
1168					// Deliver result to user via their platform
1169					const adapter = state.adapters.get(session.platform);
1170					if (adapter) {
1171						const resultText =
1172							task.status === "completed"
1173								? `✅ Background task completed:\n\`\`\`\n${JSON.stringify(task.result, null, 2)}\n\`\`\``
1174								: `❌ Background task failed:\n\`\`\`\n${task.error}\n\`\`\``;
1175	
1176						await adapter.sendMessage(session.channelId, resultText);
1177						markTaskDelivered(task.id);
1178					}
1179				}
1180			}
1181	
1182			// Touch active sessions
1183			for (const session of state.sessions.values()) {
1184				touchSession(session.id);
1185			}
1186		}, 60000); // Every 60 seconds (Hermes-style)
1187	}
1188	
1189	function stopCron(): void {
1190		if (cronInterval) {
1191			clearInterval(cronInterval);
1192			cronInterval = null;
1193		}
1194	}

1196	// HTTP handlers
1197	async function handleHttpRequest(
1198		req: IncomingMessage,
1199		res: ServerResponse,
1200	): Promise<void> {
1201		res.setHeader(
1202			"Access-Control-Allow-Origin",
1203			config.corsOrigins.join(",") || "*",
1204		);
1205		res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS");
1206		res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Authorization");
1207	
1208		if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
1209			res.writeHead(204);
1210			res.end();
1211			return;
1212		}
1213	
1214		// ── Telegram webhook (unauthenticated — called by Telegram) ──
1215		const url = new URL(req.url || "/", `http://${req.headers.host}`);
1216		if (url.pathname === "/webhook/telegram" && req.method === "POST") {
1217			const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
1218			req.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => chunks.push(chunk));
1219			req.on("end", async () => {
1220				try {
1221					const body = JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString());
1222					const telegram = state.adapters.get("telegram") as any;
1223					if (telegram?.handleWebhookUpdate) {
1224						await telegram.handleWebhookUpdate(body);
1225						res.writeHead(200);
1226						res.end("ok");
1227					} else {
1228						res.writeHead(503);
1229						res.end("Telegram adapter not running");
1230					}
1231				} catch {
1232					res.writeHead(400);
1233					res.end("Invalid request");
1234				}
1235			});
1236			return;
1237		}
1238	
1239		if (!authenticate(req)) {
1240			res.writeHead(401);
1241			res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unauthorized" }));
1242			return;
1243		}
1244	
1245		// API endpoints
1246		if (url.pathname === "/api/status" && req.method === "GET") {
1247			res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json" });
1248			res.end(
1249				JSON.stringify({
1250					running: state.running,
1251					mode: IS_DAEMON ? "daemon" : "inline",
1252					pid: process.pid,
1253					adapters: Array.from(state.adapters.keys()),
1254					clients: state.clients.size,
1255					sessions: state.sessions.size,
1256					agent: rpcProcess !== null,
1257				}),
1258			);
1259			return;
1260		}
1261	
1262		if (url.pathname === "/api/sessions" && req.method === "GET") {
1263			res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json" });
1264			res.end(JSON.stringify(listSessions()));
1265			return;
1266		}
1267	
1268		if (url.pathname === "/api/background" && req.method === "GET") {
1269			res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json" });
1270			res.end(JSON.stringify(listTasks()));
1271			return;
1272		}
1273	
1274		if (url.pathname === "/api/allowlist" && req.method === "GET") {
1275			res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json" });
1276			res.end(JSON.stringify(listAllowlistedUsers()));
1277			return;
1278		}
1279	
1280		if (url.pathname === "/api/pairing" && req.method === "GET") {
1281			res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json" });
1282			res.end(JSON.stringify(listPendingPairingCodes()));
1283			return;
1284		}
1285	
1286		res.writeHead(404);
1287		res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "Not found" }));
1288	}
1289	
1290	// WebSocket handler
1291	function handleWebSocket(ws: WebSocket, req: IncomingMessage): void {
1292		if (!authenticate(req)) {
1293			ws.close(1008, "Unauthorized");
1294			return;
1295		}
1296	
1297		const clientId = randomBytes(8).toString("hex");
1298		state.clients.set(clientId, ws);
1299	
1300		logger.info(`[gateway] WebSocket client connected: ${clientId}`);
1301	
1302		sendWs(ws, { type: "connected", data: { clientId } });
1303	
1304		ws.on("message", async (data) => {
1305			try {
1306				const msg = JSON.parse(data.toString());
1307	
1308				switch (msg.type) {
1309					case "prompt": {
1310						const result = await sendRpc("prompt", {
1311							message: msg.data?.message || "",
1312						});
1313						sendWs(ws, { type: "response", id: msg.id, data: result });
1314						break;
1315					}
1316					case "background": {
1317						const task = startBackgroundTask(
1318							msg.data?.sessionId || "default",
1319							msg.data?.command || "",
1320						);
1321						sendWs(ws, { type: "background_started", data: task });
1322						break;
1323					}
1324					case "ping": {
1325						sendWs(ws, { type: "pong", data: { time: Date.now() } });
1326						break;
1327					}
1328				}
1329			} catch (err) {
1330				sendWs(ws, { type: "error", data: { error: String(err) } });
1331			}
1332		});
1333	
1334		ws.on("close", () => {
1335			state.clients.delete(clientId);
1336			logger.info(`[gateway] WebSocket client disconnected: ${clientId}`);
1337		});
1338	}
1339	
1340	// Status update
1341	async function updateStatus(): Promise<void> {
1342		const ctx = globalCtx;
1343		if (!ctx) return;
1344	
1345		const generation = ++statusUpdateGeneration;
1346		const daemonPid = state.running ? null : readDaemonPid();
1347		const statusText = await resolveGatewayStatus({
1348			inlineRunning: state.running,
1349			adapterCount: state.adapters.size,
1350			daemonProcessRunning: daemonPid !== null,
1351			getDaemonHealth: () =>
1352				daemonPid === null ? Promise.resolve(null) : getDetachedGatewayHealth(daemonPid),
1353		});
1354	
1355		if (
1356			ctx !== globalCtx ||
1357			generation !== statusUpdateGeneration ||
1358			statusText === lastGatewayStatusText
1359		) {
1360			return;
1361		}
1362		lastGatewayStatusText = statusText;
1363		ctx.ui.setStatus("gateway", statusText);
1364	}
1365	
1366	function readDetachedHealthConfig(): GatewayConfig {
1367		try {
1368			const parsed = JSON.parse(readFileSync(GATEWAY_CONFIG_FILE, "utf-8"));
1369			const healthConfig = normalizeGatewayHealthConfig(parsed);
1370			if (!healthConfig) throw new Error("Invalid detached health configuration");
1371			lastDetachedHealthConfig = {
1372				...lastDetachedHealthConfig,
1373				...healthConfig,
1374			} as GatewayConfig;
1375		} catch {
1376			// Keep the last valid probe target during a partial or invalid config write.
1377		}
1378		return lastDetachedHealthConfig ?? config;
1379	}
1380	
1381	async function getDetachedGatewayHealth(pid: number) {
1382		return fetchGatewayHealth(readDetachedHealthConfig(), pid);
1383	}
1384	
1385	export default function (pi: ExtensionAPI) {
1386		config = loadConfig();
1387		lastDetachedHealthConfig = config;
1388		state = {
1389			running: false,
1390			adapters: new Map(),
1391			clients: new Map(),
1392			sessions: new Map(),
1393		};
1394	
1395		// Initialize stores
1396		initSessionStore();
1397		initSecurityStore();
1398		initBackgroundTasks();
1399	
1400		// Register commands
1401		pi.registerCommand("gateway", {
1402			description: "Manage Hermes-style messaging gateway",
1403			getArgumentCompletions: (prefix: string) => {
1404				const cmds = [
1405					"start",
1406					"start -d",
1407					"stop",
1408					"status",
1409					"restart",
1410					"pair",
1411					"allow",
1412					"revoke",
1413					"admin",
1414					"sessions",
1415					"tasks",
1416					"config",
1417					"tool-policy",
1418				];
1419				return cmds
1420					.filter((c) => c.startsWith(prefix))
1421					.map((c) => ({ value: c, label: c }));
1422			},
1423			handler: async (args, ctx) => {
1424				const parts = args.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
1425				const subcmd = parts[0]?.toLowerCase();
1426	
1427				switch (subcmd) {
1428					case "start": {
1429						const isDetached =
1430							parts.includes("-d") || parts.includes("--detached");
1431	
1432						if (isDetached) {
1433							const existingPid = readDaemonPid();
1434							if (existingPid !== null) {
1435								const existingHealth = await waitForGatewayHealth(
1436									readDetachedHealthConfig(),
1437									existingPid,
1438									1500,
1439								);
1440								if (existingHealth) {
1441									ctx.ui.notify(
1442										`Gateway daemon is already ${existingHealth.running ? "running" : "initializing"}.`,
1443										"info",
1444									);
1445									return;
1446								}
1447								ctx.ui.notify(
1448									`A live process owns the gateway PID file (PID ${existingPid}), but its daemon API is unavailable. Refusing to start another daemon.`,
1449									"error",
1450								);
1451								return;
1452							}
1453	
1454							// Spawn detached daemon
1455							const entryPoint = new URL("../dist/index.js", import.meta.url)
1456								.pathname;
1457							const child = spawn(process.execPath, [entryPoint, "--daemon"], {
1458								detached: true,
1459								stdio: "ignore",
1460								env: process.env,
1461							});
1462							child.unref();
1463							if (child.pid === undefined) {
1464								ctx.ui.notify("Failed to spawn gateway daemon", "error");
1465								return;
1466							}
1467	
1468							const startedHealth = await waitForGatewayHealth(
1469								readDetachedHealthConfig(),
1470								child.pid,
1471								5000,
1472							);
1473							if (!startedHealth) {
1474								ctx.ui.notify(
1475									`Gateway daemon spawn could not be verified (PID ${child.pid}). Check the gateway log.`,
1476									"error",
1477								);
1478								return;
1479							}
1480	
1481							ctx.ui.notify(
1482								`🔌 Gateway daemon ${startedHealth.running ? "started" : "is initializing"} (PID ${child.pid}).\n\n` +
1483									"It will keep running after pi closes.\n" +
1484									"Use /gateway status to check, /gateway stop to kill.",
1485								"info",
1486							);
1487							return;
1488						}
1489	
1490						if (state.running) {
1491							ctx.ui.notify("Gateway already running", "info");
1492							return;
1493						}
1494	
1495						// Reload config fresh on every start so users can edit
1496						// ~/.pi/gateway/config.json without restarting pi
1497						config = loadConfig();
1498						const port = parseInt(parts[1]) || config.port;
1499	
1500						await startGatewayServer(port);
1501	
1502						ctx.ui.notify(
1503							`✅ Gateway started on http://${config.host}:${port}\n\n` +
1504								`Platforms: ${state.adapters.size > 0 ? Array.from(state.adapters.keys()).join(", ") : "none"}\n` +
1505								`Sessions: Idle reset every ${config.sessions.idleMinutes} min`,
1506							"info",
1507						);
1508						return;
1509					}
1510	
1511					case "stop": {
1512						// Never signal a PID until the daemon API confirms the same identity.
1513						const daemonPid = readDaemonPid();
1514						if (daemonPid !== null) {
1515							const health = await waitForGatewayHealth(
1516								readDetachedHealthConfig(),
1517								daemonPid,
1518								1500,
1519							);
1520							if (!health) {
1521								ctx.ui.notify(
1522									"Refusing to signal an unverified daemon PID. Check /gateway status.",
1523									"error",
1524								);
1525								return;
1526							}
1527							try {
1528								process.kill(daemonPid, "SIGTERM");
1529							} catch {
1530								ctx.ui.notify("Failed to stop daemon", "error");
1531								return;
1532							}
1533	
1534							for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 40; attempt++) {
1535								await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
1536								if (readDaemonPid() !== daemonPid) {
1537									ctx.ui.notify("Gateway daemon stopped", "info");
1538									return;
1539								}
1540							}
1541							ctx.ui.notify(
1542								`Stop signal sent, but daemon PID ${daemonPid} is still present.`,
1543								"warning",
1544							);
1545							return;
1546						}
1547	
1548						if (!state.running) {
1549							ctx.ui.notify("Gateway not running", "info");
1550							return;
1551						}
1552	
1553						await stopGatewayServer();
1554						ctx.ui.notify("Gateway stopped", "info");
1555						return;
1556					}
1557	
1558					case "restart": {
1559						if (state.running) {
1560							await stopGatewayServer();
1561						}
1562	
1563						// Reload config and start
1564						config = loadConfig();
1565						const port = parseInt(parts[1]) || config.port;
1566						await startGatewayServer(port);
1567	
1568						ctx.ui.notify(
1569							`✅ Gateway restarted on http://${config.host}:${port}\n\n` +
1570								`Platforms: ${state.adapters.size > 0 ? Array.from(state.adapters.keys()).join(", ") : "none"}\n` +

2340	/** Apply config changes with listener rollback so the daemon stays manageable. */
2341	async function reloadDaemonConfig(): Promise<void> {
2342		const previousConfig = config;
2343		const nextConfig = mergeGatewayConfig(
2344			JSON.parse(readFileSync(GATEWAY_CONFIG_FILE, "utf-8")),
2345		);

2348			nextConfig.port !== previousConfig.port;
2349	
2350		if (!listenerChanged || !state.running) {
2351			config = nextConfig;
2352			return;
2353		}
2354	
2355		await stopGatewayServer();
2356		config = nextConfig;
2357		try {
2358			await startGatewayServer(config.port);
2359		} catch (rebindError) {
2360			await stopGatewayServer();
2361			config = previousConfig;
2362			try {
2363				await startGatewayServer(config.port);

2365					GATEWAY_CONFIG_FILE,
2366					`${JSON.stringify(previousConfig, null, 2)}\n`,
2367				);
2368			} catch (rollbackError) {
2369				logger.error(
2370					`[pi-gateway] Listener rollback failed: ${rollbackError instanceof Error ? rollbackError.message : String(rollbackError)}`,
2371				);
2372				process.kill(process.pid, "SIGTERM");
2373			}
2374			throw new Error(
2375				`Listener rebind failed and was rolled back: ${rebindError instanceof Error ? rebindError.message : String(rebindError)}`,
2376			);
2377		}
2378	}

2396				});

2411	async function detachAndRun(): Promise<void> {
2412		process.title = "pi-gateway-daemon";
2413		process.stdout.write = () => true;
2414		process.stderr.write = () => true;
2415	
2416		// Acquire the daemon identity atomically before opening any resources.
2417		try {
2418			writeGatewayPidFile(PID_FILE, process.pid);
2419		} catch (error) {
2420			logger.error(
2421				`[pi-gateway] Failed to acquire daemon PID file: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
2422			);
2423			process.exit(1);
2424		}
2425	
2426		let shutdownStarted = false;
2427		const shutdown = async (exitCode = 0) => {
2428			if (shutdownStarted) return;
2429			shutdownStarted = true;
2430			daemonShuttingDown = true;
2431			unwatchFile(GATEWAY_CONFIG_FILE);
2432			logger.info("[pi-gateway] Daemon shutting down...");
2433			await configReloadQueue.catch(() => {});
2434			if (state?.running || server || rpcProcess) {
2435				await Promise.race([
2436					stopGatewayServer(),
2437					new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 10000)),
2438				]);
2439			}
2440			removeGatewayPidFile(PID_FILE, process.pid);
2441			process.exit(exitCode);
2442		};
2443		process.on("SIGTERM", () => void shutdown());
2444		process.on("SIGINT", () => void shutdown());
2445		process.on("uncaughtException", (err) => {
2446			logger.error(
2447				`[pi-gateway] UNCAUGHT EXCEPTION: ${err.stack || err.message}`,
2448			);
2449			void shutdown(1);
2450		});

2454			);
2455		});
2456	
2457		logger.info(`[pi-gateway] Daemon starting (PID ${process.pid})`);
2458		try {
2459			config = loadConfig();
2460			state = {
2461				running: false,
2462				adapters: new Map(),
2463				clients: new Map(),
2464				sessions: new Map(),
2465			};
2466			initSessionStore();
2467			initSecurityStore();

2470			process.on("SIGHUP", () => {

2473					.then(async () => {

2485			await startGatewayServer(config.port);

2488		} catch (error) {
2489			logger.error(
2490				`[pi-gateway] Daemon startup failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.stack || error.message : String(error)}`,
2491			);
2492			await shutdown(1);
2493		}
2494	}

2496	async function startGatewayServer(port: number): Promise<void> {
2497		if (state.running) {
2498			logger.info("[gateway] Server already running");
2499			return;
2500		}
2501	
2502		server = createServer(handleHttpRequest);
2503	
2504		await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
2505			server!.listen(port, config.host, () => {
2506				logger.info(`[gateway] HTTP server started on ${config.host}:${port}`);
2507				resolve();
2508			});
2509			server!.on("error", reject);
2510		});
2511	
2512		if (config.enableWebSocket) {
2513			wss = new WebSocketServer({ server });
2514			wss.on("connection", handleWebSocket);
2515		}
2516	
2517		rpcProcess = createRpcProcess();
2518		await initializeAdapters();
2519		startCron();
2520		state.running = true;
2521		await updateStatus();
2522	}
2523	
2524	async function stopGatewayServer(): Promise<void> {
2525		if (!state?.running && !server && !rpcProcess) return;
2526		state.running = false;
2527	
2528		// Send shutdown message to all active chat channels before stopping
2529		const db = initSessionStore();
2530		const rows = db
2531			.prepare(
2532				"SELECT DISTINCT platform, channel_id FROM sessions WHERE is_background = 0",
2533			)
2534			.all() as Array<{ platform: string; channel_id: string }>;
2535		for (const row of rows) {
2536			const adapter = state.adapters.get(row.platform);
2537			if (adapter) {
2538				adapter
2539					.sendMessage(row.channel_id, "🔌 Gateway daemon is shutting down…")
2540					.catch(() => {});
2541			}
2542		}
2543	
2544		await Promise.allSettled(
2545			Array.from(state.adapters.values(), (adapter) => adapter.stop()),
2546		);
2547		state.adapters.clear();
2548	
2549		stopCron();
2550	
2551		for (const ws of state.clients.values()) {
2552			ws.close(1000, "Server shutting down");
2553		}
2554		state.clients.clear();
2555	
2556		const serverToClose = server;
2557		const webSocketServerToClose = wss;
2558		server = null;
2559		wss = null;
2560		try {
2561			webSocketServerToClose?.close();
2562		} catch {
2563			/* server was never listening */
2564		}
2565		if (serverToClose) {
2566			await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
2567				serverToClose.close(() => resolve());
2568			});
2569		}
2570	
2571		if (rpcProcess) {
2572			rpcProcess.kill();
2573			rpcProcess = null;
2574		}
2575	
2576		void updateStatus();
2577	}
```

```text
134	/**

136	 */
137	export function generatePairingCode(
138		platform: Platform,
139		userId: string,
140	): string {
141		const database = initSecurityStore();
142	
143		// Generate 8-character alphanumeric code
144		const code = randomBytes(6).toString("base64url").slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
145		const now = Date.now();
146		const expiresAt = now + 60 * 60 * 1000; // 1 hour
147	
148		database
149			.prepare(
150				`
151			INSERT INTO pairing_codes (code, platform, user_id, created_at, expires_at, used)
152			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)
153		`,
154			)
155			.run(code, platform, userId, now, expiresAt);
156	
157		logger.info(
158			`[Security] Generated pairing code ${code} for ${platform}/${userId}`,
159		);
160		return code;
161	}

163	/**
164	 * Approve pairing code
165	 */
166	export function approvePairingCode(code: string): boolean {
167		const database = initSecurityStore();
168	
169		const entry = database
170			.prepare(`
171			SELECT * FROM pairing_codes WHERE code = ? AND used = 0 AND expires_at > ?
172		`)
173			.get(code, Date.now()) as PairingCode | undefined;
174	
175		if (!entry) {
176			logger.info(`[Security] Pairing code ${code} not found or expired`);
177			return false;
178		}
179	
180		// Add to allowlist
181		database
182			.prepare(
183				`
184			INSERT OR IGNORE INTO allowlist (platform, user_id, added_at)
185			VALUES (?, ?, ?)
186		`,
187			)
188			.run(entry.platform, entry.userId, Date.now());
189	
190		// Mark code as used
191		database
192			.prepare("UPDATE pairing_codes SET used = 1 WHERE code = ?")
193			.run(code);
194	
195		logger.info(`[Security] Approved pairing: ${entry.platform}/${entry.userId}`);
196		return true;
197	}

242	export function isUserAllowed(platform: Platform, userId: string): boolean {
243		const database = initSecurityStore();
244	
245		// Check global allow all first
246		const config = getSecurityConfig();

249		// Check config-based allowedUids (cross-platform wildcard or platform-specific)
250		if (config.allowedUids) {
251			const platformUids = config.allowedUids[platform];
252			if (platformUids?.includes(userId)) return true;
253			const wildcardUids = config.allowedUids["*"];
254			if (wildcardUids?.includes(userId)) return true;
255		}
256	
257		// Check specific allowlist
258		const entry = database
259			.prepare(`
260			SELECT 1 FROM allowlist WHERE platform = ? AND user_id = ?
261		`)
262			.get(platform, userId);
263	
264		return !!entry;
265	}

292		const query = platform
293			? "SELECT * FROM allowlist WHERE platform = ? ORDER BY added_at DESC"
294			: "SELECT * FROM allowlist ORDER BY platform, added_at DESC";
295	
296		const rows = platform
297			? (database.prepare(query).all(platform) as AllowlistEntry[])
298			: (database.prepare(query).all() as AllowlistEntry[]);
299	
300		return rows;
301	}
302	
303	/**
304	 * Rate limiting
305	 */
306	export function checkRateLimit(
307		identifier: string,
308		maxRequests: number = 60,
309		windowMs: number = 60000,
310	): boolean {
311		const database = initSecurityStore();
312		const now = Date.now();
313	
314		const entry = database
315			.prepare(`
316			SELECT * FROM rate_limits WHERE identifier = ?
317		`)
318			.get(identifier) as RateLimitEntry | undefined;
319	
320		if (!entry || now - entry.windowStart > windowMs) {
321			// New window
322			database
323				.prepare(
324					`
325				INSERT OR REPLACE INTO rate_limits (identifier, count, window_start)
326				VALUES (?, 1, ?)
327			`,
328				)
329				.run(identifier, now);
330			return true;
331		}
332	
333		if (entry.count >= maxRequests) {
334			logger.warn(`[Security] Rate limit exceeded for ${identifier}`);
335			return false;
336		}
337	
338		// Increment counter
339		database
340			.prepare(
341				`
342			UPDATE rate_limits SET count = count + 1 WHERE identifier = ?
343		`,
344			)
345			.run(identifier);
346	
347		return true;
348	}
349	
350	/**
351	 * Clean up expired pairing codes
352	 */
353	export function cleanupExpiredCodes(): number {
354		const database = initSecurityStore();
355		const result = database
356			.prepare("DELETE FROM pairing_codes WHERE expires_at < ?")
357			.run(Date.now());
358		return result.changes;
359	}
360	
361	// Shared with index.ts — reads from the single gateway config file.
362	// Schema: the `security` block inside ~/.pi/gateway/config.json
363	export interface SecurityConfig {
364		allowAll: boolean;
365		requirePairing: boolean;
366		allowedUids: Record<string, string[]>;
367		adminUids: Record<string, string[]>;
368		rateLimit: {
369			maxRequests: number;
370			windowMs: number;
371		};
372	}
373	
374	function getSecurityConfig(): SecurityConfig {
375		try {
376			if (existsSync(GATEWAY_CONFIG_FILE)) {
377				const raw = JSON.parse(readFileSync(GATEWAY_CONFIG_FILE, "utf-8"));
378				if (raw.security) return raw.security as SecurityConfig;
379			}
380		} catch (err) {
381			logger.error(
382				"[Security] Failed to parse config — using defaults. Error:",
383				err,
384			);
385		}
386		return {
387			allowAll: false,
388			requirePairing: false,
389			allowedUids: {},
390			adminUids: {},
391			rateLimit: { maxRequests: 60, windowMs: 60000 },
392		};
393	}
394	
395	// ── Admin Role Management ─────────────────────────────────────────
396	
397	/**
398	 * Check if a user has admin privileges.
399	 * Looks at both DB admins table and config adminUids.
400	 */
401	export function isAdmin(platform: Platform | string, userId: string): boolean {
402		const database = initSecurityStore();
403		const config = getSecurityConfig();
404	
405		// Check config-based adminUids (cross-platform wildcard or platform-specific)
406		if (config.adminUids) {
407			const platformUids = config.adminUids[platform];
408			if (platformUids?.includes(userId)) return true;
409			const wildcardUids = config.adminUids["*"];
410			if (wildcardUids?.includes(userId)) return true;
411		}
412	
413		// Check DB admins (platform-specific or wildcard)
414		const entry = database
415			.prepare(
416				`SELECT 1 FROM admins WHERE (platform = ? OR platform = '*') AND user_id = ?`,
417			)
418			.get(platform, userId);
419	
420		return !!entry;
421	}
422	
423	/** Add a user as admin. Platform "*" means admin on all platforms. */
424	export function addAdmin(
425		platform: Platform | "*",
426		userId: string,
427		note?: string,
428	): void {
429		const database = initSecurityStore();
430		database
431			.prepare(
432				`INSERT OR REPLACE INTO admins (platform, user_id, added_at, note)
433	       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)`,
434			)
435			.run(platform, userId, Date.now(), note ?? null);
436		logger.info(`[Security] Admin added: ${platform}:${userId}`);
437	}
438	
439	/** Remove admin privileges from a user. Returns true if removed. */
440	export function removeAdmin(platform: Platform | "*", userId: string): boolean {
441		const database = initSecurityStore();
442		const result = database
443			.prepare("DELETE FROM admins WHERE platform = ? AND user_id = ?")
444			.run(platform, userId);
445		if (result.changes > 0) {
446			logger.info(`[Security] Admin removed: ${platform}:${userId}`);
447		}
448		return result.changes > 0;
449	}
450	
451	/** List all admin entries. */
452	export function listAdmins(): AdminEntry[] {
453		const database = initSecurityStore();
454		const rows = database
455			.prepare("SELECT * FROM admins ORDER BY platform, user_id")
456			.all() as AdminEntry[];
457		return rows;
458	}
```

```text
2	 * Session Store - Hermes-style per-chat session management
3	 *
4	 * Features:

22		channelId: string;
23		userId: string;

35		platform: string;
36		channel_id: string;
37		user_id: string;
38		reset_policy: string;
39		daily_hour: number;
40		idle_minutes: number;

52	/**
53	 * Initialize session database
54	 */
55	export function initSessionStore(): Database.Database {
56		if (db) return db;
57	
58		if (!existsSync(GATEWAY_DIR)) {
59			mkdirSync(GATEWAY_DIR, { recursive: true });
60		}
61	
62		db = new Database(SESSIONS_DB);
63		db.exec("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;");
64	
65		// Sessions table
66		db.exec(`
67	    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
68	      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
69	      platform TEXT NOT NULL,
70	      channel_id TEXT NOT NULL,
71	      user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
72	      reset_policy TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle',
73	      daily_hour INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,
74	      idle_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1440,
75	      last_activity INTEGER NOT NULL,
76	      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
77	      is_background INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
78	      parent_session_id TEXT,
79	      FOREIGN KEY (parent_session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id)
80	    )
81	  `);
82	
83		// Indexes for fast lookups
84		db.exec(
85			`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_platform_channel ON sessions(platform, channel_id)`,
86		);
87		db.exec(
88			`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_parent ON sessions(parent_session_id)`,
89		);
90		db.exec(
91			`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_activity ON sessions(last_activity)`,
92		);
93	
94		logger.info("[SessionStore] Database initialized");
95		return db;
96	}

98	/**

101	export function generateSessionId(): string {
102		return `sess-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`;
103	}
104	
105	/**
106	 * Get or create session for a platform/channel
107	 */
108	export function getOrCreateSession(
109		platform: string,
110		channelId: string,
111		userId: string,
112		config?: Partial<SessionConfig>,
113	): SessionConfig {
114		const database = initSessionStore();
115	
116		// Try to find existing active session
117		const existing = database
118			.prepare(`
119	    SELECT * FROM sessions 
120	    WHERE platform = ? AND channel_id = ? AND is_background = 0
121	    ORDER BY last_activity DESC
122	    LIMIT 1
123	  `)
124			.get(platform, channelId) as SessionRow | undefined;
125	
126		if (existing) {
127			// Check if session needs reset
128			if (shouldResetSession(existing)) {
129				// Delete old session, create fresh one
130				database.prepare("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?").run(existing.id);
131			} else {
132				// Update last activity and return
133				database
134					.prepare("UPDATE sessions SET last_activity = ? WHERE id = ?")
135					.run(Date.now(), existing.id);
136				return rowToSession(existing);
137			}
138		}
139	
140		// Create new session
141		const id = generateSessionId();
142		const now = Date.now();
143	
144		const session: SessionConfig = {
145			id,
146			platform,
147			channelId,
148			userId,
149			resetPolicy: config?.resetPolicy ?? "idle",
150			dailyHour: config?.dailyHour ?? 4,
151			idleMinutes: config?.idleMinutes ?? 1440,
152			lastActivity: now,
153			createdAt: now,
154			isBackground: false,
155			...config,
156		};
157	
158		database
159			.prepare(`
160	    INSERT INTO sessions (id, platform, channel_id, user_id, reset_policy, daily_hour, idle_minutes, last_activity, created_at, is_background, parent_session_id)
161	    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
162	  `)
163			.run(
164				session.id,
165				session.platform,
166				session.channelId,
167				session.userId,
168				session.resetPolicy,
169				session.dailyHour,
170				session.idleMinutes,
171				session.lastActivity,
172				session.createdAt,
173				session.isBackground ? 1 : 0,
174				session.parentSessionId ?? null,
175			);
176	
177		logger.info(
178			`[SessionStore] Created session ${id.slice(0, 12)}... for ${platform}/${channelId}`,
179		);
180		return session;
181	}

184	 * Create a background session (isolated from parent)
185	 */
186	export function createBackgroundSession(
187		platform: string,
188		channelId: string,
189		userId: string,
190		parentSessionId?: string,
191	): SessionConfig {

199			platform,

203			dailyHour: 4,

205			lastActivity: now,
206			createdAt: now,
207			isBackground: true,
208			parentSessionId,
209		};
210	
211		database
212			.prepare(`
213	    INSERT INTO sessions (id, platform, channel_id, user_id, reset_policy, daily_hour, idle_minutes, last_activity, created_at, is_background, parent_session_id)
214	    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
215	  `)
216			.run(
217				session.id,
218				session.platform,
219				session.channelId,
220				session.userId,
221				session.resetPolicy,
222				session.dailyHour,
223				session.idleMinutes,
224				session.lastActivity,
225				session.createdAt,
226				1, // is_background
227				session.parentSessionId ?? null,
228			);
229	
230		logger.info(

236	/**
237	 * Check if session should be reset
238	 */
239	function shouldResetSession(row: SessionRow): boolean {
240		const now = Date.now();
241	
242		// Check idle timeout
243		const idleMs = row.idle_minutes * 60 * 1000;
244		if (now - row.last_activity > idleMs) {
245			logger.info(
246				`[SessionStore] Session ${row.id.slice(0, 8)} reset: idle timeout`,
247			);
248			return true;
249		}
250	
251		// Check daily reset
252		if (row.reset_policy === "daily" || row.reset_policy === "both") {
253			const lastActivity = new Date(row.last_activity);
254			const nowDate = new Date(now);
255	
256			// Check if we crossed the daily reset hour since last activity
257			if (
258				lastActivity.getHours() < row.daily_hour &&
259				nowDate.getHours() >= row.daily_hour
260			) {
261				logger.info(
262					`[SessionStore] Session ${row.id.slice(0, 8)} reset: daily at ${row.daily_hour}:00`,
263				);
264				return true;
265			}
266		}
267	
268		return false;
269	}
270

272	 * Update session last activity

275		const database = initSessionStore();

277			.prepare("UPDATE sessions SET last_activity = ? WHERE id = ?")
278			.run(Date.now(), sessionId);

288			.get(sessionId) as SessionRow | undefined;

306			? "SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE platform = ? AND is_background = 0 ORDER BY last_activity DESC"
307			: "SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE is_background = 0 ORDER BY last_activity DESC";
308	
309		const rows = platform
310			? (database.prepare(query).all(platform) as SessionRow[])
311			: (database.prepare(query).all() as SessionRow[]);

320		const database = initSessionStore();
```

```text
1	/**
2	 * Platform Adapter Base - Interface for Hermes-style platform adapters
3	 */
4	
5	// ── Interactive UI types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
6	
7	/** Platform-agnostic description of an interactive prompt from pi. */
8	export interface InteractivePrompt {
9		requestId: string;
10		method:
11			| "select"
12			| "confirm"
13			| "input"
14			| "editor"
15			| "notify"
16			| "setStatus"
17			| "setWidget"
18			| "setTitle"
19			| "set_editor_text";
20		title: string;
21		message?: string;
22		options?: string[];
23		placeholder?: string;
24		prefill?: string;
25		notifyType?: "info" | "warning" | "error";
26	}
27	
28	/** User's response to an interactive prompt. */
29	export interface InteractiveResponse {
30		requestId: string;
31		value?: string;
32		confirmed?: boolean;
33		cancelled?: boolean;
34	}
35	
36	// ── Message types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
37	
38	export interface PlatformMessage {
39		id: string;
40		platform: string;
41		channelId: string;
42		userId: string;
43		content: string;
44		timestamp: number;
45		metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
46	}
47	
48	export interface PlatformConfig {
49		enabled: boolean;
50		platform: string;
51		token?: string;
52		botToken?: string;
53		webhookSecret?: string;
54	}
55	
56	export interface AdapterCallbacks {
57		onMessage: (message: PlatformMessage) => Promise<void>;
58		onTyping?: (userId: string, isTyping: boolean) => void;
59		onDisconnect?: () => void;
60		/** Fired when a user responds to an interactive prompt (button click, reply). */
61		onInteractiveResponse?: (response: InteractiveResponse) => void;
62	}
63	
64	export interface PlatformAdapter {
65		readonly platform: string;
66		readonly config: PlatformConfig;
67	
68		/**
69		 * Initialize the adapter
70		 */
71		initialize(): Promise<void>;
72	
73		/**
74		 * Start listening for messages
75		 */
76		start(callbacks: AdapterCallbacks): Promise<void>;
77	
78		/**
79		 * Stop listening
80		 */
81		stop(): Promise<void>;
82	
83		/**
84		 * Send a message to a channel
85		 */
86		sendMessage(channelId: string, content: string): Promise<string>; // Returns message ID
87	
88		/**
89		 * Edit an existing message
90		 */
91		editMessage(
92			channelId: string,
93			messageId: string,
94			content: string,
95		): Promise<void>;
96	
97		/**
98		 * Delete a message
99		 */
100		deleteMessage(channelId: string, messageId: string): Promise<void>;
101	
102		/**
103		 * Set typing indicator
104		 */
105		setTyping(channelId: string, isTyping: boolean): Promise<void>;
106	
107		/**
108		 * Get adapter health status
109		 */
110		getStatus(): Promise<{ connected: boolean; latency?: number }>;
111	
112		/**
113		 * Send an interactive prompt (select, confirm, input, etc.).
114		 * Returns the platform-specific message ID for potential cleanup.
115		 */
116		sendInteractive(
117			channelId: string,
118			prompt: InteractivePrompt,
119		): Promise<{ messageId: string }>;
120	
121		/**
122		 * Clean up interactive elements from a message (remove buttons, etc.).
123		 * Optional — only needed if the platform can't auto-expire interactions.
124		 */
125		cleanupInteractive?(channelId: string, messageId: string): Promise<void>;
126	}
127	
128	/**
129	 * Abstract base class for adapters
130	 */
131	export abstract class BaseAdapter implements PlatformAdapter {
132		abstract readonly platform: string;
133		abstract config: PlatformConfig;
134		protected callbacks: AdapterCallbacks | null = null;
135		protected running = false;
136	
137		async initialize(): Promise<void> {
138			// Override in subclass
139		}
140	
141		async start(callbacks: AdapterCallbacks): Promise<void> {
142			this.callbacks = callbacks;
143			this.running = true;
144		}
145	
146		async stop(): Promise<void> {
147			this.running = false;
148			this.callbacks = null;
149		}
150	
151		/** Clean up interactive elements (remove buttons, etc.). No-op by default. */
152		async cleanupInteractive(
153			_channelId: string,
154			_messageId: string,
155		): Promise<void> {
156			// Default: nothing to clean up
157		}
158	
159		abstract sendMessage(channelId: string, content: string): Promise<string>;
160		abstract editMessage(
161			channelId: string,
162			messageId: string,
163			content: string,
164		): Promise<void>;
165		abstract deleteMessage(channelId: string, messageId: string): Promise<void>;
166		abstract setTyping(channelId: string, isTyping: boolean): Promise<void>;
167		abstract getStatus(): Promise<{ connected: boolean; latency?: number }>;
168	
169		/**
170		 * Default interactive prompt — sends as text with instructions.
171		 * Override in platform-specific adapters for native interactive UI.
172		 */
173		async sendInteractive(
174			channelId: string,
175			prompt: InteractivePrompt,
176		): Promise<{ messageId: string }> {
177			const text = formatGenericPrompt(prompt);
178			// Skip empty notifications (e.g. widget/status clears with no content)
179			if (!text) {
180				return { messageId: "0" };
181			}
182			const messageId = await this.sendMessage(channelId, text);
183			return { messageId };
184		}
185	
186		protected emitMessage(message: PlatformMessage): Promise<void> {
187			if (this.callbacks?.onMessage) {
188				return this.callbacks.onMessage(message).catch((err) => {
189					// Log but don't crash the adapter loop
190					console.error(`[${this.platform}] Error in onMessage callback:`, err);
191				}) as Promise<void>;
192			}
193			return Promise.resolve();
194		}
195	
196		protected generateMessageId(): string {
197			return `${this.platform}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
198		}
199	}
200	
201	// ── Generic interactive prompt formatter (fallback for non-interactive platforms) ─┐
202	
203	function formatGenericPrompt(prompt: InteractivePrompt): string {
204		switch (prompt.method) {
205			case "select": {
206				const options = prompt.options || [];
207				const numbered = options.map((opt, i) => `${i + 1}. ${opt}`).join("\n");
208				return `**${prompt.title}**\n\n${numbered}\n\n_Reply with the number of your choice._`;
209			}
210			case "confirm": {
211				const msg = prompt.message ? `\n\n_${prompt.message}_` : "";
212				return `**${prompt.title}**${msg}\n\n_Reply yes or no._`;
213			}
214			case "input":
215			case "editor": {
216				const hint = prompt.placeholder ? `\n\n_(${prompt.placeholder})_` : "";
217				const pre = prompt.prefill
218					? `\n\n\`\`\`\n${prompt.prefill}\n\`\`\`\n\n_Reply with your ${prompt.method === "editor" ? "changes" : "input"}._`
219					: `\n\n_Reply with your ${prompt.method === "editor" ? "text" : "input"}._`;
220				return `**${prompt.title}**${hint}${pre}`;
221			}
222			case "notify":
223			case "setStatus":
224			case "setWidget":
225			case "setTitle":
226			case "set_editor_text": {
227				const text = prompt.message || prompt.title;
228				// Skip if pi clears a widget/status with no content (e.g. setWidget(name, undefined))
229				if (!text) {
230					return "";
231				}
232				const icon =
233					prompt.notifyType === "warning"
234						? "⚠️"
235						: prompt.notifyType === "error"
236							? "❌"
237							: "ℹ️";
238				return `${icon} ${text}`;
239			}
240			default: {
241				console.warn(
242					`[base] Unknown interactive method "${prompt.method}", falling back to plain text`,
243				);
244				return `**${prompt.title}**${prompt.message ? `\n\n_${prompt.message}_` : ""}\n\n_Reply with your response._`;
245			}
246		}
247	}
248
```

```text
705	- **Input-based pricing tiers** - Request-wide input-token pricing tiers for accurate long-context cost accounting (e.g. GPT-5.4/5.5/5.6 long-context rates), also configurable for custom models in `models.json` and `modelOverrides`. See [Model Configuration](docs/models.md#model-configuration).
706	
707	### Added
708	
709	- Added the opt-in `max` thinking level across CLI, SDK, RPC, model selection, and themes. Custom themes can define `thinkingMax`; existing themes fall back to `thinkingXhigh`.
710	- Added request-wide input-token pricing tiers to custom model costs in `models.json`, `modelOverrides`, and extension-registered providers.
711	- Added `~` (home directory) expansion for the `shellPath` setting ([#6470](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6470) by [@aaronkyriesenbach](https://github.com/aaronkyriesenbach)).
712	
713	### Fixed
714	
715	- Fixed inherited post-compaction output-token budgeting to ignore stale assistant usage from before the compaction boundary ([#6464](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6464)).
716	- Fixed inherited GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5 long-context cost accounting while retaining the intentional 272K default context limit for models that require an explicit override.
717	- Fixed inherited GPT-5.6 metadata to keep direct OpenAI requests in the 272K short-context tier while exposing the Codex backend's 372K context window with long-context pricing, and removed the nonexistent bare `gpt-5.6` alias.
718	- Fixed inherited Anthropic message conversion to preserve thinking blocks with empty thinking text but a valid signature instead of dropping them, avoiding thinking-block errors on newer Claude models ([#6457](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6457) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
719	
720	## [0.80.5] - 2026-07-09
721	
722	## [0.80.4] - 2026-07-09
723	
724	### New Features
725	
726	- **Prompt cache miss visibility** - Significant cache misses can be shown in transcripts via `showCacheMissNotices`. See [Model & Thinking](docs/settings.md#model--thinking).
727	- **Project-local resource configuration** - `pi config -l` and Tab switching manage global vs project-local package resources. See [Enable and Disable Resources](docs/packages.md#enable-and-disable-resources).
728	- **Extension lifecycle and provider hooks** - Extensions get `agent_settled`, `before_provider_headers`, entry renderers, and `InlineExtension`. See [agent_start / agent_end / agent_settled](docs/extensions.md#agent_start--agent_end--agent_settled), [before_provider_headers](docs/extensions.md#before_provider_headers), and [InlineExtension](docs/sdk.md#inlineextension).
729	- **New inherited model and transport support** - GPT-5.6 metadata, Copilot Claude Sonnet 5, and zstd Codex SSE transport are available through inherited provider support. See [Providers](docs/providers.md) and [Model Options](docs/usage.md#model-options).
730	
731	### Added
732	
733	- Added inherited OpenAI GPT-5.6 model metadata for `gpt-5.6`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, and `gpt-5.6-luna`, plus verified `openai-codex` support for `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, and `gpt-5.6-luna`.
734	- Added inherited Claude Sonnet 5 to the GitHub Copilot model catalog ([#6200](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6200)).
735	- Added inherited zstd request-body compression for the OpenAI Codex Responses SSE transport.
736	- Added `/login <provider>` support with provider autocomplete.
737	- Added public SDK exports for CLI-equivalent model and scoped-model resolution ([#6201](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6201)).
738	- Added extension and RPC `agent_settled` events plus session-level idle waiting for fully settled agent runs ([#6363](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6363)).
739	- Added `before_provider_headers` extension hook support for injecting provider request headers ([#6350](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6350) by [@pmateusz](https://github.com/pmateusz)).
740	- Added an `InlineExtension` type for named inline extension factories ([#6267](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6267) by [@any-victor](https://github.com/any-victor)).
741	- Added extension entry renderers for persisted display-only session entries that are rendered in interactive mode without being sent to the model context.
742	- Added project-local resource override management to `pi config`, including project mode startup with `pi config -l` and Tab switching between global and project scopes ([#6309](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6309)).
743	- Added inherited `InMemorySessionStorage` and `JsonlSessionStorage` exports from the agent harness ([#6435](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6435)).
744	- Added inherited custom metadata support in JSONL session headers ([#6417](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6417) by [@ArcadiaLin](https://github.com/ArcadiaLin)).
745	- Added a `showCacheMissNotices` setting and `/settings` toggle for significant prompt-cache miss transcript notices.
746	
747	### Fixed
748	
749	- Fixed inherited retry classification for gRPC `ResourceExhausted` provider errors such as NVIDIA NIM transient exhaustion responses ([#6449](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/6449) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai)).
750	- Fixed inherited retry classification for Cloudflare 524 timeout responses ([#6239](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6239)).
751	- Fixed inherited GitHub Copilot device-code login polling to wait before the first token poll and to honor server-provided `slow_down` intervals, avoiding incorrect failures or apparent hangs after browser authorization ([#6187](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6187)).
752	- Fixed inherited OpenAI Codex WebSocket sessions to rotate cached connections before the backend's 60-minute limit, avoiding connection-limit failures on long sessions ([#6268](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6268)).
753	- Fixed inherited DS4 server context overflow detection for `Prompt has ... tokens, but the configured context size is ... tokens` errors ([#6262](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6262)).
754	- Fixed inherited Fireworks GLM 5.2 Fast to use the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and `thinkingLevelMap`, aligning it with GLM 5.2 ([#6195](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/6195)).
```
