```text
1	# Pi Discord Remote
2	
3	A Pi extension that bridges your Pi coding sessions to Discord. Every project gets its own channel, every session gets its own thread — monitor, steer, and control Pi from Discord in real time.
4	
5	## Features
6	
7	- **Per-project channels** — a dedicated Discord channel is created for each project (named after the working directory), keeping your server organized
8	- **Session threads** — each Pi session spawns a thread inside the project channel with a short, readable slug (`pi-a1b2c`)
9	- **Global config** — set your `.env` once in `~/.pi/.env`, works across all projects
10	- **Two-way control** — send messages in Discord to steer Pi, or react with 🛑 to abort
11	- **Tool call streaming** — optionally watch tool calls and results arrive live in Discord
12	- **Slash commands** — register bridge commands as native Discord slash commands
13	
14	## Prerequisites
15	
16	- [Pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi)
17	- A [Discord bot](https://discord.com/developers/applications) in your server with these permissions:
18	  - Send Messages
19	  - Read Message History
20	  - Create Public Threads
21	  - Manage Threads
22	  - Add Reactions
23	  - Manage Channels *(needed for per-project channel creation)*
24	
25	## Installation
26	
27	### npm (recommended)
28	
29	Inside Pi, run:
30	
31	```
32	/pi-install npm:pi-discord-bridge
33	```
34	
35	Or manually add to `~/.pi/agent/settings.json`:
36	
37	```json
38	{
39	  "packages": [
40	    "npm:pi-discord-bridge"
41	  ]
42	}
43	```
44	
45	### Local (from source)
46	
47	```bash
48	cp -r pi-discord-bridge ~/.pi/agent/extensions/discord-bridge
49	cd ~/.pi/agent/extensions/discord-bridge && npm install
50	```
51	
52	Then use `"ext:discord-bridge"` in settings.json instead.
53	
54	### Config
55	
56	Either way, set up your environment:
57	
58	```bash
59	cp .env.example ~/.pi/.env
60	# Edit ~/.pi/.env with your bot token, channel IDs, etc.
61	```
62	
63	Restart Pi.
64	
65	## Configuration
66	
67	All settings go in `~/.pi/.env`. See [`.env.example`](.env.example) for the full list.
68	
69	| Variable | Default | Description |
70	| --- | --- | --- |
71	| `PI_DISCORD_ENABLED` | `false` | Master switch |
72	| `PI_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` | — | Discord bot token |
73	| `PI_DISCORD_USER_IDS` | — | Allowed Discord user IDs (comma-separated) |
74	| `PI_DISCORD_CREATE_CHANNEL_PER_PROJECT` | `true` | `true` = auto-create a channel per project (requires `PI_DISCORD_GUILD_ID`); `false` = send everything to `PI_DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID` |
75	| `PI_DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID` | — | Target channel when `CREATE_CHANNEL_PER_PROJECT=false` |
76	| `PI_DISCORD_GUILD_ID` | — | Guild for per-project channel creation (required when toggle is `true`) |
77	| `PI_DISCORD_STREAM_MESSAGES` | `false` | Live-edit messages as the assistant streams |
78	| `PI_DISCORD_CREATE_THREAD_PER_SESSION` | `true` | One thread per Pi session |
79	| `PI_DISCORD_THREAD_NAME_PREFIX` | `pi` | Thread name prefix |
80	| `PI_DISCORD_RENDER_TOOL_CALLS` | `true` | Show tool calls in Discord |
81	| `PI_DISCORD_RENDER_TOOL_RESULTS` | `true` | Show tool results in Discord |
82	| `PI_DISCORD_RENDER_USER_INPUT` | `true` | Echo user messages to Discord |
83	| `PI_DISCORD_RENDER_REASONING` | `false` | Show chain-of-thought |
84	
85	## How it works
86	
87	```
88	Server
89	├── #general              (your existing channel)
90	├── #my-app               (auto-created for ~/projects/my-app)
91	│   ├── pi-a1b2c          (session thread)
92	│   └── pi-f3d4e          (another session thread)
93	└── #api-server           (auto-created for ~/projects/api-server)
94	    └── pi-b7c8d          (session thread)
95	```
96	
97	Each time you start Pi in a project directory, the extension:
98	
99	1. Creates (or reuses) a text channel named after the project directory
100	2. Creates a session thread with a 5-character slug inside that channel
101	3. Sends all assistant messages, tool calls, and results to that thread
102	
103	## Discord commands
104	
105	| Command | Description |
106	| --- | --- |
107	| `/session` | Current session and thread info |
108	| `/abort` | Abort the current turn (or react 🛑) |
109	| `/compact` | Trigger context compaction |
110	| `/new [args]` | Start a new Pi session |
111	| `/mute` / `/unmute` | Suppress/resume Discord output |
112	| `/discord-status` | Full status and config dump |
113	| `/discord-test [msg]` | Send a test message |
114	| `/discord-reconnect` | Reconnect the bot |
115	
116	You can also just type naturally — messages are forwarded to Pi as input.
117	
118	## Pi commands
119	
120	| Command | Description |
121	| --- | --- |
122	| `/discord-status` | Connection status, channels, config |
123	| `/discord-test [msg]` | Send a test message |
124	| `/discord-reconnect` | Reconnect the bot |
125	| `/discord-mute` / `/discord-unmute` | Mute/unmute Discord output |
126	| `/discord-arm` | Arm in-process session replacement |
127	| `/discord-launcher-status` | HTTP launcher info |
128	
129	## License
130	
131	MIT
132
```
</details></tool-use>

1	<p align="center">
2	  <b>Control Pi from any chat app. Anywhere, anytime.</b>
3	</p>
4	
5	<p align="center">
6	  pi-connect bridges Pi running on your machine to the messaging platforms you already use.<br/>
7	  Code review, research, automation, data analysis — anything Pi can do,<br/>
8	  now accessible from your phone, tablet, or any device with a chat app.
9	</p>
10	
11	**Pi-only agent bridge** – This fork focuses on Pi and keeps the platform bridge simple.
12	
13	## 🧩 Platform feature snapshot
14	
15	High-level view of what each **built-in platform** can do in pi-connect.
16	
17	**Legend**
18	
19	| Symbol | Meaning |
20	|--------|---------|
21	| ✅ | Works in **stable** pi-connect with typical configuration |
22	| ⚠️ | Partial, needs extra config (e.g. speech / ASR), or limited by the vendor app or API |
23	| ❌ | Not supported or not applicable in practice |
24	
25	† **QQ (NapCat / OneBot)** — unofficial self-hosted bridge; behaviour depends on your NapCat / network setup.
26	
27	| Capability | Feishu | DingTalk | Telegram | Slack | Discord | LINE | WeCom | Weibo | **Weixin**<br>*(personal)* | QQ† | QQ Bot |
28	|------------|:------:|:--------:|:--------:|:-----:|:-------:|:----:|:-----:|:-----:|:-------------------------:|:---:|:------:|
29	| Text & slash commands | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
30	| Markdown / cards | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
31	| Streaming / chunked replies | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
32	| Images & files | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
33	| Voice / STT / TTS | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | ❌ | ⚠️ | ❌ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ⚠️ |
34	| Private (DM) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
35	| Group / channel | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
36	
37	> **WeCom:** Webhook mode needs a **public URL**; long-connection / WS style setups often do not.  
38	> **Voice row:** many platforms need `[speech]` / TTS providers enabled in `config.toml`; values are a best-effort summary.  
39	> Per-platform setup: [Platform setup guides](#-platform-setup-guides) below.
40	
41	## Features
42	
43	### 📱 Platform Flexibility
44	**11 Chat Platforms** — Feishu, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, WeChat Work, Weibo, LINE, QQ, QQ Bot (Official), plus **Weixin (personal ilink)** for **personal WeChat**. Most platforms need **zero public IP**.
45	
46	### 🔄 Multi-Bot Relay
47	**Multi-Bot Relay** — Bind multiple Pi-backed bots in a group chat and let them communicate with each other in one conversation.
48	
49	### 🎮 Complete Chat Control
50	**Full Control from Chat** — Switch models (`/model`), tune reasoning (`/reasoning`), change permission modes (`/mode`), manage sessions, all via slash commands.
51	
52	**Directory Switching in Chat** — Change where the next session starts with `/dir <path>` (and `/cd <path>` as a compatibility alias), plus quick history jump via `/dir <number>` / `/dir -`.
53	
54	### 🧠 Persistent Memory
55	**Agent Memory** — Read and write agent instruction files (`/memory`) without touching the terminal.
56	
57	### ⏰ Intelligent Scheduling
58	**Scheduled Tasks** — Set up cron jobs in natural language. *"Every day at 6am, summarize GitHub trending"* just works.
59	
60	### 🎤 Multimodal Support
61	**Voice & Images** — Send voice messages or screenshots; pi-connect handles STT/TTS and multimodal forwarding.
62	
63	### 📦 Multi-Project Architecture
64	**Multi-Project** — One process, multiple projects, each with its own agent + platform combo.
65	
66	### 🌍 Multilingual Interface
67	**5 Languages** — Native support for English, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Japanese, and Spanish. Built-in i18n ensures everyone feels at home.

80	## 🚀 Quick Start
81	
82	### 🤖 Install & Configure with Pi (Recommended)
83	
84	> **The easiest way** — Ask Pi to follow this installation guide and help configure pi-connect:
85	
86	```bash
87	Follow https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tasercake/pi-connect/refs/heads/main/INSTALL.md to install and configure pi-connect.
88	```
89	
90	
91	### 📦 Manual Install
92	
93	**Via npm:**
94	
95	```bash
96	npm install -g pi-connect
97	```
98	
99	**Via Homebrew (macOS / Linux):**
100	
101	```bash
102	brew install pi-connect
103	```
104	
105	**Download binary from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/tasercake/pi-connect/releases):**
106	
107	```bash
108	# Linux amd64 - Stable
109	curl -L -o pi-connect https://github.com/tasercake/pi-connect/releases/latest/download/pi-connect-linux-amd64
110	chmod +x pi-connect
111	sudo mv pi-connect /usr/local/bin/
112	
113	```
114	
115	**Build from source (requires Go 1.22+):**
116	
117	```bash
118	git clone https://github.com/tasercake/pi-connect.git
119	cd pi-connect
120	make build
121	```
122	
123	
124	### ⚙️ Configure
125	
126	> **💡 Tip: Use the Web UI to configure** — After installing, run `pi-connect web` to configure the web admin and open the dashboard in your browser. You can visually create projects, add platforms, manage providers, and chat with your agent — no need to manually edit TOML files. **Note:** `pi-connect web` only configures and opens the browser — you still need to run `pi-connect` separately to start the service.
127	
128	If you prefer manual configuration:
129	
130	```bash
131	mkdir -p ~/.pi-connect
132	cp config.example.toml ~/.pi-connect/config.toml
133	vim ~/.pi-connect/config.toml
134	```
135	
136	Set `admin_from = "alice,bob"` in a project to allow those user IDs to run privileged commands such as `/dir` and `/shell`.
137	When a user runs `/dir reset`, pi-connect restores the configured `work_dir` and clears the persisted override stored under `data_dir/projects/<project>.state.json`.
138	
139	
140	### ▶️ Run
141	
142	```bash
143	./pi-connect
144	```
145	
146	
147	### 🔄 Upgrade
148	
149	```bash
150	# npm
151	npm install -g pi-connect
152	
153	# Homebrew
154	brew upgrade pi-connect
155	
156	# Binary self-update
157	pi-connect update           # Stable
158	pi-connect update --pre     # Include pre-releases
159	```

194	
195	## 🎯 Key Features
196	
197	### 💬 Session Management
198	
199	```
200	/new [name]       Start a new session
201	/list             List all sessions
202	/switch <id>      Switch session
203	/current          Show current session
204	/dir [path|reset] Show, switch, or reset work directory
205	```
206	
207	Project configs rotate to a fresh session automatically after long inactivity. This prevents "context drift" where stale chat history (failed commands, debugging noise) is repeatedly re-ingested via `--continue` and starts to dominate the model's attention. The previous session is preserved and remains accessible via `/list` and `/switch`.
208	
209	```toml
210	[[projects]]
211	reset_on_idle_mins = 30   # default when unset; set to 0 to disable
212	```
213	
214	The default is **30 minutes** when unset. Set `reset_on_idle_mins = 0` to opt out and always continue the previous session.
215	
216	### 🛡️ OS-User Isolation (`run_as_user`)
217	
218	On Linux/macOS, a project can spawn Pi under a different Unix
219	user for OS-level file-system isolation from the supervisor user that
220	runs pi-connect.
221	
222	```toml
223	[[projects]]
224	name = "pi-sandboxed"
225	run_as_user = "partseeker-coder"
226	run_as_env = ["PGSSLROOTCERT"]
227	```
228	
229	The target user needs passwordless sudo from the supervisor, no sudo
230	of its own, read+write on `work_dir`, and its own Pi credentials.
231	See [`docs/usage.md`](./docs/usage.md#running-agents-as-a-different-unix-user-run_as_user)
232	for the full setup.
233	
234	Before starting pi-connect, audit the setup with:
235	
236	```bash
237	pi-connect doctor user-isolation
238	```
239	
240	This runs three go/no-go preflight gates and an isolation probe that
241	reports what the target user can and cannot read. pi-connect refuses to
242	start if any gate fails or if the probe detects a cross-user leak.
243	
244	---
245	
246	### 🔐 Permission Modes
247	
248	```
249	/mode             Show available modes
250	/mode yolo        # Auto-approve all tools
251	/mode default     # Ask for each tool
252	```
253	
254	
255	### 🔄 Provider Management
256	
257	```
258	/provider list              List providers
259	/provider switch <name>     Switch API provider at runtime
260	```
261	
262	
263	### 🤖 Model Selection
264	
265	```
266	/model                      List available models (format: alias - model)
267	/model switch <alias>       Switch to model by alias
268	```
269	
270	
271	### 📂 Work Directory
272	
273	```
274	/dir                         Show current work directory and history
275	/dir <path>                  Switch to a path (relative or absolute)
276	/dir <number>                Switch from history
277	/dir -                       Switch to previous directory
278	/cd <path>                   Compatibility alias for /dir <path>
279	```
280	
281	
282	### ⏰ Scheduled Tasks
283	
284	```bash
285	/cron add 0 6 * * * Summarize GitHub trending
286	```
287	
288	### 📎 Agent Attachment Send-Back
289	
290	When an agent generates a local screenshot, chart, PDF, bundle, or other file, it can send that attachment back to the current chat.
291	
292	First release supports:
293	- Feishu
294	- Telegram
295	
296	If your agent does not natively inject the system prompt, run this once in chat after upgrading:
297	
298	```text
299	/bind setup
300	```
301	
302	or:
303	
304	```text
305	/cron setup
306	```
307	
308	This refreshes the pi-connect instructions in the project memory file so the agent knows how to send attachments back.
309	
310	You can control this feature globally in `config.toml`:
311	
312	```toml
313	attachment_send = "on"  # default: "on"; set to "off" to block image/file send-back
314	```
315	
316	This switch is independent from the agent's `/mode`. It only controls `pi-connect send --image/--file`.
317	
318	Examples:
319	
320	```bash
321	pi-connect send --image /absolute/path/to/chart.png
322	pi-connect send --file /absolute/path/to/report.pdf
323	pi-connect send --file /absolute/path/to/report.pdf --image /absolute/path/to/chart.png
324	```
325	
326	Notes:
327	- Absolute paths are the safest option.
328	- `--image` and `--file` can both be repeated.
329	- `attachment_send = "off"` disables only attachment send-back; ordinary text replies still work.
330	- This command is for generated attachments, not ordinary text replies.
331	
332	📖 **Full documentation:** [docs/usage.md](docs/usage.md)

_**Agent - sidechain (gpt-5.6-sol 2026-08-31 04:26:08Z)**_

Pi 0.84.4’s source and extension documentation confirm the central timing premise: `agent_end` closes one low-level run, while retry, compaction, and queued continuations can follow before `agent_settled`. The pinned pi-chat and TelePi sources do finalize on `agent_end`; I’m narrowing the Pirelay handler and then checking whether that incompatibility is already adequately disclosed by the spike gate rather than assuming every source mismatch needs another table phrase.

3	// piRPCSession drives `pi --mode rpc` as a long-lived subprocess.
4	//
5	// Why this exists:
6	//   - JSON mode (`pi --mode json -p <prompt>`) spawns a fresh process per turn.
7	//     That works for plain prompts but breaks extension commands (e.g. /goals,
8	//     /sisyphus from @capyup/pi-goal) because they assume a persistent extension
9	//     runtime and a UI surface that JSON mode doesn't provide.
10	//   - RPC mode keeps one pi process alive for the whole session, dispatches
11	//     extension commands properly, and exposes an extension UI sub-protocol we
12	//     can bridge.
13	//
14	// Wire shape (NOT JSON-RPC 2.0 — pi's own JSONL protocol):
15	//   Commands (stdin):  {"id": "...", "type": "prompt", "message": "..."}
16	//   Responses (stdout): {"id": "...", "type": "response", "command": "prompt", "success": true}
17	//   Events (stdout):    {"type": "message_update", ...}  (no id)
18	//   UI requests (stdout): {"type": "extension_ui_request", "id": "...", "method": "..."}
19	//   UI replies (stdin):   {"type": "extension_ui_response", "id": "...", "value": "..."}
20	//
21	// Framing rules per pi docs: strict JSONL, LF-only delimiter. Do not use a
22	// generic Unicode line reader. bufio.Scanner with ScanLines is safe.

236	func newPiRPCSession(ctx context.Context, cmd, workDir, model, mode, thinking, resumeID string, extraEnv []string) (*piRPCSession, error) {
237		sessCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
238		s := &piRPCSession{
239			cmd:                 cmd,
240			workDir:             workDir,
241			model:               model,
242			mode:                mode,
243			thinking:            thinking,
244			extraEnv:            extraEnv,
245			events:              make(chan core.Event, 64),
246			ctx:                 sessCtx,
247			cancel:              cancel,
248			pending:             make(map[string]*rpcPending),
249			writeGate:           make(chan struct{}, 1),
250			mutatingGate:        make(chan struct{}, 1),
251			slowAcceptanceAfter: 30 * time.Second,
252		}
253		s.writeGate <- struct{}{}
254		s.mutatingGate <- struct{}{}
255		s.slowAcceptanceLog = func(command string, elapsed time.Duration) {
256			slog.Warn("piRPCSession: slow command acceptance",
257				"command", command,
258				"elapsed", elapsed,
259				"session_id", s.CurrentSessionID(),
260			)
261		}
262		s.alive.Store(true)
263		s.healthPhase = core.StallPhaseSettled
264		if resumeID != "" && resumeID != core.ContinueSession {
265			s.sessionID.Store(resumeID)
266		}
267		return s, nil
268	}

270	// startProcess spawns `pi --mode rpc` and starts the read loop. Idempotent.
271	func (s *piRPCSession) startProcess() error {
272		return s.startProcessContext(s.ctx)
273	}
274	
275	func (s *piRPCSession) startProcessContext(ctx context.Context) error {
276		if ctx == nil {
277			ctx = context.Background()
278		}
279		s.startOnce.Do(func() {
280			s.startErr = s.doStart(ctx)
281		})
282		return s.startErr
283	}
284	
285	func (s *piRPCSession) doStart(startCtx context.Context) error {
286		args := []string{"--mode", "rpc"}
287		if sid, _ := s.sessionID.Load().(string); sid != "" {
288			args = append(args, "--session", sid)
289		}
290		if s.model != "" {
291			args = append(args, "--model", s.model)
292		}
293		if s.mode == "yolo" {
294			args = append(args, "--auto-approve")
295		}
296		if s.thinking != "" {
297			args = append(args, "--thinking", s.thinking)
298		}
299	
300		slog.Debug("piRPCSession: launching", "args", core.RedactArgs(args))
301	
302		cmd := exec.CommandContext(s.ctx, s.cmd, args...)
303		cmd.Dir = s.workDir
304		env := os.Environ()
305		if len(s.extraEnv) > 0 {
306			env = core.MergeEnv(env, s.extraEnv)
307		}
308		cmd.Env = env
309	
310		stdin, err := cmd.StdinPipe()
311		if err != nil {
312			return fmt.Errorf("piRPCSession: stdin pipe: %w", err)
313		}
314		stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
315		if err != nil {
316			return fmt.Errorf("piRPCSession: stdout pipe: %w", err)
317		}
318		var stderrBuf boundedStderrBuffer
319		cmd.Stderr = &stderrBuf
320	
321		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
322			return fmt.Errorf("piRPCSession: start: %w", err)
323		}
324		s.generation.Add(1)
325	
326		s.procMu.Lock()
327		s.proc = cmd
328		s.stdin = stdin
329		s.stdout = stdout
330		s.stderr = &stderrBuf
331		s.procMu.Unlock()
332	
333		// readLoop drains stdout before calling Wait. os/exec documents that Wait
334		// closes pipes after observing process exit, so a concurrent Wait can discard
335		// buffered ACK/agent_settled frames and break acceptance/settlement semantics.
336		s.wg.Add(1)
337		go s.readLoop(cmd)
338	
339		s.acquireSessionIDFromStateContext(startCtx, "startup")
340	
341		return nil
342	}
343	
344	// readLoop drains stdout, demuxing responses, events, and UI requests.
345	func (s *piRPCSession) readLoop(cmd *exec.Cmd) {
346		defer s.wg.Done()
347		s.procMu.Lock()
348		stdout := s.stdout
349		s.procMu.Unlock()
350		if stdout == nil {
351			return
352		}
353	
354		// Pi events can include large blobs (e.g. base64 image content in user
355		// messages echoed back). Match JSON-mode buffer size.
356		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(stdout)
357		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 64*1024), 16*1024*1024)
358		// Default ScanLines splits on \n and strips trailing \r. That matches
359		// pi's LF-only framing while tolerating CRLF if a wrapper introduces it.
360	
361		for scanner.Scan() {
362			line := scanner.Bytes()
363			if len(bytes.TrimSpace(line)) == 0 {
364				continue
365			}
366			s.dispatchLine(line)
367		}
368		scanErr := scanner.Err()
369		if scanErr != nil {
370			slog.Debug("piRPCSession: stdout scanner closed", "error", scanErr)
371		}
372		// stdout reached EOF: all protocol frames have been drained, so Wait can
373		// safely finalize ProcessState and stderr without truncating the pipe.
374		waitErr := cmd.Wait()
375		s.alive.Store(false)
376		if s.closing.Load() || s.ctx.Err() != nil {
377			return
378		}
379	
380		s.procMu.Lock()
381		stderr := ""
382		if s.stderr != nil {
383			stderr = s.stderr.String()
384		}
385		s.procMu.Unlock()
386		metadataErr := waitErr
387		if metadataErr == nil {
388			metadataErr = errors.New("exit status 0")
389		}
390		cause := newUnexpectedProcessExitError("pi RPC", cmd, metadataErr, stderr)
391		if scanErr != nil {
392			cause = fmt.Errorf("%w; stdout read error: %v", cause, scanErr)
393		}
394		slog.Warn("piRPCSession: transport exited", "error", cause)
395		s.emitTransportFailure(cause)
396	}

398	func (s *piRPCSession) dispatchLine(line []byte) {
399		var env struct {
400			Type string          `json:"type"`
401			ID   json.RawMessage `json:"id"`
402		}
403		if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &env); err != nil {
404			slog.Debug("piRPCSession: non-JSON line", "line", truncBytes(line, 120))
405			return
406		}
407	
408		switch env.Type {
409		case "response":
410			s.handleResponse(line)
411		case "extension_ui_request":
412			s.handleUIRequest(line)
413		case "session":
414			var sess struct {
415				ID string `json:"id"`
416			}
417			_ = json.Unmarshal(line, &sess)
418			if sess.ID != "" {
419				s.sessionID.Store(sess.ID)
420			}
421		default:
422			// Generic agent event (message_update, message_end, tool_*, etc.).
423			// Reuse JSON-mode event handling.
424			var raw map[string]any
425			if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &raw); err == nil {
426				s.handleAgentEvent(raw)
427			}
428		}
429	}
430	
431	// handleAgentEvent reuses the JSON-mode event semantics. It's intentionally a
432	// thin wrapper around the existing piSession event handlers so we don't drift.
433	func (s *piRPCSession) handleAgentEvent(raw map[string]any) {
434		s.updateUsageFromEvent(raw)
435		eventType, _ := raw["type"].(string)
436		s.noteProtocolEvent(eventType)
437		switch eventType {
438		case "message_update":
439			s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseStreaming, false)
440			s.rpcHandleMessageUpdate(raw)
441		case "message_end":
442			s.rpcHandleMessageEnd(raw)
443		case "custom_message":
444			if content := customMessageContent(raw); content != "" {
445				s.rpcFinalizeCustomMessage(content)
446			}
447		case "agent_start":
448			s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseRunning, false)
449			s.streamMu.Lock()
450			s.isStreaming = true
451			s.streamMu.Unlock()
452			s.rpcBeginAttempt()
453		case "agent_end":
454			// agent_end is deliberately not a terminal boundary. Pi can retry,
455			// compact, or continue queued work after it.
456			s.rpcHandleAgentEnd(raw)
457		case "agent_settled":
458			s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseSettled, false)
459			s.streamMu.Lock()
460			s.isStreaming = false
461			s.streamMu.Unlock()
462			s.rpcHandleAgentSettled()
463		case "auto_retry_start":
464			s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseRetrying, false)
465			s.rpcHandleAutoRetryStart(raw)
466		case "auto_retry_end":
467			s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseRunning, false)
468			s.rpcHandleAutoRetryEnd(raw)
469		case "extension_error":
470			s.rpcHandleExtensionError(raw)
471		case "turn_end":
472			// A single prompt can produce multiple turns (assistant -> tools -> assistant).
473			// Only agent_settled completes the pi-connect turn.
474		case "compaction_start", "compaction_end", "summarization_retry_scheduled", "summarization_retry_attempt_start", "summarization_retry_finished":
475			switch eventType {
476			case "compaction_start":
477				s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseCompacting, true)
478			case "summarization_retry_scheduled", "summarization_retry_attempt_start":
479				s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseRetrying, true)
480			case "compaction_end", "summarization_retry_finished":
481				s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseRunning, false)
482			}
483			s.rpcHandleCompactionEvent(eventType, raw)
484		case "tool_execution_start", "tool_execution_update":
485			s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseTool, false)
486		case "tool_execution_end":
487			s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseRunning, false)
488		case "queue_update":
489			// agent_settled remains authoritative; queue updates are liveness only.
490			slog.Debug("piRPCSession: queue state changed", "session_id", s.CurrentSessionID())
491		}
492	}
493	
494	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcHandleExtensionError(raw map[string]any) {
495		errMsg, _ := raw["error"].(string)
496		extPath, _ := raw["extensionPath"].(string)
497		extErr := &rpcExtensionError{extension: filepath.Base(extPath), message: errMsg}
498	
499		s.turnMu.Lock()
500		if s.turn.active || s.promptPending {
501			// EventError ends the engine's foreground wait even when nontransport.
502			// Defer errors tied to an ACK/active run to avoid a second settlement.
503			s.turn.pendingExtensionErr = extErr.Error()
504			s.turnMu.Unlock()
505			return
506		}
507		s.turn.finalizedSeq++
508		s.turnMu.Unlock()
509		s.emitLifecycle(core.Event{Type: core.EventError, Error: extErr})
510	}
511	
512	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcHandleCompactionEvent(eventType string, raw map[string]any) {
513		switch eventType {
514		case "compaction_start":
515			slog.Info("piRPCSession: compaction started", "session_id", s.CurrentSessionID())
516			s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventThinking, Content: "Context compaction started"})
517		case "compaction_end":
518			if errMsg, _ := raw["errorMessage"].(string); errMsg != "" {
519				slog.Warn("piRPCSession: compaction failed", "session_id", s.CurrentSessionID(), "error", errMsg)
520				s.turnMu.Lock()
521				active := s.turn.active
522				hasValidAnswer := s.turn.committedSuccess || s.turn.attemptSucceeded
523				if active && !hasValidAnswer {
524					s.turn.finalErr = "context compaction failed: " + errMsg
525				}
526				s.turnMu.Unlock()
527				if active && hasValidAnswer {
528					// Threshold compaction runs after a valid answer. Its failure must
529					// not replace that answer with a failed turn.
530					s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventThinking, Content: "Context compaction failed; answer preserved"})
531				}
532				if !active {
533					// Manual compact commands do not create an agent run/agent_settled.
534					s.emitLifecycle(core.Event{Type: core.EventError, Error: &rpcProviderError{message: "context compaction failed: " + errMsg}})
535				}
536				return
537			}
538			slog.Info("piRPCSession: compaction completed", "session_id", s.CurrentSessionID())
539			s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventThinking, Content: "Context compaction completed"})
540		case "summarization_retry_scheduled":
541			s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventThinking, Content: "Context compaction retry scheduled"})
542		case "summarization_retry_attempt_start":
543			s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventThinking, Content: "Context compaction retry started"})
544		}
545	}
546	
547	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcBeginAttempt() {
548		s.turnMu.Lock()
549		var extensionWarning string
550		if !s.turn.active {
551			seq := s.turn.finalizedSeq
552			extensionWarning = s.turn.pendingExtensionErr
553			deferredCustom := append([]string(nil), s.turn.deferredCustom...)
554			s.turn = rpcTurnState{active: true, finalizedSeq: seq, deferredCustom: deferredCustom}
555		}
556		s.turn.attemptOutput = ""
557		s.turn.streamed.Reset()
558		s.turn.attemptErr = ""
559		s.turn.attemptSucceeded = false
560		s.turn.attemptUsage = piUsage{}
561		s.turnMu.Unlock()
562		if extensionWarning != "" {
563			s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventThinking, Content: extensionWarning})
564		}
565	}

567	// rpcHandleAgentEnd records one low-level run. It never emits EventResult or
568	// EventError: willRetry, overflow compaction, or extension-queued continuation
569	// can all follow before agent_settled.
570	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcHandleAgentEnd(raw map[string]any) {
571		var output strings.Builder
572		var finalErr string
573		var sawSuccessfulAssistant bool
574		var attemptUsage piUsage
575		if messages, ok := raw["messages"].([]any); ok {
576			for _, m := range messages {
577				msg, _ := m.(map[string]any)
578				if msg == nil {
579					continue
580				}
581				if role, _ := msg["role"].(string); role != "assistant" {
582					continue
583				}
584				s.recordUsageFromMessage(msg)
585				if u, ok := parsePiUsage(msg["usage"]); ok {
586					attemptUsage = u
587				}
588				if errMsg := assistantError(msg); errMsg != "" {
589					finalErr = errMsg
590					if isRecoverablePiOverflow(errMsg) {
591						s.storePendingOverflowError(errMsg)
592					}
593					continue
594				}
595				if assistantMessageSucceeded(msg) {
596					finalErr = ""
597					sawSuccessfulAssistant = true
598					s.clearPendingOverflowError()
599				}
600				output.WriteString(assistantText(msg))
601			}
602		}
603	
604		willRetry, _ := raw["willRetry"].(bool)
605		s.turnMu.Lock()
606		if !s.turn.active {
607			seq := s.turn.finalizedSeq
608			s.turn = rpcTurnState{active: true, finalizedSeq: seq}
609		}
610		if output.Len() > 0 {
611			s.turn.attemptOutput = output.String()
612		} else if s.turn.attemptOutput == "" {
613			s.turn.attemptOutput = s.turn.streamed.String()
614		}
615		if finalErr != "" {
616			s.turn.attemptErr = finalErr
617		}
618		if sawSuccessfulAssistant {
619			s.turn.attemptSucceeded = true
620		}
621		if attemptUsage.usedTokens() > 0 {
622			s.turn.attemptUsage = attemptUsage
623		}
624		if s.turn.attemptUsage.usedTokens() > 0 {
625			s.turn.attemptUsages = append(s.turn.attemptUsages, s.turn.attemptUsage)
626		}
627		if willRetry {
628			// Preserve completed assistant/tool-turn text from this run, but discard
629			// the final failed assistant call's uncommitted stream.
630			s.turn.committed.WriteString(output.String())
631			s.turn.committedSuccess = s.turn.committedSuccess || sawSuccessfulAssistant
632			s.turn.attemptOutput = ""
633			s.turn.streamed.Reset()
634			s.turn.attemptErr = ""
635			s.turn.finalErr = ""
636		} else if s.turn.attemptErr != "" {
637			s.turn.finalErr = s.turn.attemptErr
638			s.turn.attemptOutput = ""
639		} else {
640			s.turn.committed.WriteString(s.turn.attemptOutput)
641			s.turn.committedSuccess = s.turn.committedSuccess || s.turn.attemptSucceeded
642			s.turn.finalErr = ""
643			s.turn.attemptOutput = ""
644		}
645		s.turnMu.Unlock()
646	}
647	
648	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcHandleAutoRetryStart(_ map[string]any) {
649		s.turnMu.Lock()
650		if !s.turn.active {
651			seq := s.turn.finalizedSeq
652			s.turn = rpcTurnState{active: true, finalizedSeq: seq}
653		}
654		// Be defensive with older producers that omit agent_end.willRetry.
655		if s.turn.finalErr != "" {
656			s.turn.finalErr = ""
657		}
658		s.turn.attemptOutput = ""
659		s.turn.streamed.Reset()
660		s.turn.attemptErr = ""
661		s.turn.attemptSucceeded = false
662		s.turnMu.Unlock()
663		s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventThinking, Content: "Provider retry in progress"})
664	}
665	
666	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcHandleAutoRetryEnd(raw map[string]any) {
667		if success, _ := raw["success"].(bool); success {
668			return
669		}
670		if finalErr, _ := raw["finalError"].(string); finalErr != "" {
671			s.turnMu.Lock()
672			if s.turn.active {
673				s.turn.finalErr = finalErr
674			}
675			s.turnMu.Unlock()
676		}
677	}
678	
679	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcHandleAgentSettled() {
680		s.turnMu.Lock()
681		if !s.turn.active {
682			s.turnMu.Unlock()
683			return
684		}
685		content := s.turn.committed.String()
686		if s.turn.finalErr == "" && s.turn.attemptOutput != "" {
687			content += s.turn.attemptOutput
688		}
689		errMsg := s.turn.finalErr
690		if errMsg == "" && content == "" && !s.turn.committedSuccess && !s.turn.attemptSucceeded {
691			errMsg = s.pendingOverflowErrorForEOF()
692		}
693		extensionWarning := s.turn.pendingExtensionErr
694		deferredCustom := append([]string(nil), s.turn.deferredCustom...)
695		s.turn.pendingExtensionErr = ""
696		s.turn.deferredCustom = nil
697		s.turn.active = false
698		s.turn.finalizedSeq++
699		s.turnMu.Unlock()
700	
701		if extensionWarning != "" {
702			s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventThinking, Content: extensionWarning})
703		}
704		if errMsg != "" {
705			if len(deferredCustom) > 0 {
706				// Core returns immediately on EventError and resyncs remaining events.
707				// Fold side notifications into the one settled error so none are lost.
708				errMsg += "\n\n" + strings.Join(deferredCustom, "\n")
709				deferredCustom = nil
710			}
711			s.emitLifecycle(core.Event{Type: core.EventError, Error: &rpcProviderError{message: errMsg}})
712		} else {
713			evt := core.Event{Type: core.EventResult, Content: content, SessionID: s.CurrentSessionID(), Done: true}
714			if usage := s.GetContextUsage(); usage != nil {
715				evt.InputTokens = usage.UsedTokens
716				evt.OutputTokens = usage.OutputTokens
717			}
718			s.emitLifecycle(evt)
719		}
720		for _, custom := range deferredCustom {
721			s.emitLifecycle(core.Event{Type: core.EventResult, Content: custom, Done: true, SessionID: s.CurrentSessionID()})
722		}
723	}
724	
725	func assistantError(msg map[string]any) string {
726		if errMsg, _ := msg["errorMessage"].(string); errMsg != "" {
727			return errMsg
728		}
729		if stopReason, _ := msg["stopReason"].(string); stopReason == "error" {
730			return "assistant provider error"
731		}
732		return ""
733	}
734	
735	func assistantText(msg map[string]any) string {
736		content, _ := msg["content"].([]any)
737		var b strings.Builder
738		for _, c := range content {
739			item, _ := c.(map[string]any)
740			if item == nil {
741				continue
742			}
743			if typ, _ := item["type"].(string); typ != "text" {
744				continue
745			}
746			if text, ok := item["text"].(string); ok {
747				b.WriteString(text)
748			}
749		}
750		return b.String()
751	}
752	
753	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcHandleMessageUpdate(raw map[string]any) {
754		ame, _ := raw["assistantMessageEvent"].(map[string]any)
755		if ame == nil {
756			return
757		}
758		subType, _ := ame["type"].(string)
759		switch subType {
760		case "text_delta":
761			if delta, _ := ame["delta"].(string); delta != "" {
762				// Buffer until agent_settled. Streaming failed-attempt text outward
763				// cannot be retracted safely when Pi retries.
764				s.turnMu.Lock()
765				if !s.turn.active {
766					seq := s.turn.finalizedSeq
767					s.turn = rpcTurnState{active: true, finalizedSeq: seq}
768				}
769				s.turn.streamed.WriteString(delta)
770				s.turnMu.Unlock()
771			}
772		case "thinking_delta":
773			if delta, _ := ame["delta"].(string); delta != "" {
774				s.thinkingBuf.WriteString(delta)
775			}
776		case "thinking_end":
777			if s.thinkingBuf.Len() > 0 {
778				s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventThinking, Content: s.thinkingBuf.String()})
779				s.thinkingBuf.Reset()
780			}
781		case "toolcall_end":
782			s.rpcEmitToolFromMessage(ame)
783		}
784	}
785	
786	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcEmitToolFromMessage(ame map[string]any) {
787		msg, _ := ame["message"].(map[string]any)
788		if msg == nil {
789			msg, _ = ame["partial"].(map[string]any)
790		}
791		if msg == nil {
792			return
793		}
794		content, _ := msg["content"].([]any)
795		idx := 0
796		if ci, ok := ame["contentIndex"].(float64); ok {
797			idx = int(ci)
798		}
799		if idx < 0 || idx >= len(content) {
800			return
801		}
802		item, _ := content[idx].(map[string]any)
803		if item == nil {
804			return
805		}
806		if t, _ := item["type"].(string); t != "toolCall" {
807			return
808		}
809		name, _ := item["name"].(string)
810		input := extractToolInput(item)
811		s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventToolUse, ToolName: name, ToolInput: input})
812	}
813	
814	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcHandleMessageEnd(raw map[string]any) {
815		msg, _ := raw["message"].(map[string]any)
816		if msg == nil {
817			return
818		}
819		role, _ := msg["role"].(string)
820		switch role {
821		case "toolResult":
822			toolName, _ := msg["toolName"].(string)
823			content, _ := msg["content"].([]any)
824			var output string
825			for _, c := range content {
826				if item, ok := c.(map[string]any); ok {
827					if text, ok := item["text"].(string); ok {
828						output = text
829						break
830					}
831				}
832			}
833			s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventToolResult, ToolName: toolName, Content: truncStr(output, 500)})
834		case "assistant":
835			s.recordUsageFromMessage(msg)
836			s.turnMu.Lock()
837			if !s.turn.active {
838				seq := s.turn.finalizedSeq
839				s.turn = rpcTurnState{active: true, finalizedSeq: seq}
840			}
841			if u, ok := parsePiUsage(msg["usage"]); ok {
842				s.turn.attemptUsage = u
843			}
844			if errMsg := assistantError(msg); errMsg != "" {
845				s.turn.attemptErr = errMsg
846				s.turn.attemptOutput = ""
847				s.turnMu.Unlock()
848				if isRecoverablePiOverflow(errMsg) {
849					s.storePendingOverflowError(errMsg)
850				}
851				return
852			}
853			text := assistantText(msg)
854			if text != "" {
855				s.turn.attemptOutput += text
856			}
857			s.turnMu.Unlock()
858			if assistantMessageSucceeded(msg) {
859				s.turnMu.Lock()
860				s.turn.attemptSucceeded = true
861				s.turnMu.Unlock()
862				s.clearPendingOverflowError()
863			}
864		}
865	}
866	
867	func (s *piRPCSession) updateUsageFromEvent(raw map[string]any) {
868		if msg, _ := raw["message"].(map[string]any); msg != nil {
869			s.recordUsageFromMessage(msg)
870		}
871		if messages, _ := raw["messages"].([]any); messages != nil {
872			for _, item := range messages {
873				if msg, _ := item.(map[string]any); msg != nil {
874					s.recordUsageFromMessage(msg)
875				}
876			}
877		}
878	}
879	
880	func (s *piRPCSession) recordUsageFromMessage(msg map[string]any) {
881		u, ok := parsePiUsage(msg["usage"])
882		if !ok {
883			return
884		}
885		s.usageMu.Lock()
886		s.contextUsage = u.contextUsage()
887		s.usageMu.Unlock()
888	}
889	
890	func (s *piRPCSession) GetContextUsage() *core.ContextUsage {
891		s.usageMu.Lock()
892		defer s.usageMu.Unlock()
893		return cloneContextUsage(s.contextUsage)
894	}
895	
896	func (s *piRPCSession) storePendingOverflowError(errMsg string) {
897		s.usageMu.Lock()
898		defer s.usageMu.Unlock()
899		s.pendingContextOverflowErr = errMsg
900		s.recoveredAfterOverflow = false
901	}
902	
903	func (s *piRPCSession) clearPendingOverflowError() {
904		s.usageMu.Lock()
905		defer s.usageMu.Unlock()
906		if s.pendingContextOverflowErr != "" {
907			s.pendingContextOverflowErr = ""
908			s.recoveredAfterOverflow = true
909		}
910	}
911	
912	func (s *piRPCSession) pendingOverflowErrorForEOF() string {
913		s.usageMu.Lock()
914		defer s.usageMu.Unlock()
915		if s.recoveredAfterOverflow {
916			return ""
917		}
918		return s.pendingContextOverflowErr
919	}
920	
921	func (s *piRPCSession) handleResponse(line []byte) {
922		var resp struct {
923			ID      json.RawMessage `json:"id"`
924			Success bool            `json:"success"`
925			Data    json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
926			Command string          `json:"command"`
927			Error   string          `json:"error"`
928			Message string          `json:"message"`
929		}
930		if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &resp); err != nil {
931			slog.Debug("piRPCSession: bad response line", "err", err)
932			return
933		}
934		if resp.Success && resp.Command == "get_state" {
935			s.storeSessionIDFromStateData(resp.Data)
936		}
937		key := idKey(resp.ID)
938		if key == "" {
939			return
940		}
941		s.pendingMu.Lock()
942		pending, ok := s.pending[key]
943		delete(s.pending, key)
944		s.pendingMu.Unlock()
945		if !ok {
946			slog.Debug("piRPCSession: unmatched response", "id", key, "command", resp.Command)
947			return
948		}
949		errMsg := resp.Error
950		if errMsg == "" {
951			errMsg = resp.Message
952		}
953		// Buffered channel plus map ownership gives exactly-once completion. The
954		// receiver may be racing caller cancellation, but only map winner decides.
955		pending.ch <- rpcCallResult{response: rpcResponse{success: resp.Success, data: resp.Data, errMsg: errMsg}}
956	}
957	
958	// handleUIRequest auto-cancels all dialog methods (Phase 1 strategy).
959	// Fire-and-forget methods are logged and dropped. Phase 2 will add a real
960	// bridge here (chat-text fallback or Telegram inline keyboard).
961	func (s *piRPCSession) handleUIRequest(line []byte) {
962		var req struct {
963			ID     string `json:"id"`
964			Method string `json:"method"`
965			Title  string `json:"title"`
966		}
967		if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &req); err != nil {
968			return
969		}
970		slog.Debug("piRPCSession: extension UI request", "method", req.Method, "id", req.ID, "title", req.Title)
971	
972		switch req.Method {
973		case "select", "confirm", "input", "editor":
974			// Auto-cancel dialog. Extension sees cancelled=true; most well-behaved
975			// extensions then fall back to a safe default (refuse-by-default for
976			// confirm, no-op for select, etc.).
977			_ = s.writeJSON(map[string]any{
978				"type":      "extension_ui_response",
979				"id":        req.ID,
980				"cancelled": true,
981			})
982		default:
983			// Fire-and-forget (notify, setStatus, setWidget, setTitle, ...).
984			// Surface notifications as text events so the user at least sees them.
985			var notify struct {
986				Method     string `json:"method"`
987				Message    string `json:"message"`
988				NotifyType string `json:"notifyType"`
989			}
990			if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &notify); err == nil && notify.Method == "notify" && notify.Message != "" {
991				prefix := "ℹ️ "
992				if notify.NotifyType == "warning" {
993					prefix = "⚠️ "
994				} else if notify.NotifyType == "error" {
995					prefix = "❌ "
996				}
997				s.tryEmit(core.Event{Type: core.EventText, Content: prefix + notify.Message + "\n"})
998			}
999			// All other fire-and-forget UI methods (setStatus, setWidget, setTitle,
1000			// setHeader, setFooter, ...) are TUI affordances; nothing to do.
1001		}
1002	}
1003	
1004	// Send implements core.AgentSession.Send. It waits for prompt acceptance while
1005	// turn events stream asynchronously via Events().
1006	func (s *piRPCSession) Send(prompt string, images []core.ImageAttachment, files []core.FileAttachment) error {
1007		return s.SendContext(s.ctx, prompt, images, files)
1008	}
1009	
1010	// SendContext waits for Pi's authoritative prompt-acceptance ACK. Once stdin
1011	// accepts the complete command, cancellation before that ACK is outcome-unknown
1012	// and must never trigger an automatic replay.
1013	func (s *piRPCSession) SendContext(ctx context.Context, prompt string, images []core.ImageAttachment, files []core.FileAttachment) error {
1014		if ctx == nil {
1015			ctx = context.Background()
1016		}
1017		if !s.alive.Load() {
1018			return &RPCCommandNotSentError{Command: "prompt", Cause: errors.New("session is closed")}
1019		}
1020		if err := s.startProcessContext(ctx); err != nil {
1021			return &RPCCommandNotSentError{Command: "prompt", Cause: err}
1022		}
1023		if err := s.acquireMutating(ctx, "prompt"); err != nil {
1024			return err
1025		}
1026		defer s.releaseMutating()
1027	
1028		cleanAttachments(s.workDir)
1029		var atFiles []string
1030		if len(images) > 0 {
1031			atFiles = append(atFiles, saveImagesToDisk(s.workDir, images)...)
1032		}
1033		// File attachments are classified: inline-safe text/code stays on the
1034		// `@<path>` inline path; everything else is surfaced as a path-only
1035		// reference in the message body so the model uses its `read` tool /
1036		// domain skills rather than blowing the context window. See
1037		// attachments.go for classification rules and rationale.
1038		attached := classifyFileAttachments(s.workDir, files)
1039		atFiles = append(atFiles, attached.inlinePaths...)
1040		body := prompt
1041		if refPrefix := buildAttachmentPrefix(attached.referencePaths, files); refPrefix != "" {
1042			body = refPrefix + body
1043		}
1044		// Pi RPC mode's `prompt` command doesn't accept @file as a separate
1045		// argument; we prefix `@<path>` tokens into the message text instead.
1046		// Pi expands those references identically to the CLI's positional form.
1047		msg := body
1048		if len(atFiles) > 0 {
1049			var b strings.Builder
1050			for _, f := range atFiles {
1051				b.WriteString("@")
1052				b.WriteString(f)
1053				b.WriteString(" ")
1054			}
1055			b.WriteString(body)
1056			msg = b.String()
1057		}
1058	
1059		// Decide command + streamingBehavior. If we're mid-stream, the prompt must
1060		// be sent as steering (well-behaved IM clients steer when the user types
1061		// during a turn). Extension commands bypass this: they always go through
1062		// `prompt` regardless of streaming.
1063		isExt := isLikelyExtensionCommand(prompt)
1064		var extensionSeq uint64
1065		s.turnMu.Lock()
1066		s.promptPending = true
1067		s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseAwaitingAcceptance, false)
1068		if isExt {
1069			extensionSeq = s.turn.finalizedSeq
1070		}
1071		s.turnMu.Unlock()
1072		s.streamMu.Lock()
1073		streaming := s.isStreaming
1074		s.streamMu.Unlock()
1075	
1076		var cmd map[string]any
1077		if isExt || !streaming {
1078			cmd = map[string]any{
1079				"type":    "prompt",
1080				"message": msg,
1081			}
1082			if streaming && isExt {
1083				// Extension commands execute immediately even during streaming —
1084				// no streamingBehavior needed per pi docs.
1085			} else if streaming {
1086				cmd["streamingBehavior"] = "steer"
1087			}
1088		} else {
1089			cmd = map[string]any{"type": "prompt", "message": msg, "streamingBehavior": "steer"}
1090		}
1091	
1092		resp, err := s.callMutating(ctx, cmd)
1093		s.turnMu.Lock()
1094		s.promptPending = false
1095		if err != nil || !resp.success {
1096			s.turn.pendingExtensionErr = ""
1097		}
1098		s.turnMu.Unlock()
1099		if err != nil {
1100			if !s.Alive() {
1101				s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseTransportBroken, false)
1102			}
1103			return fmt.Errorf("piRPCSession: prompt command: %w", err)
1104		}
1105		if !resp.success {
1106			s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseSettled, false)
1107			return fmt.Errorf("piRPCSession: pi rejected prompt: %s", resp.errMsg)
1108		}
1109		s.healthMu.Lock()
1110		if s.healthPhase == core.StallPhaseAwaitingAcceptance {
1111			s.healthPhase = core.StallPhaseRunning
1112		}
1113		s.healthMu.Unlock()
1114		if s.CurrentSessionID() == "" {
1115			s.acquireSessionIDFromState("post_prompt")
1116		}
1117		if isExt {
1118			// Extension commands can be fully handled during prompt preflight and
1119			// ACK without starting an agent run; such commands never emit
1120			// agent_settled. Complete only when no run/custom result appeared.
1121			s.rpcFinalizeExtensionACK(extensionSeq)
1122		}
1123		return nil
1124	}
1125	
1126	func (s *piRPCSession) CompactContext() error {
1127		return s.CompactContextWithContext(s.ctx)
1128	}
1129	
1130	// CompactContextWithContext gives manual compaction the same cancellation and
1131	// outcome semantics as prompts. Process death between write and ACK remains
1132	// unknown; durable restart journaling/exact-once recovery is intentionally out
1133	// of scope, so callers must not replay automatically.
1134	func (s *piRPCSession) CompactContextWithContext(ctx context.Context) error {
1135		if ctx == nil {
1136			ctx = context.Background()
1137		}
1138		if !s.alive.Load() {
1139			return &RPCCommandNotSentError{Command: "compact", Cause: errors.New("session is closed")}
1140		}
1141		if err := s.startProcessContext(ctx); err != nil {
1142			return &RPCCommandNotSentError{Command: "compact", Cause: err}
1143		}
1144		if err := s.acquireMutating(ctx, "compact"); err != nil {
1145			return err
1146		}
1147		defer s.releaseMutating()
1148	
1149		resp, err := s.callMutating(ctx, map[string]any{"type": "compact"})
1150		if err != nil {
1151			return fmt.Errorf("piRPCSession: compact command: %w", err)
1152		}
1153		if !resp.success {
1154			return fmt.Errorf("piRPCSession: pi rejected compact: %s", resp.errMsg)
1155		}
1156		return nil
1157	}
1158	
1159	// isLikelyExtensionCommand returns true when the message starts with `/` but is
1160	// not a built-in pi TUI command (which RPC ignores anyway) and not a known
1161	// expansion prefix (skills, prompt templates). Used only to skip the
1162	// streamingBehavior guard.
1163	func isLikelyExtensionCommand(msg string) bool {
1164		m := strings.TrimSpace(msg)
1165		if !strings.HasPrefix(m, "/") {
1166			return false
1167		}
1168		rest := strings.SplitN(m, " ", 2)[0]
1169		if strings.HasPrefix(rest, "/skill:") {
1170			return false
1171		}
1172		return true
1173	}
1174	
1175	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcFinalizeCustomMessage(content string) {
1176		s.turnMu.Lock()
1177		if s.turn.active || s.promptPending {
1178			// Custom/subagent notifications are independent side-channel results.
1179			// Defer them behind the authoritative active-turn settlement. promptPending
1180			// closes the pre-agent_start race after Send has accepted a prompt.
1181			s.turn.deferredCustom = append(s.turn.deferredCustom, content)
1182			s.turnMu.Unlock()
1183			return
1184		}
1185		s.turn.finalizedSeq++
1186		s.turnMu.Unlock()
1187		s.emitLifecycle(core.Event{Type: core.EventResult, Content: content, Done: true, SessionID: s.CurrentSessionID()})
1188	}
1189	
1190	func (s *piRPCSession) rpcFinalizeExtensionACK(before uint64) {
1191		s.turnMu.Lock()
1192		idle := !s.turn.active && s.turn.finalizedSeq == before
1193		s.turnMu.Unlock()
1194		if !idle {
1195			return
1196		}
1197	
1198		// Prompt ACK is emitted immediately before a normal agent run starts, so
1199		// local event state alone has a race. A subsequent protocol state query is
1200		// ordered after prompt handling and distinguishes true extension-only ACKs
1201		// from slash templates/commands that started an agent. This is capability
1202		// state, not a settlement timer.
1203		resp, err := s.callWithTimeout(map[string]any{"type": "get_state"}, 2*time.Second)
1204		if err != nil || !resp.success {
1205			if err == nil {
1206				err = fmt.Errorf("get_state rejected: %s", resp.errMsg)
1207			}
1208			s.emitTransportFailure(fmt.Errorf("cannot confirm extension-only prompt completion: %w", err))
1209			return
1210		}
1211		var state struct {
1212			IsStreaming bool `json:"isStreaming"`
1213		}
1214		if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.data, &state); err != nil {
1215			s.emitTransportFailure(fmt.Errorf("cannot decode extension completion state: %w", err))
1216			return
1217		}
1218		if state.IsStreaming {
1219			return
1220		}
1221	
1222		s.turnMu.Lock()
1223		if s.turn.active || s.turn.finalizedSeq != before {
1224			s.turnMu.Unlock()
1225			return
1226		}
1227		extensionErr := s.turn.pendingExtensionErr
1228		deferredCustom := append([]string(nil), s.turn.deferredCustom...)
1229		s.turn.pendingExtensionErr = ""
1230		s.turn.deferredCustom = nil
1231		s.turn.finalizedSeq++
1232		s.turnMu.Unlock()
1233		if extensionErr != "" {
1234			if len(deferredCustom) > 0 {
1235				extensionErr += "\n\n" + strings.Join(deferredCustom, "\n")
1236			}
1237			s.emitLifecycle(core.Event{Type: core.EventError, Error: errors.New(extensionErr)})
1238			return
1239		}
1240		if len(deferredCustom) == 0 {
1241			s.emitLifecycle(core.Event{Type: core.EventResult, Done: true, SessionID: s.CurrentSessionID()})
1242			return
1243		}
1244		for _, custom := range deferredCustom {
1245			s.emitLifecycle(core.Event{Type: core.EventResult, Content: custom, Done: true, SessionID: s.CurrentSessionID()})
1246		}
1247	}
1248	
1249	func (s *piRPCSession) acquireSessionIDFromState(reason string) {
1250		s.acquireSessionIDFromStateContext(s.ctx, reason)
1251	}
1252	
1253	func (s *piRPCSession) acquireSessionIDFromStateContext(ctx context.Context, reason string) {
1254		if s.CurrentSessionID() != "" {
1255			return
1256		}
1257		resp, err := s.callWithTimeoutContext(ctx, map[string]any{"type": "get_state"}, 2*time.Second)
1258		if err != nil {
1259			slog.Debug("piRPCSession: get_state session id lookup failed", "reason", reason, "error", err)
1260			return
1261		}
1262		if !resp.success {
1263			slog.Debug("piRPCSession: get_state session id lookup rejected", "reason", reason, "error", resp.errMsg)
1264			return
1265		}
1266		s.storeSessionIDFromStateData(resp.data)
1267	}
1268	
1269	func (s *piRPCSession) storeSessionIDFromStateData(data json.RawMessage) {
1270		if s.CurrentSessionID() != "" || len(bytes.TrimSpace(data)) == 0 {
1271			return
1272		}
1273		var state struct {
1274			SessionID string `json:"sessionId"`
1275		}
1276		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
1277			slog.Debug("piRPCSession: bad get_state data", "error", err)
1278			return
1279		}
1280		if state.SessionID != "" {
1281			s.sessionID.Store(state.SessionID)
1282		}
1283	}

1285	// callWithTimeout is reserved for bounded read-only/idempotent commands. A
1286	// timeout removes that request; monotonic IDs ensure any late response cannot
1287	// satisfy or corrupt a future call.
1288	func (s *piRPCSession) callWithTimeout(payload map[string]any, timeout time.Duration) (rpcResponse, error) {
1289		return s.callWithTimeoutContext(s.ctx, payload, timeout)
1290	}
1291	
1292	func (s *piRPCSession) callWithTimeoutContext(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]any, timeout time.Duration) (rpcResponse, error) {
1293		return s.callRPC(ctx, payload, timeout, false)
1294	}
1295	
1296	// callMutating has no acceptance-failure timeout after a successful write.
1297	// Its only diagnostic timer emits one slow-acceptance warning and keeps waiting.
1298	func (s *piRPCSession) callMutating(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]any) (rpcResponse, error) {
1299		return s.callRPC(ctx, payload, 0, true)
1300	}
1301	
1302	func (s *piRPCSession) callRPC(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]any, timeout time.Duration, mutating bool) (rpcResponse, error) {
1303		if ctx == nil {
1304			ctx = context.Background()
1305		}
1306		command, _ := payload["type"].(string)
1307		if command == "" {
1308			command = "unknown"
1309		}
1310		if err := s.commandUnavailable(ctx); err != nil {
1311			return rpcResponse{}, &RPCCommandNotSentError{Command: command, Cause: err}
1312		}
1313	
1314		id := fmt.Sprintf("%d", s.nextID.Add(1))
1315		payload["id"] = id
1316		pending := &rpcPending{ch: make(chan rpcCallResult, 1), mutating: mutating}
1317		s.pendingMu.Lock()
1318		if !s.alive.Load() {
1319			s.pendingMu.Unlock()
1320			return rpcResponse{}, &RPCCommandNotSentError{Command: command, Cause: errors.New("pi RPC transport is closed")}
1321		}
1322		s.pending[id] = pending
1323		s.pendingMu.Unlock()
1324	
1325		written, cancellationClaimed, err := s.writeJSONTracked(ctx, payload, func() bool {
1326			return s.claimPendingCancellation(id, mutating)
1327		})
1328		if err != nil {
1329			var notStarted *rpcWriteNotStartedError
1330			owned := cancellationClaimed
1331			if !owned {
1332				if errors.As(err, &notStarted) {
1333					owned = s.removePending(id)
1334				} else {
1335					owned = s.claimPendingCancellation(id, mutating)
1336				}
1337			}
1338			if !owned {
1339				// Matched ACK or transport failure already owns the request. A
1340				// definitive ACK wins even if the local writer reports an error later.
1341				claimed := <-pending.ch
1342				if claimed.err == nil {
1343					s.emitTransportFailure(err)
1344					return claimed.response, nil
1345				}
1346				err = claimed.err
1347			} else {
1348				if !errors.As(err, &notStarted) {
1349					s.alive.Store(false)
1350					s.procMu.Lock()
1351					stdin := s.stdin
1352					s.procMu.Unlock()
1353					if stdin != nil {
1354						_ = stdin.Close()
1355					}
1356					s.cancelPending(&rpcTransportError{cause: err})
1357				}
1358			}
1359			if written == 0 {
1360				return rpcResponse{}, &RPCCommandNotSentError{Command: command, Cause: err}
1361			}
1362			if mutating {
1363				return rpcResponse{}, &RPCAcceptanceUnknownError{Command: command, Cause: err}
1364			}
1365			return rpcResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("pi RPC %s partial write: %w", command, err)
1366		}
1367	
1368		ch := pending.ch
1369	
1370		var timeoutTimer *time.Timer
1371		var timeoutCh <-chan time.Time
1372		if timeout > 0 {
1373			timeoutTimer = time.NewTimer(timeout)
1374			defer timeoutTimer.Stop()
1375			timeoutCh = timeoutTimer.C
1376		}
1377		var slowTimer *time.Timer
1378		var slowCh <-chan time.Time
1379		if mutating && s.slowAcceptanceAfter > 0 {
1380			slowTimer = time.NewTimer(s.slowAcceptanceAfter)
1381			defer slowTimer.Stop()
1382			slowCh = slowTimer.C
1383		}
1384	
1385		for {
1386			select {
1387			case result := <-ch:
1388				if result.err != nil {
1389					if mutating {
1390						return rpcResponse{}, &RPCAcceptanceUnknownError{Command: command, Cause: result.err}
1391					}
1392					return rpcResponse{}, result.err
1393				}
1394				return result.response, nil
1395			case <-ctx.Done():
1396				var claimed bool
1397				if mutating {
1398					claimed = s.claimPendingCancellation(id, true)
1399				} else {
1400					claimed = s.removePending(id)
1401				}
1402				if claimed {
1403					if mutating {
1404						s.terminateUnknownTransport(ctx.Err())
1405						return rpcResponse{}, &RPCAcceptanceUnknownError{Command: command, Cause: ctx.Err()}
1406					}
1407					return rpcResponse{}, ctx.Err()
1408				}
1409				// Response/process exit already won map ownership. Consume its buffered
1410				// result so cancellation cannot overwrite a definitive outcome.
1411				return s.finishClaimedRPC(command, mutating, <-ch)
1412			case <-s.sessionDone():
1413				var claimed bool
1414				if mutating {
1415					claimed = s.claimPendingCancellation(id, true)
1416				} else {
1417					claimed = s.removePending(id)
1418				}
1419				if claimed {
1420					if mutating {
1421						s.terminateUnknownTransport(s.ctx.Err())
1422						return rpcResponse{}, &RPCAcceptanceUnknownError{Command: command, Cause: s.ctx.Err()}
1423					}
1424					return rpcResponse{}, s.ctx.Err()
1425				}
1426				return s.finishClaimedRPC(command, mutating, <-ch)
1427			case <-timeoutCh:
1428				if s.removePending(id) {
1429					return rpcResponse{}, &rpcCallTimeoutError{command: command, id: id, timeout: timeout}
1430				}
1431				return s.finishClaimedRPC(command, mutating, <-ch)
1432			case <-slowCh:
1433				slowCh = nil
1434				if s.slowAcceptanceLog != nil {
1435					s.slowAcceptanceLog(command, s.slowAcceptanceAfter)
1436				} else {
1437					slog.Warn("piRPCSession: slow command acceptance", "command", command, "elapsed", s.slowAcceptanceAfter, "session_id", s.CurrentSessionID())
1438				}
1439			}
1440		}
1441	}
1442	
1443	func (s *piRPCSession) finishClaimedRPC(command string, mutating bool, result rpcCallResult) (rpcResponse, error) {
1444		if result.err == nil {
1445			return result.response, nil
1446		}
1447		if mutating {
1448			return rpcResponse{}, &RPCAcceptanceUnknownError{Command: command, Cause: result.err}
1449		}
1450		return rpcResponse{}, result.err
1451	}
1452	
1453	func (s *piRPCSession) removePending(id string) bool {
1454		return s.claimPendingCancellation(id, false)
1455	}
1456	
1457	// claimPendingCancellation makes mutation cancellation ownership and lifecycle
1458	// suppression one atomic pending-map operation. Transport failure therefore
1459	// cannot slip a competing EventError between request removal and suppression.
1460	func (s *piRPCSession) claimPendingCancellation(id string, suppress bool) bool {
1461		s.pendingMu.Lock()
1462		defer s.pendingMu.Unlock()
1463		if _, ok := s.pending[id]; !ok {
1464			return false
1465		}
1466		if suppress {
1467			s.suppressTransportEvent.Store(true)
1468		}
1469		delete(s.pending, id)
1470		return true
1471	}
1472	
1473	func (s *piRPCSession) acquireMutating(ctx context.Context, command string) error {
1474		if s.mutatingGate == nil {
1475			// Only zero-value test sessions can reach this path; real sessions always
1476			// initialize the gate in newPiRPCSession.
1477			s.mutatingGate = make(chan struct{}, 1)
1478			s.mutatingGate <- struct{}{}
1479		}
1480		select {
1481		case <-s.mutatingGate:
1482			if err := s.commandUnavailable(ctx); err != nil {
1483				s.releaseMutating()
1484				return &RPCCommandNotSentError{Command: command, Cause: err}
1485			}
1486			return nil
1487		case <-ctx.Done():
1488			return &RPCCommandNotSentError{Command: command, Cause: ctx.Err()}
1489		case <-s.sessionDone():
1490			return &RPCCommandNotSentError{Command: command, Cause: s.ctx.Err()}
1491		}
1492	}
1493	
1494	func (s *piRPCSession) commandUnavailable(ctx context.Context) error {
1495		select {
1496		case <-ctx.Done():
1497			return ctx.Err()
1498		default:
1499		}
1500		select {
1501		case <-s.sessionDone():
1502			return s.ctx.Err()
1503		default:
1504		}
1505		if !s.alive.Load() {
1506			return errors.New("pi RPC transport is closed")
1507		}
1508		return nil
1509	}
1510	
1511	func (s *piRPCSession) sessionDone() <-chan struct{} {
1512		if s.ctx == nil {
1513			return nil
1514		}
1515		return s.ctx.Done()
1516	}
1517	
1518	func (s *piRPCSession) releaseMutating() {
1519		s.mutatingGate <- struct{}{}
1520	}
1521	
1522	func (s *piRPCSession) writeJSON(v any) error {
1523		_, _, err := s.writeJSONTracked(s.ctx, v, nil)
1524		return err
1525	}
1526	
1527	// writeJSONTracked marshals before touching stdin, permits cancellation while
1528	// queued for the write lock, and closes stdin to interrupt an in-progress pipe
1529	// write on cancellation. Closing stdin makes that transport terminal rather
1530	// than leaving an immortal writer goroutine.
1531	func (s *piRPCSession) writeJSONTracked(ctx context.Context, v any, claimCancellation func() bool) (written int, cancellationClaimed bool, err error) {
1532		if ctx == nil {
1533			ctx = context.Background()
1534		}
1535		data, err := json.Marshal(v)
1536		if err != nil {
1537			return 0, false, &rpcWriteNotStartedError{cause: err}
1538		}
1539		data = append(data, '\n')
1540	
1541		if s.writeGate == nil {
1542			s.writeGate = make(chan struct{}, 1)
1543			s.writeGate <- struct{}{}
1544		}
1545		select {
1546		case <-s.writeGate:
1547			defer func() { s.writeGate <- struct{}{} }()
1548		case <-ctx.Done():
1549			return 0, false, &rpcWriteNotStartedError{cause: ctx.Err()}
1550		case <-s.sessionDone():
1551			return 0, false, &rpcWriteNotStartedError{cause: s.ctx.Err()}
1552		}
1553		if err := s.commandUnavailable(ctx); err != nil {
1554			return 0, false, &rpcWriteNotStartedError{cause: err}
1555		}
1556	
1557		s.procMu.Lock()
1558		stdin := s.stdin
1559		s.procMu.Unlock()
1560		if stdin == nil {
1561			return 0, false, &rpcWriteNotStartedError{cause: errors.New("piRPCSession: stdin not ready")}
1562		}
1563	
1564		var stateMu sync.Mutex
1565		finished := false
1566		cancelled := false
1567		writeDone := make(chan struct{})
1568		watcherDone := make(chan struct{})
1569		go func() {
1570			defer close(watcherDone)
1571			select {
1572			case <-ctx.Done():
1573			case <-s.sessionDone():
1574			case <-writeDone:
1575				return
1576			}
1577	
1578			stateMu.Lock()
1579			if finished || (claimCancellation != nil && !claimCancellation()) {
1580				stateMu.Unlock()
1581				return
1582			}
1583			cancelled = true
1584			s.alive.Store(false)
1585			stateMu.Unlock()
1586			_ = stdin.Close()
1587		}()
1588	
1589		total := 0
1590		var writeErr error
1591		for total < len(data) {
1592			n, currentErr := stdin.Write(data[total:])
1593			total += n
1594			if currentErr != nil {
1595				writeErr = currentErr
1596				break
1597			}
1598			if n == 0 {
1599				writeErr = io.ErrShortWrite
1600				break
1601			}
1602		}
1603		stateMu.Lock()
1604		finished = true
1605		cancellationClaimed = cancelled
1606		stateMu.Unlock()
1607		close(writeDone)
1608		<-watcherDone
1609	
1610		if cancellationClaimed {
1611			if writeErr != nil {
1612				return total, true, writeErr
1613			}
1614			if ctx.Err() != nil {
1615				return total, true, ctx.Err()
1616			}
1617			if s.ctx != nil && s.ctx.Err() != nil {
1618				return total, true, s.ctx.Err()
1619			}
1620			return total, true, errors.New("pi RPC write cancelled")
1621		}
1622		if writeErr != nil {
1623			return total, false, writeErr
1624		}
1625		return total, false, nil
1626	}
1627	
1628	// cancelPending claims every outstanding request. Its return value identifies
1629	// whether a mutating caller will report transport loss through its Send/compact
1630	// return path, avoiding a contradictory competing lifecycle event.
1631	func (s *piRPCSession) cancelPending(err error) (hadMutating bool) {
1632		if err == nil {
1633			err = errors.New("pi RPC transport closed")
1634		}
1635		s.pendingMu.Lock()
1636		pending := s.pending
1637		s.pending = make(map[string]*rpcPending)
1638		s.pendingMu.Unlock()
1639		for _, request := range pending {
1640			hadMutating = hadMutating || request.mutating
1641			request.ch <- rpcCallResult{err: err}
1642		}
1643		return hadMutating
1644	}
1645	
1646	func (s *piRPCSession) terminateUnknownTransport(cause error) {
1647		if cause == nil {
1648			cause = errors.New("mutating command acceptance cancelled")
1649		}
1650		s.suppressTransportEvent.Store(true)
1651		s.alive.Store(false)
1652		s.procMu.Lock()
1653		stdin := s.stdin
1654		s.procMu.Unlock()
1655		if stdin != nil {
1656			_ = stdin.Close()
1657		}
1658		s.cancelPending(&rpcTransportError{cause: cause})
1659	}
1660	
1661	func (s *piRPCSession) tryEmit(evt core.Event) {
1662		if s.events == nil {
1663			return
1664		}
1665		s.emitMu.Lock()
1666		defer s.emitMu.Unlock()
1667		if cap(s.events) > 0 && len(s.events) >= cap(s.events)-1 {
1668			// Keep one slot reserved for EventResult/EventError. Only progress may
1669			// be coalesced/dropped under backpressure.
1670			return
1671		}
1672		s.eventsMu.RLock()
1673		defer s.eventsMu.RUnlock()
1674		if s.eventsClosed {
1675			return
1676		}
1677		select {
1678		case s.events <- evt:
1679		default:
1680		}
1681	}
1682	
1683	func (s *piRPCSession) emitLifecycle(evt core.Event) {
1684		if s.events == nil {
1685			return
1686		}
1687		s.emitMu.Lock()
1688		defer s.emitMu.Unlock()
1689		s.eventsMu.RLock()
1690		defer s.eventsMu.RUnlock()
1691		if s.eventsClosed {
1692			return
1693		}
1694		if s.ctx == nil {
1695			s.events <- evt
1696			return
1697		}
1698		select {
1699		case s.events <- evt:
1700		case <-s.ctx.Done():
1701		}
1702	}
1703	
1704	func (s *piRPCSession) emitTransportFailure(cause error) {
1705		if cause == nil {
1706			cause = errors.New("pi RPC transport failed")
1707		}
1708		s.transportOnce.Do(func() {
1709			transportErr := &rpcTransportError{cause: cause}
1710			s.alive.Store(false)
1711			s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseTransportBroken, false)
1712			// Claim waiters before closing stdin. This makes pending-map ownership
1713			// the outcome linearization point and lets a blocked writer unwind after
1714			// its caller has been selected as the sole error reporter.
1715			hadMutating := s.cancelPending(transportErr)
1716			s.procMu.Lock()
1717			stdin := s.stdin
1718			s.procMu.Unlock()
1719			if stdin != nil {
1720				_ = stdin.Close()
1721			}
1722			if hadMutating || s.suppressTransportEvent.Load() {
1723				// The waiting Send/compact caller reports typed outcome-unknown (or
1724				// typed not-sent for a zero-byte write). Do not race it with a
1725				// contradictory lifecycle transport event.
1726				return
1727			}
1728			s.emitLifecycle(core.Event{Type: core.EventError, Error: transportErr})
1729		})
1730	}
1731	
1732	func (s *piRPCSession) closeEvents() {
1733		if s.events == nil {
1734			return
1735		}
1736	
1737		s.eventsMu.Lock()
1738		defer s.eventsMu.Unlock()
1739		if !s.eventsClosed {
1740			s.eventsClosed = true
1741			close(s.events)
1742		}
1743	}
1744	
1745	func (s *piRPCSession) RespondPermission(_ string, _ core.PermissionResult) error {
1746		return nil
1747	}
1748	
1749	func (s *piRPCSession) EventErrorIsTerminal(err error) bool {
1750		var transportErr *rpcTransportError
1751		return errors.As(err, &transportErr)
1752	}

1754	func (s *piRPCSession) Events() <-chan core.Event { return s.events }

1756	func (s *piRPCSession) CurrentSessionID() string {
1757		v, _ := s.sessionID.Load().(string)

1761	func (s *piRPCSession) Alive() bool { return s.alive.Load() }

1763	func (s *piRPCSession) noteProtocolEvent(eventType string) {
1764		if eventType == "" {
1765			return
1766		}
1767		s.healthMu.Lock()
1768		s.lastProtocolEvent = eventType
1769		s.healthActivitySeq++
1770		s.healthMu.Unlock()
1771	}

1773	func (s *piRPCSession) setHealthPhase(phase core.StallPhase, compacting bool) {
1774		s.healthMu.Lock()
1775		s.healthPhase = phase
1776		s.isCompacting = compacting
1777		s.healthMu.Unlock()
1778	}

1780	// ProbeStall performs bounded read-only reconciliation. get_state supplies
1781	// operation flags; a bounded tail read of its sessionFile supplies an opaque
1782	// durable leaf/file cursor without transporting or logging message bodies.
1783	func (s *piRPCSession) ProbeStall(ctx context.Context) (core.StallProbeSnapshot, error) {
1784		snapshot := core.StallProbeSnapshot{
1785			ProcessAlive: s.Alive(),
1786			Generation:   s.generation.Load(),
1787		}
1788		s.procMu.Lock()
1789		if s.proc != nil && s.proc.Process != nil {
1790			snapshot.PID = s.proc.Process.Pid
1791		}
1792		s.procMu.Unlock()
1793		if !snapshot.ProcessAlive {
1794			snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseProcessDead
1795			return snapshot, nil
1796		}
1797	
1798		s.healthMu.Lock()
1799		snapshot.Phase = s.healthPhase
1800		snapshot.ActivitySeq = s.healthActivitySeq
1801		snapshot.IsCompacting = s.isCompacting
1802		snapshot.LastEventType = s.lastProtocolEvent
1803		s.healthMu.Unlock()
1804		s.turnMu.Lock()
1805		snapshot.PromptPending = s.promptPending
1806		turnActive := s.turn.active
1807		s.turnMu.Unlock()
1808	
1809		resp, err := s.callWithTimeoutContext(ctx, map[string]any{"type": "get_state"}, 0)
1810		if err != nil {
1811			if !s.Alive() {
1812				snapshot.ProcessAlive = false
1813				snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseTransportBroken
1814			}
1815			return snapshot, err
1816		}
1817		if !resp.success {
1818			return snapshot, fmt.Errorf("get_state rejected: %s", resp.errMsg)
1819		}
1820		var state struct {
1821			IsStreaming         bool   `json:"isStreaming"`
1822			IsCompacting        bool   `json:"isCompacting"`
1823			SessionFile         string `json:"sessionFile"`
1824			MessageCount        int    `json:"messageCount"`
1825			PendingMessageCount int    `json:"pendingMessageCount"`
1826		}
1827		if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.data, &state); err != nil {
1828			return snapshot, fmt.Errorf("decode get_state: %w", err)
1829		}
1830		snapshot.TransportResponsive = true
1831		snapshot.IsStreaming = state.IsStreaming
1832		snapshot.IsCompacting = state.IsCompacting
1833		snapshot.PendingMessageCount = state.PendingMessageCount
1834		if snapshot.PromptPending {
1835			snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseAwaitingAcceptance
1836		} else if state.IsCompacting {
1837			snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseCompacting
1838		} else if state.IsStreaming {
1839			switch snapshot.Phase {
1840			case core.StallPhaseTool, core.StallPhaseRetrying:
1841			default:
1842				snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseStreaming
1843			}
1844		} else if !turnActive {
1845			snapshot.Phase = core.StallPhaseSettled
1846		}
1847		cursor, err := boundedDurableCursor(ctx, state.SessionFile, state.MessageCount)
1848		if err != nil {
1849			// get_state responsiveness is still useful, but durable reconciliation
1850			// failure must count as a failed probe rather than healthy silence.
1851			return snapshot, fmt.Errorf("read durable cursor: %w", err)
1852		}
1853		snapshot.Cursor = cursor
1854		return snapshot, nil
1855	}
1856	
1857	// InterruptStall serializes Pi's native abort through the prompt/compact
1858	// mutation gate and never submits or replays user input.
1859	func (s *piRPCSession) InterruptStall(ctx context.Context) error {
1860		if err := s.acquireMutating(ctx, "abort"); err != nil {
1861			return fmt.Errorf("admit stalled-operation abort: %w", err)
1862		}
1863		defer s.releaseMutating()
1864	
1865		// Revalidate after acquiring the mutation gate. Settlement or a queued turn
1866		// may have won while core was scheduling recovery. Never abort unknown prompt
1867		// acceptance, an idle/new generation, or manual compaction (Pi RPC abort does
1868		// not cancel manual compaction).
1869		s.turnMu.Lock()
1870		promptPending := s.promptPending
1871		s.turnMu.Unlock()
1872		s.healthMu.Lock()
1873		phase := s.healthPhase
1874		s.healthMu.Unlock()
1875		if promptPending {
1876			return nil
1877		}
1878		switch phase {
1879		case core.StallPhaseRunning, core.StallPhaseStreaming, core.StallPhaseTool, core.StallPhaseRetrying:
1880		default:
1881			return nil
1882		}
1883	
1884		resp, err := s.callWithTimeoutContext(ctx, map[string]any{"type": "abort"}, 0)
1885		if err != nil {
1886			return fmt.Errorf("abort stalled operation: %w", err)
1887		}
1888		if !resp.success {
1889			return fmt.Errorf("abort stalled operation rejected: %s", resp.errMsg)
1890		}
1891		return nil
1892	}
1893	
1894	func boundedDurableCursor(ctx context.Context, path string, messageCount int) (string, error) {
1895		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
1896			return "", err
1897		}
1898		if path == "" {
1899			return fmt.Sprintf("messages:%d", messageCount), nil
1900		}
1901		f, err := os.Open(path)
1902		if err != nil {
1903			return "", err
1904		}
1905		defer f.Close()
1906		info, err := f.Stat()
1907		if err != nil {
1908			return "", err
1909		}
1910		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
1911			return "", err
1912		}
1913		const tailLimit int64 = 64 * 1024
1914		size := info.Size()
1915		start := size - tailLimit
1916		if start < 0 {
1917			start = 0
1918		}
1919		buf := make([]byte, size-start)
1920		if len(buf) > 0 {
1921			if _, err := f.ReadAt(buf, start); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
1922				return "", err
1923			}
1924		}
1925		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
1926			return "", err
1927		}
1928		lines := bytes.Split(buf, []byte{'\n'})
1929		leaf := ""
1930		for i := len(lines) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
1931			line := bytes.TrimSpace(lines[i])
1932			if len(line) == 0 || (start > 0 && i == 0) {
1933				continue
1934			}
1935			var entry struct {
1936				ID string `json:"id"`
1937			}
1938			if json.Unmarshal(line, &entry) == nil && entry.ID != "" {
1939				leaf = entry.ID
1940				break
1941			}
1942		}
1943		return fmt.Sprintf("messages:%d:size:%d:leaf:%s", messageCount, size, leaf), nil
1944	}
1945	
1946	func (s *piRPCSession) Close() error {
1947		s.closeOnce.Do(func() {
1948			s.closing.Store(true)
1949			s.alive.Store(false)
1950			s.setHealthPhase(core.StallPhaseProcessDead, false)
1951			// Try a graceful shutdown by closing stdin first.
1952			s.procMu.Lock()
1953			stdin := s.stdin
1954			proc := s.proc
1955			s.procMu.Unlock()
1956			if stdin != nil {
1957				_ = stdin.Close()
1958			}
1959			if proc != nil && proc.Process != nil {
1960				_ = proc.Process.Signal(os.Interrupt)
1961			}
1962			// Wake every ACK waiter before waiting for process teardown. Calls that
1963			// completed their write report acceptance/outcome unknown.
1964			s.cancelPending(&rpcTransportError{cause: errors.New("pi RPC session closed")})
1965			if s.cancel != nil {
1966				s.cancel()
1967			}
1968			done := make(chan struct{})
1969			go func() {
1970				s.wg.Wait()
1971				close(done)
1972			}()
1973			select {
1974			case <-done:
1975			case <-time.After(8 * time.Second):
1976				if proc != nil && proc.Process != nil {
1977					_ = proc.Process.Kill()
1978				}
1979				slog.Warn("piRPCSession: close timed out, killed")
1980			}
1981			s.closeEvents()
1982		})
1983		return nil
1984	}
1985	
1986	// idKey converts a JSON id (string or number) to a stable map key.
1987	func idKey(raw json.RawMessage) string {
1988		raw = bytes.TrimSpace(raw)
1989		if len(raw) == 0 {
1990			return ""
1991		}
1992		var s string
1993		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &s) == nil {
1994			return s
1995		}
1996		var n json.Number
1997		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &n) == nil {
1998			return string(n)
1999		}
2000		return string(raw)
2001	}
2002	
2003	func truncBytes(b []byte, n int) string {
2004		if len(b) <= n {
2005			return string(b)
2006		}
2007		return string(b[:n]) + "..."
2008	}

286	// findSessionFile locates the .jsonl file for a given session UUID in sessDir.
287	// Session files are named: <timestamp>_<uuid>.jsonl — this function extracts
288	// the UUID portion and matches exactly to avoid partial-match vulnerabilities.
289	func findSessionFile(sessDir, sessionID string) string {
290		entries, err := os.ReadDir(sessDir)
291		if err != nil {
292			return ""
293		}
294		for _, entry := range entries {
295			name := entry.Name()
296			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".jsonl") {
297				continue
298			}
299			// Extract UUID: strip .jsonl, then take everything after the last "_".
300			base := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".jsonl")
301			if idx := strings.LastIndex(base, "_"); idx >= 0 {
302				if base[idx+1:] == sessionID {
303					return filepath.Join(sessDir, name)
304				}
305			}
306		}
307		return ""
308	}

310	// piSessionDir returns the pi session directory for the given workDir.
311	// Pi encodes the absolute path as: replace "/" with "-", wrap with "--".
312	// e.g. /home/user/project → --home-user-project--
313	func piSessionDir(workDir string) string {
314		homeDir, err := os.UserHomeDir()
315		if err != nil {
316			return ""
317		}
318		absDir, err := filepath.Abs(workDir)
319		if err != nil {
320			return ""
321		}
322		encoded := "--" + strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimPrefix(absDir, "/"), "/", "-") + "--"
323		return filepath.Join(homeDir, ".pi", "agent", "sessions", encoded)
324	}
